--[[
	SheetFrame  -  one frame of a columns x rows spritesheet inside a host, whatever the sheet's
	resolution: the sheet is drawn that many times the host's size in a clipping window and moved by
	whole frames. ImageRectSize would need the sheet's pixel size, which a plugin cannot read.
	  SheetFrame.new(host) -> view      host: an ImageLabel or ImageButton; the view fills it, under
	                                    the host's other children
	  view.show(image, columns, rows)   image: a content link; clears the host's own image. No rows:
	                                    a square sheet
	  view.setFrame(index)              0-based, row by row; wraps past the last frame
	  view.hide()
	  view.shown                        true from show until hide
	The host draws its own image or a frame, never both: giving it an image hides the view. A frame
	is stretched to the host's shape, as a flipbook particle's is.
]]

local SheetFrame = {}

function SheetFrame.new(host)
	local window = Instance.new("Frame")
	window.Name = "SheetFrame"
	window.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	window.BorderSizePixel = 0
	window.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	window.ClipsDescendants = true
	window.Visible = false
	window.Parent = host

	local sheet = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	sheet.Name = "Sheet"
	sheet.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sheet.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sheet.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	sheet.Parent = window

	local view = { shown = false }
	local columns = 1
	local rows = 1

	function view.setFrame(index)
		local frame = index % (columns * rows)
		local column = frame % columns
		local row = math.floor(frame / columns)
		sheet.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-column, -row)
	end

	function view.show(image, sheetColumns, sheetRows)
		columns = math.max(math.floor(sheetColumns), 1)
		rows = math.max(math.floor(sheetRows or sheetColumns), 1)
		view.shown = true
		host.Image = ""
		sheet.Size = UDim2.fromScale(columns, rows)
		if sheet.Image ~= image then
			sheet.Image = image
		end
		view.setFrame(0)
		window.Visible = true
	end

	function view.hide()
		view.shown = false
		window.Visible = false
	end

	host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function()
		if host.Image ~= "" then
			view.hide()
		end
	end)

	return view
end

return SheetFrame

--[[
	ShortcutPanel  -  Part-Icles V5 ShortcutKey System

	The Shortcuts modal, opened by the Settings panel's "Shortcuts" button over Properties: a short
	description, the leader row ("Leader: P  [Set] [(none)]"; a chord shows as "<LEADER> + key", or
	bare with no leader), a search box, Reset all, then the actions by ActionCatalog category, each
	with its chord and [Bind] [X].
	Build returns refs: { panel, scrollList, searchBox, resetBtn, headerCloseBtn, leaderLabel,
	leaderSetBtn, leaderClearBtn }. Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring wires capture, conflict warnings and
	saving, and lists only actions with `implemented = true`.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local ShortcutPanel = {}

local DESCRIPTION = 'Bind a chord. Hold the leader (below) then tap the chord. Don\'t press the leader during capture.'

local function buildClassic(sg)
	-- Wider than RandomizerPanel: each row holds a chord and two buttons, and 300 leaves about 120 px
	-- for a chord such as "P + Shift+X".
	local panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, "Shortcuts", 300, 420)
	panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
	panel.Visible = false

	local refs = {panel = panel}

	-- makeToolPanel's own header close, exposed for wiring.
	local hd = panel:FindFirstChild("Hd")
	if hd then refs.headerCloseBtn = hd:FindFirstChild("Close") end

	local descBlob = W.makeBlob("PGuardDesc", panel, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22))
	descBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 26)
	W.addPadding(descBlob, 6, 6, 4, 4)
	local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	desc.Name = "DescText"
	desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	desc.Text = DESCRIPTION
	desc.TextWrapped = false
	desc.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	desc.Font = T.Font
	desc.TextSize = 9
	desc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	desc.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	desc.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	desc.Parent = descBlob

	-- Shortcuts/Wiring drives its capture and label through these refs.
	local leaderRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	leaderRow.Name = "LeaderRow"
	leaderRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leaderRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 52)
	leaderRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22)
	leaderRow.Parent = panel

	local leaderBlob = W.makeBlob("LeaderBlob", leaderRow, UDim2.new(1, -132, 1, 0))
	leaderBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	W.addPadding(leaderBlob, 6, 4, 0, 0)
	local leaderLabel = W.makeLabel("L", leaderBlob, "Leader: P", T.BrightGold, T.Font, 10)
	leaderLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	leaderLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	refs.leaderLabel = leaderLabel

	local leaderSetBtn = W.makeButton("LeaderSet", leaderRow, "Set", UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
	leaderSetBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderSetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 2)
	leaderSetBtn.TextSize = 10
	refs.leaderSetBtn = leaderSetBtn

	local leaderClearBtn = W.makeButton("LeaderClear", leaderRow, "(none)", UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
	leaderClearBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderClearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 2)
	leaderClearBtn.TextSize = 10
	refs.leaderClearBtn = leaderClearBtn

	-- Shortcuts/Wiring filters the list by it.
	local searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	searchBox.Name = "ShortcutsSearch"
	searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Search shortcuts..."
	searchBox.Text = ""
	searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	searchBox.Font = T.Font
	searchBox.TextSize = 9
	searchBox.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	searchBox.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	searchBox.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	searchBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	searchBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	searchBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 78)
	searchBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
	searchBox.Parent = panel
	W.addCorner(searchBox, UDim.new(0, 3))
	W.addPadding(searchBox, 0, 0, 4, 4)
	refs.searchBox = searchBox

	-- Two-click confirm, wired by Shortcuts/Wiring.
	local resetBtn = W.makeButton("ShortcutsReset", panel, "Reset all", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18), T.DarkGold)
	resetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 100)
	resetBtn.TextSize = 9
	refs.resetBtn = resetBtn

	local scrollList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scrollList.Name = "ShortcutsList"
	scrollList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scrollList.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scrollList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 122)
	scrollList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -128)
	scrollList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scrollList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scrollList.ScrollBarThickness = 1
	scrollList.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scrollList.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(scrollList, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
	refs.scrollList = scrollList

	-- Shown until Wiring.populate fills the list.
	local placeholder = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	placeholder.Name = "Placeholder"
	placeholder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	placeholder.Text = "Loading…"
	placeholder.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	placeholder.Font = T.Font
	placeholder.TextSize = 8
	placeholder.TextWrapped = true
	placeholder.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	placeholder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	placeholder.Parent = scrollList

	return refs
end

-- Width of the Set and (none) buttons in the leader row.
local LEADER_BUTTON = 64
-- Two lines of caption text.
local DESCRIPTION_HEIGHT = 32

-- The same refs on the mode's tool shell. Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring fills the list and drives
-- the leader row, the search and the two-click "Reset all".
local function buildModern(sg)
	local panel, chrome = W.makeToolShell(sg, "Shortcuts", PanelSizes.of("Shortcuts"), PanelSizes.of("ShortcutsHeight"))
	panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
	local body = chrome.body
	local refs = { panel = panel, headerCloseBtn = chrome.close }

	local description = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	description.Name = "DescText"
	description.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	description.Text = DESCRIPTION
	description.TextWrapped = true
	description.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	description.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	description.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	description.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, DESCRIPTION_HEIGHT)
	TypeScale.style(description, "Caption")
	W.paint(description, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
	description.Parent = body

	-- "Leader: <key>" with Set and (none) at the right.
	local leaderRow = W.makeRowFrame(body, "LeaderRow", 0)
	local leaderLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	leaderLabel.Name = "L"
	leaderLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leaderLabel.Text = "Leader: P"
	leaderLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	leaderLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	W.lay(leaderLabel, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -(LEADER_BUTTON + LAYOUT.RowGap) * 2, 1, 0)
	end)
	TypeScale.style(leaderLabel, "Label")
	W.paint(leaderLabel, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	leaderLabel.Parent = leaderRow
	refs.leaderLabel = leaderLabel

	local leaderSet = W.makeActionButton(leaderRow, "LeaderSet", "Set", 0, "TextSecondary")
	leaderSet.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderSet.Size = UDim2.new(0, LEADER_BUTTON, 1, 0)
	W.lay(leaderSet, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -(LEADER_BUTTON + LAYOUT.RowGap), 0, 0)
	end)
	refs.leaderSetBtn = leaderSet

	local leaderClear = W.makeActionButton(leaderRow, "LeaderClear", "(none)", 0, "TextSecondary")
	leaderClear.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderClear.Size = UDim2.new(0, LEADER_BUTTON, 1, 0)
	leaderClear.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	refs.leaderClearBtn = leaderClear

	local searchBox, searchField = W.makeSearchField(body, "ShortcutsSearch", "Search shortcuts...")
	refs.searchBox = searchBox

	local reset = W.makeActionButton(body, "ShortcutsReset", "Reset all", 0, "TextSecondary")
	refs.resetBtn = reset

	-- Wiring.populate fills it with the action rows.
	local scrollList = W.makeLoadingList(body, "ShortcutsList")
	refs.scrollList = scrollList

	-- The stack under the description, laid again when the layout changes (Relayout).
	W.layEach(body, function()
		local gap = LAYOUT.RowGap
		local top = DESCRIPTION_HEIGHT + gap
		leaderRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
		top += LAYOUT.Row + gap
		searchField.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
		top += LAYOUT.Search + gap
		reset.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
		top += LAYOUT.Row + gap
		scrollList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
		scrollList.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -top)
	end)

	return refs
end

function ShortcutPanel.build(sg)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return buildClassic(sg)
	end
	return buildModern(sg)
end

return ShortcutPanel

--[[
	Skin  -  draws a theme's surfaces: the background image on every panel in every mode, and in the
	Custom mode each surface's layers from ThemeSchema's custom.surfaces (fill, image, gradient,
	shadow, outline, corner) on panels, title bars, fields, buttons, toggles and scroll bars.
	Surfaces come from the Widgets registries: `panels`, `blobs` (a GuiButton is a button, else a
	field), `toggles`, `scrollbars`, and `surfaces` ({ inst, surface }), which overrides the lists' guess.
	  Skin.apply(themed)             every registered surface, after ThemeApply's registered repaint;
	                                 a widget is skipped while the theme it was drawn with stands
	  Skin.applyAside(themed)        the same for a build kept apart (Widgets.buildAside)
	  Skin.watch(screenGui, themed)  draws widgets added later, once a frame at most; animations play
	                                 while that UI is shown
	  Skin.background(image, panel)  a panel's overlay image: the panel layer's in Custom, else the theme's
	  Skin.dressLit(inst, lit)       a segment or tab chip, from its own paint: its layers while lit
	  Skin.eachSurface(themed, fn)   fn(inst, surface) for every registered widget once
	  Skin.outline(stroke), Skin.ownTextColor(text), Skin.invalidate(), Skin.reset()
	What it adds is named "_Skin..." and removed when its layer goes off; what it changes beyond
	colours (corner radius, outline thickness, a scroll bar's images) it remembers and gives back.
	Animations and gradient shimmer play on ThemeClock. Text on a title bar's, field's or button's
	layers keeps a colour reaching 3:1 there, or takes the theme text colour that reads best (over an
	image, the image layer's text colour if it names one).
	What it keeps about a widget lives in its attributes (`_skin...`, RESERVED_ATTRS.md), never in a
	weak table: Roblox drops an instance from a weak-keyed table once no variable holds it.
]]

local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.ThemeSchema)
local ThemeClock = require(script.Parent.ThemeClock)
local BuildPacer = require(script.Parent.BuildPacer)
local ColorMath = require(script.Parent.ThemeModes.ColorMath)
local Invert = require(script.Parent.ThemeModes.Invert)
local T = C.T

local Skin = {}

local LAYOUTS = { "UIListLayout", "UIGridLayout", "UITableLayout", "UIPageLayout" }

-- What a surface is painted as when its fill layer is off.
local BASE = {
	panel = { color = "PanelBg", alpha = "PanelAlpha" },
	titleBar = { color = "Header" },
	field = { color = "BlobBg", alpha = "BlobAlpha" },
	button = { color = "BlobBg", alpha = "BlobAlpha" },
}

-- What a text mirror copies from its widget (drawText).
local TEXT_PROPERTIES = { "Text", "FontFace", "TextSize", "TextColor3", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment", "TextTruncate", "TextWrapped", "RichText", "LineHeight" }
-- The contrast text on a widget's layers must reach, else it takes the theme colour that reads best.
local TEXT_FLOOR = 3
local READABLE_ROLES = { "OnAccent", "TextPrimary", "PanelBg" }

local version = 0
local mirrorings = 0
local imageSizes = {}
local pendingSizes = {}
local watchConnection = nil
local applyQueued = false
local lastThemed = nil

function Skin.reset()
	version += 1
	ThemeClock.reset()
	if watchConnection then
		watchConnection:Disconnect()
		watchConnection = nil
	end
	applyQueued = false
	lastThemed = nil
end

-- How Invert turns a layer colour: fill, gradient and outline as fills; shadow and image colours stay.
local INVERTED_AS = { ["fill.color"] = "fill", ["gradient.from"] = "fill", ["gradient.to"] = "fill", ["outline.color"] = "fill" }

-- A layer the surface does not draw (ThemeSchema.SURFACE_LAYERS) reads as off.
local function layersOf(surface)
	local doc = T.Doc
	local drawsLayer = {}
	for _, layer in ipairs(ThemeSchema.SURFACE_LAYERS[surface] or {}) do
		drawsLayer[layer] = true
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, field in ipairs(ThemeSchema.SURFACE_FIELDS) do
		local layer, key = string.match(field.path, "^(%a+)%.(.+)$")
		out[layer] = out[layer] or {}
		local value = ThemeSchema.value(doc, "custom.surfaces." .. surface .. "." .. field.path)
		if C.Inversion and value and INVERTED_AS[field.path] then
			value = C.color3ToHex(Invert.color(C.hexToColor3(value), C.Inversion, INVERTED_AS[field.path]))
		end
		-- The theme's hue turn reaches every colour of a layer, as it does the roles (Constants.refresh).
		if C.HueTurn and value and field.kind == "color" then
			value = C.color3ToHex(ColorMath.turnHue(C.hexToColor3(value), C.HueTurn))
		end
		out[layer][key] = value
	end
	for layer, values in pairs(out) do
		if not drawsLayer[layer] then
			values.on = false
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Every layer off: what a widget is drawn with to give back all the skin did to it.
local function offLayers(surface)
	local layers = layersOf(surface)
	for _, values in pairs(layers) do
		values.on = false
	end
	return layers
end

local function anyOn(layers)
	for _, layer in pairs(layers) do
		if layer.on then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function color(hex, fallback)
	return hex and C.hexToColor3(hex) or fallback
end

-- A property's value before the skin first changed it, kept on the instance.
local function remember(inst, key, value)
	if inst:GetAttribute("_skinWas" .. key) == nil then
		inst:SetAttribute("_skinWas" .. key, value)
	end
end

local function original(inst, key)
	return inst:GetAttribute("_skinWas" .. key)
end

local function restore(inst, key)
	local value = inst:GetAttribute("_skinWas" .. key)
	if value ~= nil then
		inst[key] = value
		inst:SetAttribute("_skinWas" .. key, nil)
	end
end

local function own(inst, className, name)
	local child = inst:FindFirstChild(name)
	if child and child.ClassName == className then
		return child
	end
	child = Instance.new(className)
	child.Name = name
	child.Parent = inst
	return child
end

local function drop(inst, name)
	local child = inst:FindFirstChild(name)
	if child then
		child:Destroy()
	end
end

-- The UICorner / UIStroke the widget had before the skin, or the skin's own one.
local function modifier(inst, className, name)
	for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
		if child.ClassName == className and child.Name ~= name then
			return child, false
		end
	end
	return own(inst, className, name), true
end

-- A 9-slice or a sheet needs the image's pixel size: loaded once per image as an EditableImage.

local function sizeOf(id, onKnown)
	if id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local known = imageSizes[id]
	if known ~= nil then
		return known or nil
	end
	-- Every image waiting on one probe is told when it ends (a lit chip draws outside a full apply).
	local waiting = pendingSizes[id]
	if waiting then
		table.insert(waiting, onKnown)
		return nil
	end
	pendingSizes[id] = { onKnown }
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, editable = pcall(function()
			return AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(id))
		end)
		imageSizes[id] = ok and editable and editable.Size or false
		if ok and editable then
			pcall(function()
				editable:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		local callbacks = pendingSizes[id]
		pendingSizes[id] = nil
		for _, callback in ipairs(callbacks) do
			callback()
		end
	end)
	return nil
end

-- A 9-slice takes no rounding: Roblox rounds each of its nine pieces, opening gaps between them.
local function cornerOf(label, radius)
	if label.ScaleType == Enum.ScaleType.Slice then
		return UDim.new(0, 0)
	end
	return radius
end

local function laySlice(label, border, size)
	border = math.min(border, math.floor(math.min(size.X, size.Y) / 2) - 1)
	label.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	label.SliceCenter = Rect.new(border, border, size.X - border, size.Y - border)
	local corner = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner then
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
	end
end

local function setImage(label, fields)
	local id = fields.image or ""
	local source = fields["anim.source"] or "None"
	local frames = fields["anim.frames"]
	if source == "List" and frames and frames[1] then
		id = frames[1]
	end
	label.Image = id
	label.ImageTransparency = 1 - (fields.opacity or 100) / 100
	label.ImageColor3 = color(fields.tint, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	-- ThemeSchema validates `scale` to its choices, each an Enum.ScaleType name.
	local scale = fields.scale or "Stretch"
	label.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType[scale]
	label.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
	label.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
	if scale == "Tile" then
		label.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(fields.tile or 128, fields.tile or 128)
	end
	-- A slice stretches until the probe has the image's size, then lays its slice if still shown.
	if scale == "Slice" then
		label.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
		local border = fields.slice or 16
		local size = sizeOf(id, function()
			local measured = imageSizes[id]
			if measured and label.Image == id then
				laySlice(label, border, measured)
			end
		end)
		if size then
			laySlice(label, border, size)
		end
	end
	if source == "None" then
		ThemeClock.stop(label)
	else
		ThemeClock.image(label, {
			source = source,
			image = fields.image,
			frames = frames,
			cols = fields["anim.cols"],
			rows = fields["anim.rows"],
			count = fields["anim.count"],
			fps = fields["anim.fps"],
			loop = fields["anim.loop"],
		})
	end
end

local function imageFields(prefix)
	local fields = {}
	for _, field in ipairs(ThemeSchema.IMAGE_FIELDS) do
		local path = prefix and prefix .. field.path or ThemeSchema.backgroundPath(field.path)
		fields[field.path] = ThemeSchema.value(T.Doc, path)
	end
	return fields
end

-- A panel drawn by its image casts it from the overlay: on the clear panel a UIShadow veils its inside.
local function castShadow(inst, shadow)
	if not shadow.on or inst:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		drop(inst, "_SkinShadow")
		return
	end
	local ui = own(inst, "UIShadow", "_SkinShadow")
	ui.Color = color(shadow.color, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
	ui.Transparency = 1 - (shadow.opacity or 50) / 100
	ui.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, shadow.blur or 12)
	ui.Spread = UDim2.fromOffset(shadow.spread or 0, shadow.spread or 0)
	ui.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(shadow.x or 0, shadow.y or 4)
end

function Skin.background(image, panel)
	if T.Mode == "Custom" and ThemeSchema.imageLayerShows(T.Doc, "panel") then
		setImage(image, imageFields("custom.surfaces.panel.image."))
		castShadow(image, layersOf("panel").shadow)
	else
		drop(image, "_SkinShadow")
		-- The live image and see-through (a preview edits them before the document).
		local fields = imageFields(nil)
		fields.image = T.BgImage or ""
		fields.opacity = math.floor((1 - (T.BgImageTransparency or 1)) * 100 + 0.5)
		setImage(image, fields)
	end
	local corner = image:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	local panelCorner = panel and panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner and panelCorner then
		corner.CornerRadius = cornerOf(image, panelCorner.CornerRadius)
	end
end

-- Whether nothing of the UI lies under a button or field (the Transform row over the scene).
local function floating(inst)
	local panels = lastThemed and lastThemed.panels or {}
	local parent = inst.Parent
	while parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") do
		if parent.BackgroundTransparency < 1 or table.find(panels, parent) then
			return false
		end
		parent = parent.Parent
	end
	return true
end

-- A button or field over the scene draws its see-through layers solid: they would show the scene.
local function overScene(inst, surface)
	return (surface == "button" or surface == "field") and floating(inst)
end

-- The colour a surface's fill paints; its base colour while the fill layer is off.
local function fillColor(surface, layers)
	local base = BASE[surface]
	return if layers.fill.on then color(layers.fill.color, T[base.color]) else T[base.color]
end

local function drawFill(inst, surface, layers)
	if not BASE[surface] then
		return
	end
	local fill = layers.fill
	if fill.on then
		inst.BackgroundColor3 = fillColor(surface, layers)
		-- Modals stay solid as well.
		if not (inst:GetAttribute("_opaquePanel") or inst:GetAttribute("_opaqueBlob")) then
			local opacity = if overScene(inst, surface) then 100 else fill.opacity or 100
			inst.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - opacity / 100
		end
	end
end

-- A layer covers a widget: a gradient tints its text too and an image child lies over it. Never on a
-- text box (its caret) or a scrolling frame; a button's or label's text shows through a mirror.
local function coverable(inst)
	return inst:IsA("GuiObject") and not inst:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and not inst:IsA("TextBox")
end

-- The colours under a widget's text as drawn: its gradient's ends, else its fill, seen over the
-- panel; nil under an image.
local function groundOf(inst)
	if inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinImage") then
		return nil
	end
	local behind = inst.BackgroundTransparency
	local gradient = inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinGradient")
	if not gradient then
		return { ColorMath.mix(inst.BackgroundColor3, T.PanelBg, behind) }
	end
	local ground = {}
	local alphas = gradient.Transparency.Keypoints
	for index, keypoint in ipairs(gradient.Color.Keypoints) do
		local alpha = alphas[index] and alphas[index].Value or 0
		table.insert(ground, ColorMath.mix(keypoint.Value, T.PanelBg, 1 - (1 - behind) * (1 - alpha)))
	end
	return ground
end

-- The widget's own text colour while it reaches TEXT_FLOOR on `ground`, else the best-reading one.
local function readable(textColor, ground)
	if not ground then
		return textColor
	end
	local best, bestContrast = textColor, ColorMath.minContrast(textColor, ground)
	if bestContrast >= TEXT_FLOOR then
		return textColor
	end
	for _, role in ipairs(READABLE_ROLES) do
		local contrast = ColorMath.minContrast(T[role], ground)
		if contrast > bestContrast then
			best, bestContrast = T[role], contrast
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Copies a widget's text onto its mirror in a readable colour; a transparency the widget's own code
-- set (a disabled state) passes on.
local function copyText(inst)
	local label = inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinText")
	if not label then
		return
	end
	if inst.TextTransparency ~= 1 then
		inst:SetAttribute("_skinWasTextTransparency", inst.TextTransparency)
		inst.TextTransparency = 1
	end
	for _, property in ipairs(TEXT_PROPERTIES) do
		label[property] = inst[property]
	end
	label.TextColor3 = inst:GetAttribute("_skinTextColor") or readable(inst.TextColor3, groundOf(inst))
	label.TextTransparency = original(inst, "TextTransparency")
end

-- The colour an image layer gives text over it (an image's own colours are not known here), or nil.
local function imageTextColor(layers)
	local image = layers.image
	if image.on and image.textColor then
		return C.hexToColor3(image.textColor)
	end
	return nil
end

-- fn for each clear-backed text on `root`, outside children with their own background or the skin's.
local function eachTextOn(root, fn)
	for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and string.sub(child.Name, 1, 5) ~= "_Skin" and child.BackgroundTransparency >= 1 then
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("TextBox") then
				fn(child)
			end
			eachTextOn(child, fn)
		end
	end
end

-- Recolours text, keeping its own colour (`_skinTextWas`) and the given one (`_skinTextSet`).
local function recolourText(text, colour)
	if colour == text.TextColor3 then
		return
	end
	if text:GetAttribute("_skinTextWas") == nil then
		text:SetAttribute("_skinTextWas", text.TextColor3)
	end
	text:SetAttribute("_skinTextSet", colour)
	text.TextColor3 = colour
end

-- Text whose ground changed takes the image layer's text colour, or one that reads there.
local function colourTextOn(root, ground, forced)
	eachTextOn(root, function(text)
		recolourText(text, forced or readable(text.TextColor3, ground))
	end)
end

-- Gives a text its own colour back while Skin's readable colour still shows. ThemeApply's walk calls
-- it first: a readable colour is no text role, so the walk alone would leave it.
function Skin.ownTextColor(text)
	local was = text:GetAttribute("_skinTextWas")
	if was == nil then
		return text.TextColor3
	end
	local given = text:GetAttribute("_skinTextSet")
	text:SetAttribute("_skinTextWas", nil)
	text:SetAttribute("_skinTextSet", nil)
	if given == text.TextColor3 then
		text.TextColor3 = was
	end
	return text.TextColor3
end

-- A mirror's connections are numbered by `_skinMirror`; one of an earlier mirroring disconnects itself.
local function mirrorText(inst)
	local label = inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinText")
	if not label then
		label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "_SkinText"
		-- TypeScale skips `_Skin...` text, or it would scale the mirror's copied size again.
		label:SetAttribute("_typeRole", inst:GetAttribute("_typeRole") or "Mirror")
		label.Parent = inst
	end
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	remember(inst, "TextTransparency", inst.TextTransparency)
	copyText(inst)
	if inst:GetAttribute("_skinMirror") ~= nil then
		return
	end
	mirrorings += 1
	local mirroring = mirrorings
	inst:SetAttribute("_skinMirror", mirroring)
	local function follow(signal)
		local connection
		connection = signal:Connect(function()
			if inst:GetAttribute("_skinMirror") ~= mirroring then
				connection:Disconnect()
				return
			end
			copyText(inst)
		end)
	end
	for _, property in ipairs(TEXT_PROPERTIES) do
		follow(inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property))
	end
	follow(inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextTransparency"))
end

local function unmirrorText(inst)
	inst:SetAttribute("_skinMirror", nil)
	drop(inst, "_SkinText")
	restore(inst, "TextTransparency")
end

-- A covered button or label shows its text through the mirror; uncovered, its own text is back.
local function drawText(inst, covered)
	if covered and (inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextLabel")) then
		mirrorText(inst)
	elseif inst:GetAttribute("_skinMirror") ~= nil or inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinText") then
		unmirrorText(inst)
	end
end

-- Where the part of `inst` its parent shows (its top `shown` pixels) lies along a gradient's angle,
-- as 0..1 of it. A UIGradient's ends snap to its widget's edges at its angle, so it spans the
-- corners projected on the direction: a w x h rectangle projects onto
-- [min(0, w dx) + min(0, h dy), max(0, w dx) + max(0, h dy)].
local function shownSpan(full, shown, rotation)
	local angle = math.rad(rotation)
	local dx, dy = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
	local low = math.min(0, full.X * dx) + math.min(0, full.Y * dy)
	local high = math.max(0, full.X * dx) + math.max(0, full.Y * dy)
	local shownLow = math.min(0, full.X * dx) + math.min(0, shown * dy)
	local shownHigh = math.max(0, full.X * dx) + math.max(0, shown * dy)
	if high - low < 1e-6 or shownHigh - shownLow < 1e-6 then
		return 0, 1
	end
	return (shownLow - low) / (high - low), (shownHigh - low) / (high - low)
end

-- Two ends laid at `first` and `last` (0..1) and held flat outside them.
local function between(first, last, keypoint, from, to)
	local points = {}
	if first > 0 then
		table.insert(points, keypoint(0, from))
	end
	table.insert(points, keypoint(first, from))
	table.insert(points, keypoint(last, to))
	if last < 1 then
		table.insert(points, keypoint(1, to))
	end
	return points
end

-- Lays a gradient layer on `inst`; on a title bar's frame over the shown part only (the bar clips it).
-- `under`: a colour to lay the gradient over, solid (a widget over the scene); nil lays it see-through.
local function layGradient(inst, gradient, under)
	local ui = inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinGradient")
	if not ui then
		return
	end
	local rotation = gradient.rotation or 90
	local first, last = 0, 1
	if inst.Name == "_SkinTitle" and inst.Parent then
		first, last = shownSpan(inst.AbsoluteSize, math.min(inst.Parent.AbsoluteSize.Y, inst.AbsoluteSize.Y), rotation)
	end
	local fromColor = color(gradient.from, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	local toColor = color(gradient.to, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
	local fromAlpha = 1 - (gradient.fromOpacity or 100) / 100
	local toAlpha = 1 - (gradient.toOpacity or 100) / 100
	if under then
		fromColor = ColorMath.mix(fromColor, under, fromAlpha)
		toColor = ColorMath.mix(toColor, under, toAlpha)
		fromAlpha, toAlpha = 0, 0
	end
	ui.Color = ColorSequence.new(between(first, last, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new, fromColor, toColor))
	ui.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(between(first, last, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new, fromAlpha, toAlpha))
	ui.Rotation = rotation
end

-- `under`: see layGradient.
local function drawGradient(inst, layers, under)
	local gradient = layers.gradient
	local foreign = false
	for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("UIGradient") and child.Name ~= "_SkinGradient" then
			foreign = true
		end
	end
	if not gradient.on or foreign or not coverable(inst) then
		local old = inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinGradient")
		if old then
			ThemeClock.stop(old)
			old:Destroy()
		end
		return false
	end
	-- A UIGradient multiplies the background colour: white lets its own colours show.
	inst.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local ui = own(inst, "UIGradient", "_SkinGradient")
	layGradient(inst, gradient, under)
	if under then
		inst.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	end
	ThemeClock.shimmer(ui, gradient.shimmer or 0, gradient.rotation or 90)
	return true
end

-- A panel drawn by its image casts its shadow from that image (Skin.background).
local function drawShadow(inst, surface, layers)
	if surface == "panel" and ThemeSchema.imageLayerShows(T.Doc, "panel") then
		drop(inst, "_SkinShadow")
		return
	end
	castShadow(inst, layers.shadow)
end

local function drawOutline(inst, surface, layers)
	local outline = layers.outline
	if inst:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		return
	end
	local stroke, isOwn = modifier(inst, "UIStroke", "_SkinStroke")
	if not outline.on then
		stroke:SetAttribute("_skinRestSurface", nil)
		if isOwn then
			stroke:Destroy()
		else
			restore(stroke, "Thickness")
		end
		return
	end
	if not isOwn then
		remember(stroke, "Thickness", stroke.Thickness)
	end
	stroke.Color = color(outline.color, T.Outline)
	stroke.Transparency = 1 - (outline.opacity or 100) / 100
	stroke.Thickness = outline.thickness or 1
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke:SetAttribute("_skinRestSurface", surface)
end

-- A stroke's resting outline as the theme in force draws it, or nil; hover, focus and state paints
-- start from it. ThemeApply's repaint runs before Skin draws a new theme, so it is never kept.
function Skin.outline(stroke)
	local surface = stroke:GetAttribute("_skinRestSurface")
	if surface == nil or T.Mode ~= "Custom" then
		return nil
	end
	local outline = layersOf(surface).outline
	if not outline.on then
		return nil
	end
	return { color = color(outline.color, T.Outline), thickness = outline.thickness or 1, transparency = 1 - (outline.opacity or 100) / 100 }
end

local function drawCorner(inst, layers)
	local corner = layers.corner
	if inst:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		return
	end
	local ui, isOwn = modifier(inst, "UICorner", "_SkinCorner")
	if not corner.on then
		if isOwn then
			ui:Destroy()
		else
			restore(ui, "CornerRadius")
		end
		return
	end
	if not isOwn then
		remember(ui, "CornerRadius", ui.CornerRadius)
	end
	ui.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, corner.radius or 8)
end

-- An image under a widget's content; list-laid widgets keep none (it would become a row).
local function drawImage(inst, surface, layers)
	local image = layers.image
	local laysOut = false
	for _, className in ipairs(LAYOUTS) do
		if inst:FindFirstChildOfClass(className) then
			laysOut = true
		end
	end
	if surface == "panel" or not image.on or laysOut or not coverable(inst) or not ThemeSchema.hasPicture(image.image, image["anim.source"], image["anim.frames"]) then
		local old = inst:FindFirstChild("_SkinImage")
		if old then
			ThemeClock.stop(old)
			old:Destroy()
		end
		return false
	end
	local label = own(inst, "ImageLabel", "_SkinImage")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.ZIndex = 0
	local fields = {}
	for key, value in pairs(image) do
		fields[key] = value
	end
	setImage(label, fields)
	-- The image takes the widget's rounding, or it would show square corners past it.
	local corner = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if corner then
		own(label, "UICorner", "_SkinCorner").CornerRadius = cornerOf(label, corner.CornerRadius)
	else
		drop(label, "_SkinCorner")
	end
	return true
end

-- A scroll bar: its fill is the bar's colour, its outline thickness the bar's, its image the bar's.
local function drawScrollBar(inst, layers)
	local fill, outline, image = layers.fill, layers.outline, layers.image
	if fill.on then
		inst.ScrollBarImageColor3 = color(fill.color, T.ScrollBar)
		remember(inst, "ScrollBarImageTransparency", inst.ScrollBarImageTransparency)
		inst.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 1 - (fill.opacity or 100) / 100
	else
		restore(inst, "ScrollBarImageTransparency")
	end
	if outline.on then
		remember(inst, "ScrollBarThickness", inst.ScrollBarThickness)
		inst.ScrollBarThickness = outline.thickness or 1
	else
		restore(inst, "ScrollBarThickness")
	end
	local id = image.on and image.image or ""
	for _, key in ipairs({ "TopImage", "MidImage", "BottomImage" }) do
		if id ~= "" then
			remember(inst, key, inst[key])
			inst[key] = id
		else
			restore(inst, key)
		end
	end
end

-- The radius of the panel a title bar tops: its nearest ancestor with a corner.
local function panelRadius(bar)
	local node = bar.Parent
	while node do
		local corner = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		if corner then
			return corner.CornerRadius.Offset
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return T.BigCorner.Offset
end

-- Layers go on a frame of the skin's own, rounded and taller than the bar by its radius, which the
-- bar clips: its bottom corners fall outside and a gradient or an image is one piece.
local function drawTitleBar(bar, layers)
	local square = bar:FindFirstChild("SquareBottom")
	if not (layers.fill.on or layers.gradient.on or layers.image.on) then
		local header = bar.Parent and bar.Parent:FindFirstChild("Header")
		if header then
			eachTextOn(header, Skin.ownTextColor)
		end
		drop(bar, "_SkinTitle")
		restore(bar, "BackgroundTransparency")
		restore(bar, "ClipsDescendants")
		if square then
			restore(square, "Visible")
		end
		return
	end
	remember(bar, "BackgroundTransparency", bar.BackgroundTransparency)
	remember(bar, "ClipsDescendants", bar.ClipsDescendants)
	bar.ClipsDescendants = true
	if square then
		remember(square, "Visible", square.Visible)
		square.Visible = false
	end
	local radius = layers.corner.on and (layers.corner.radius or 8) or panelRadius(bar)
	local fresh = bar:FindFirstChild("_SkinTitle") == nil
	local frame = own(bar, "Frame", "_SkinTitle")
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, radius)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = T.Header
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = original(bar, "BackgroundTransparency")
	-- A gradient tints a background: a bar the theme leaves clear takes a solid one under it.
	if layers.gradient.on and frame.BackgroundTransparency >= 1 then
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	end
	bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	own(frame, "UICorner", "_SkinCorner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	if fresh then
		-- The span shown changes with the bar's width: the gradient is laid again from the theme.
		frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			layGradient(frame, layersOf("titleBar").gradient)
		end)
	end
	local header = bar.Parent and bar.Parent:FindFirstChild("Header")
	if header then
		eachTextOn(header, Skin.ownTextColor)
	end
	drawFill(frame, "titleBar", layers)
	drawGradient(frame, layers)
	drawImage(frame, "titleBar", layers)
	-- The title and controls sit in the Header beside the bar, never the bar's parent: on the
	-- Properties panel that is the panel itself.
	if header then
		colourTextOn(header, groundOf(frame), imageTextColor(layers))
	end
end

local function draw(inst, surface, layers)
	if surface == "scrollBar" then
		drawScrollBar(inst, layers)
		return
	elseif surface == "titleBar" then
		drawTitleBar(inst, layers)
		return
	end
	-- Readable colours are worked out afresh from each text's own.
	if surface ~= "panel" then
		if inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextBox") then
			Skin.ownTextColor(inst)
		end
		eachTextOn(inst, Skin.ownTextColor)
	end
	drawFill(inst, surface, layers)
	local tinted = drawGradient(inst, layers, if overScene(inst, surface) then fillColor(surface, layers) else nil)
	drawShadow(inst, surface, layers)
	drawOutline(inst, surface, layers)
	drawCorner(inst, layers)
	local covered = drawImage(inst, surface, layers)
	local forced = covered and imageTextColor(layers) or nil
	inst:SetAttribute("_skinTextColor", forced)
	drawText(inst, tinted or covered)
	-- A panel's text is left to its roles: a walk of every label in it on each draw costs too much.
	if surface == "panel" or not (layers.fill.on or tinted or covered) then
		return
	end
	-- A widget's own text shows as is (a covered one through its mirror), as does the text lying on it.
	local ground = groundOf(inst)
	if not (tinted or covered) and (inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextBox")) then
		recolourText(inst, readable(inst.TextColor3, ground))
	end
	colourTextOn(inst, ground, forced)
end

-- Every registered widget once, with its surface (`surfaces` first, else its list); Pick uses it too.
function Skin.eachSurface(themed, fn)
	local named = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(themed.surfaces or {}) do
		named[entry.inst] = entry.surface
	end
	local function visit(inst, guess)
		if named[inst] == nil then
			fn(inst, guess)
		end
	end
	-- Panels first: a title bar takes its panel's corner as drawn.
	for _, panel in ipairs(themed.panels or {}) do
		visit(panel, "panel")
	end
	for inst, surface in pairs(named) do
		fn(inst, surface)
	end
	for _, blob in ipairs(themed.blobs or {}) do
		visit(blob, blob:IsA("GuiButton") and "button" or "field")
	end
	for _, toggle in ipairs(themed.toggles or {}) do
		visit(toggle, "toggle")
	end
	for _, scrollbar in ipairs(themed.scrollbars or {}) do
		visit(scrollbar, "scrollBar")
	end
end

local drawThemed

function Skin.apply(themed)
	lastThemed = themed
	drawThemed(themed)
end

-- Draws a build kept apart (Widgets.buildAside) without making it where new widgets are drawn.
function Skin.applyAside(themed)
	drawThemed(themed)
end

function drawThemed(themed)
	local custom = T.Mode == "Custom"
	local stamp = tostring(version) .. ":" .. tostring(T.Doc)
	local layersBySurface = {}
	if custom then
		for _, surface in ipairs(ThemeSchema.SURFACES) do
			local layers = layersOf(surface)
			layersBySurface[surface] = anyOn(layers) and layers or nil
		end
	end
	-- Per surface, a widget keeps the stamp of the theme it was drawn with, and `_skinned_<surface>`
	-- while it holds anything to give back; with neither (every widget outside Custom) it is skipped.
	Skin.eachSurface(themed, function(inst, surface)
		local layers = layersBySurface[surface]
		local skinnedKey = "_skinned_" .. surface
		if not layers and not inst:GetAttribute(skinnedKey) then
			return
		end
		-- The start-up build draws a Custom theme over frames like the rest of the build; anywhere
		-- else (a theme change, a rebuild) this does nothing.
		BuildPacer.step()
		local stampKey = "_skinDrawn_" .. surface
		if not inst.Parent or inst:GetAttribute(stampKey) == stamp then
			return
		end
		inst:SetAttribute(stampKey, stamp)
		if layers then
			inst:SetAttribute(skinnedKey, true)
			draw(inst, surface, layers)
		elseif inst:GetAttribute(skinnedKey) then
			draw(inst, surface, offLayers(surface))
			inst:SetAttribute(skinnedKey, nil)
		end
	end)
	for _, image in ipairs(themed.panelImages or {}) do
		if image.Parent and image:GetAttribute("_skinDrawn_overlay") ~= stamp then
			image:SetAttribute("_skinDrawn_overlay", stamp)
			Skin.background(image, themed.overlayPanel and themed.overlayPanel[image])
		end
	end
end

-- A lit segment or chip takes a button's see-through and layers; an unlit one keeps its plain look
-- in the button's shape, so a row's chips match the theme's buttons.
function Skin.dressLit(inst, lit)
	local layers = T.Mode == "Custom" and layersOf("button") or nil
	if lit and layers and anyOn(layers) then
		inst.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		inst:SetAttribute("_skinned_button", true)
		draw(inst, "button", layers)
	elseif layers and layers.corner.on then
		local shape = offLayers("button")
		shape.corner = layers.corner
		inst:SetAttribute("_skinned_button", true)
		draw(inst, "button", shape)
	elseif inst:GetAttribute("_skinned_button") then
		draw(inst, "button", offLayers("button"))
		inst:SetAttribute("_skinned_button", nil)
	end
end

-- The theme changed: everything is drawn again on the next apply.
function Skin.invalidate()
	version += 1
end

function Skin.watch(screenGui, themed)
	ThemeClock.watch(screenGui)
	if watchConnection then
		watchConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	watchConnection = screenGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
		if applyQueued then
			return
		end
		applyQueued = true
		task.defer(function()
			applyQueued = false
			if screenGui.Parent then
				Skin.apply(themed)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

return Skin

--[[
	ThemeApply  -  live theme changes. Loaded by UIBuilder/init.luau; adds UpdateTheme, SnapshotTheme
	and RestoreTheme to UIBuilder.
	UpdateTheme takes the saved theme values (nil = unchanged), runs Constants.refresh(), lays a new
	layout in place (Relayout's slots, then TypeScale's roles), then repaints in two steps: a walk
	moves text and frames no registry knows from an old role colour to the new one, then the
	registered instances are painted from their roles. The order matters: the walk goes by colour
	alone, and a new panel colour can equal an old text colour, so the repaint puts right what the
	walk did to a registered instance. Image tints are never matched: a themed icon registers its own
	repaint (W.paint, or the repaints list). What no slot carries (Classic, a widget built otherwise
	in another structure) still needs a rebuild.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.ThemeSchema)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local Skin = require(script.Parent.Skin)
local Relayout = require(script.Parent.Relayout)
local UISound = require(script.Parent.UISound)
local T = C.T

-- Roles the walk follows, by priority: text in a colour two roles shared follows the earlier role.
local TEXT_ROLES = { "TextPrimary", "TextHeading", "TextLabel", "TextSecondary", "TextDisabled", "Accent", "Success", "Warning", "Danger" }

-- Colours are stored at 8 bits; anything closer than half a step is the same colour.
local SAME_COLOR = 0.002

local function sameColor(first, second)
	return math.abs(first.R - second.R) < SAME_COLOR
		and math.abs(first.G - second.G) < SAME_COLOR
		and math.abs(first.B - second.B) < SAME_COLOR
end

-- Drops destroyed instances from a registry list; `key` names the instance field of table entries.
local function sweepDead(list, key)
	local kept = 1
	for index = 1, #list do
		local entry = list[index]
		local inst = key and entry[key] or entry
		if inst and inst.Parent then
			list[kept] = entry
			kept += 1
		end
	end
	for index = kept, #list do
		list[index] = nil
	end
end

-- { old, new } pairs for the text roles whose colour changed.
local function changedTextRoles(before)
	local remap = {}
	for _, role in ipairs(TEXT_ROLES) do
		local old = before[role]
		local claimed = false
		for _, pair in ipairs(remap) do
			if sameColor(pair.old, old) then
				claimed = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not claimed and not sameColor(old, T[role]) then
			table.insert(remap, { old = old, new = T[role] })
		end
	end
	return remap
end

local function remapColor(color, remap)
	for _, pair in ipairs(remap) do
		if sameColor(color, pair.old) then
			return pair.new
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Moves every text and accent-coloured frame from an old role colour to the new one. Skipped:
-- `_noColorRemap` (a user colour, a compositing layer, white on a fill) and frames under a UIGradient.
local function remapDescendants(screenGui, remap)
	for _, desc in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
		local isText = desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("TextBox")
		-- Skin's readable colour goes before the walk reads the text's own.
		local own = isText and Skin.ownTextColor(desc)
		if desc:GetAttribute("_noColorRemap") then
			continue
		end
		if isText then
			local text = remapColor(own, remap)
			if text then
				desc.TextColor3 = text
			end
			if desc:IsA("TextBox") then
				local placeholder = remapColor(desc.PlaceholderColor3, remap)
				if placeholder then
					desc.PlaceholderColor3 = placeholder
				end
			end
		elseif desc:IsA("Frame") or desc:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
			local fill = remapColor(desc.BackgroundColor3, remap)
			if fill and not desc:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then
				desc.BackgroundColor3 = fill
			end
		end
	end
end

return function(UIBuilder, W)
	local function repaintRegistered(themed)
		for _, stroke in ipairs(themed.strokes) do
			stroke.Color = T.Border
			stroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha
		end
		for _, panel in ipairs(themed.panels) do
			panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
			-- Modal dialogs stay solid whatever the theme's see-through.
			if not panel:GetAttribute("_opaquePanel") then
				panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
			end
		end
		for _, blob in ipairs(themed.blobs) do
			blob.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			blob.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		end
		for _, fill in ipairs(themed.fills) do
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = T.SliderFill
		end
		for _, scrollbar in ipairs(themed.scrollbars) do
			scrollbar.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(themed.roles) do
			entry.inst[entry.prop] = T[entry.role]
		end
		-- After strokes: a toggle's outline depends on its state.
		for _, toggle in ipairs(themed.toggles) do
			W.paintToggle(toggle)
		end

		-- WidgetAxis.trackAxis registers { btn, color, selBg }; the button's `_selected` picks the selected paint.
		for _, entry in ipairs(themed.axisButtons) do
			local button = entry.btn
			if button.Parent then
				W.paintAxisButton(button, entry.color, entry.selBg, button:GetAttribute("_selected") == true)
			end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(themed.axisColored) do
			if entry.inst and entry.inst.Parent then
				local color = T["Axis" .. (entry.axis or "X")]
				if color then
					entry.inst[entry.prop] = color
				end
			end
		end
		for _, dot in ipairs(themed.evenDots) do
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = dot:GetAttribute("_even") and T.BrightGold or T.DarkGold
		end
		-- Widgets that paint from T themselves (deck tabs, tray chips, the workspace bar).
		for _, repaint in ipairs(themed.repaints) do
			pcall(repaint)
		end
		-- Last: the background images and Custom's layers draw over the colours just put back.
		Skin.invalidate()
		Skin.apply(themed)
		UISound.refresh()
	end

	-- panelAlpha and blobAlpha are saved with the theme and drawn by the Classic mode only.
	-- Argument 10 (font scale) is accepted and ignored: text sizes come from the theme's text size.
	function UIBuilder:UpdateTheme(accent, background, slider, panelAlpha, blobAlpha, fontName, textAccent, blobColor, scrollBarColor, _fontScale, bgImage, bgImageTransparency)
		local themed = W.getThemed()
		for _, name in ipairs({ "strokes", "panels", "blobs", "fills", "scrollbars", "toggles", "panelImages", "evenDots" }) do
			sweepDead(themed[name])
		end
		sweepDead(themed.roles, "inst")
	sweepDead(themed.surfaces, "inst")
	for overlay in pairs(themed.overlayPanel) do
		if not overlay.Parent then
			themed.overlayPanel[overlay] = nil
		end
	end

		local before = {}
		for _, role in ipairs(TEXT_ROLES) do
			before[role] = T[role]
		end

		if accent then
			T.InputAccent = accent
		end
		if background then
			T.InputBg = background
		end
		if slider then
			T.InputSlider = slider
		end
		if blobColor then
			T.InputBlob = blobColor
		end
		if scrollBarColor then
			T.InputScrollBar = scrollBarColor
		end
		if textAccent then
			T.TextAccent = textAccent
		end
		if panelAlpha ~= nil then
			T.InputPanelAlpha = panelAlpha
		end
		if blobAlpha ~= nil then
			T.InputBlobAlpha = blobAlpha
		end
		if bgImage ~= nil then
			T.BgImage = bgImage
		end
		if bgImageTransparency ~= nil then
			T.BgImageTransparency = bgImageTransparency
		end

		local fontChanged = false
		if fontName and fontName ~= T.Font.Name then
			local font = ThemeSchema.fontEnum(fontName)
			if font then
				T.Font = font
				fontChanged = true
			end
		end

		C.refresh()

		-- A new layout is laid before the colours, so Skin draws on the new sizes. Compared with the layout
		-- last laid, not the one before this call: a caller may have refreshed Constants (ThemeStore.apply).
		local screenGui = self._screenGui
		local relaidOut = false
		if screenGui and C.layoutKey() ~= self._laidKey then
			Relayout.run()
			TypeScale.reapply(screenGui)
			self._laidKey = C.layoutKey()
			relaidOut = true
		end

		-- Before the registered repaint, never after it: see the header.
		if screenGui then
			local remap = changedTextRoles(before)
			if #remap > 0 then
				remapDescendants(screenGui, remap)
			end
		end
		repaintRegistered(themed)
		if fontChanged and screenGui and not relaidOut then
			TypeScale.reapply(screenGui)
		end
	end

	function UIBuilder:SnapshotTheme()
		return {
			Accent = T.InputAccent,
			Background = T.InputBg,
			Slider = T.InputSlider,
			Blob = T.InputBlob,
			ScrollBar = T.InputScrollBar,
			TextAccent = T.TextAccent,
			PanelAlpha = T.InputPanelAlpha,
			BlobAlpha = T.InputBlobAlpha,
			Font = T.Font,
			BgImage = T.BgImage,
			BgImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency,
			-- The rest of the theme (ThemeSchema); documents are replaced whole, never edited in place.
			Doc = T.Doc,
		}
	end

	function UIBuilder:RestoreTheme(snapshot)
		T.Doc = snapshot.Doc or T.Doc
		self:UpdateTheme(snapshot.Accent, snapshot.Background, snapshot.Slider, snapshot.PanelAlpha, snapshot.BlobAlpha, snapshot.Font.Name,
			snapshot.TextAccent, snapshot.Blob, snapshot.ScrollBar, nil, snapshot.BgImage or "", snapshot.BgImageTransparency or 1)
	end
end

--[[
	ThemeClock  -  the theme's moving parts on one clock: an image layer's animation (a sprite sheet
	or a list of image ids) and a gradient's shimmer.
	  ThemeClock.image(label, spec)   plays an animation on a skin-owned ImageLabel after its image,
	                                  tint and opacity are set. spec: { source = "Sheet" | "List",
	                                  image, frames, cols, rows, count, fps, loop }. The first frame
	                                  shows at once, the rest once the engine has the images.
	  ThemeClock.shimmer(gradient, speed, rotation)   sways a UIGradient along its angle; speed 0 holds it
	  ThemeClock.stop(inst)           an image stops and its sheet goes; a gradient holds still
	  ThemeClock.watch(screenGui)     plays only while that UI is shown and Studio is in use
	  ThemeClock.advance(now)         lays every playing image's frame for clock time `now` (once a frame)
	  ThemeClock.reset()              a new build: nothing plays
	A sheet is a uniform grid read row by row: the whole sheet is scaled to cols x rows widgets inside
	a CanvasGroup and moved a cell a frame. That needs no pixel size (a plugin can measure only images
	the viewer owns), and the CanvasGroup takes the widget's corner (ClipsDescendants ignores UICorner).
	Images with the same animation share it and show the same frame. On a frame change only images
	on screen take it: one found off screen keeps the hidden ancestor that kept it off (its gate) and
	costs one read of the gate per change until the gate shows, then catches up. Reduced motion (the
	theme's or GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled) shows first frames, still.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local Motion = require(script.Parent.Motion)
local Preload = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Preload)
local T = C.T

local ThemeClock = {}

-- Clicking another Studio pane also drops the viewport's focus, so the clock stops only after this long.
local IDLE_AFTER = 30
-- A shimmer sways a quarter of the widget each way; its period runs SLOWEST to FASTEST on a log scale.
local SHIMMER_REACH = 0.25
local SLOWEST, FASTEST = 12, 0.8

local EPOCH = os.clock()
-- An animation and its images: { key, fps, count, pingPong, loadKey, frames or positions, index,
-- members = { [label] = { cells, shown, gate } } }. Strong tables, swept of dead widgets as met.
local animations = {}
local playing = {}
local swaying = {}
local loaded = {}
local loading = {}
local clockConnection = nil
local watchConnections = {}
local shown = true
local outOfUse = false
local focusChanges = 0

-- The frame an animation of `count` frames shows at clock time `now`.
local function frameAt(animation, now)
	local count = animation.count
	if count <= 1 or not loaded[animation.loadKey] then
		return 0
	end
	local step = math.floor((now - EPOCH) * animation.fps)
	if animation.pingPong then
		local period = 2 * count - 2
		local phase = step % period
		return phase < count and phase or period - phase
	end
	return step % count
end

local function showFrame(animation, label, member, index)
	member.shown = index
	if member.cells then
		member.cells.Position = animation.positions[index + 1]
	else
		label.Image = animation.frames[index + 1]
	end
end

-- The nearest of `inst` and its ancestors that keeps it from being drawn, or false; `seen` caches
-- answers for one pass.
local function hiddenAt(inst, seen)
	local known = seen[inst]
	if known ~= nil then
		return known
	end
	local gate
	if not inst:IsA("GuiObject") then
		gate = false
	elseif inst.Visible == false or inst.Parent == nil then
		gate = inst
	else
		gate = hiddenAt(inst.Parent, seen)
	end
	seen[inst] = gate
	return gate
end

-- One image's turn at a frame change: it takes the frame if on screen, unless its gate is still shut.
local function catchUp(animation, label, member, index, seen, gates)
	if member.shown == index then
		return
	end
	local gate = member.gate
	if gate then
		local shut = gates[gate]
		if shut == nil then
			shut = gate.Visible == false
			gates[gate] = shut
		end
		if shut then
			return
		end
	end
	member.gate = hiddenAt(label, seen) or nil
	if not member.gate then
		showFrame(animation, label, member, index)
	end
end

local refresh

function ThemeClock.advance(now)
	local seen, gates = nil, nil
	local dropped = false
	for key, animation in pairs(animations) do
		local index = frameAt(animation, now)
		if index ~= animation.index then
			animation.index = index
			seen = seen or {}
			gates = gates or {}
			for label, member in pairs(animation.members) do
				if label.Parent then
					catchUp(animation, label, member, index, seen, gates)
				else
					animation.members[label] = nil
					playing[label] = nil
					dropped = true
				end
			end
			if next(animation.members) == nil then
				animations[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	if dropped then
		refresh()
	end
end

local function tick()
	ThemeClock.advance(os.clock())
end

-- Starts or stops the clock and the shimmers for what plays now and whether it may.
function refresh()
	local running = shown and not outOfUse and not Motion.reduced()
	local anyImage = next(playing) ~= nil
	if running and anyImage and not clockConnection then
		clockConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(tick)
	elseif not (running and anyImage) and clockConnection then
		clockConnection:Disconnect()
		clockConnection = nil
	end
	for gradient, tween in pairs(swaying) do
		if not gradient.Parent then
			tween:Cancel()
			swaying[gradient] = nil
		elseif running then
			tween:Play()
		else
			tween:Pause()
		end
	end
end

-- The sheet's cells in a CanvasGroup under the label, cut to the label's corner.
local function sheetCells(label, spec, cols, rows)
	local group = label:FindFirstChild("_ClockSheet")
	if not group then
		group = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
		group.Name = "_ClockSheet"
		group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		group.BorderSizePixel = 0
		group.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		group.Parent = label
	end
	local labelCorner = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	local corner = group:FindFirstChild("_ClockCorner")
	if labelCorner then
		if not corner then
			corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.Name = "_ClockCorner"
			corner.Parent = group
		end
		corner.CornerRadius = labelCorner.CornerRadius
	elseif corner then
		corner:Destroy()
	end
	local cells = group:FindFirstChild("Cells")
	if not cells then
		cells = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		cells.Name = "Cells"
		cells.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cells.BorderSizePixel = 0
		cells.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
		cells.Parent = group
	end
	cells.Image = spec.image
	cells.ImageColor3 = label.ImageColor3
	cells.ImageTransparency = label.ImageTransparency
	cells.Size = UDim2.fromScale(cols, rows)
	label.Image = ""
	return cells
end

-- Asks the engine for an animation's images once; its frames advance after the answer.
local function load(key, ids)
	if loaded[key] or loading[key] then
		return
	end
	loading[key] = true
	task.spawn(function()
		Preload.wait(ids)
		loading[key] = nil
		loaded[key] = true
	end)
end

-- The animation `spec` describes, shared by every image playing the same one; nil for none.
local function animationFor(spec)
	local fps, pingPong = spec.fps or 12, spec.loop == "PingPong"
	local animation
	if spec.source == "Sheet" and (spec.image or "") ~= "" then
		local cols, rows = spec.cols or 4, spec.rows or 4
		local count = (spec.count or 0) > 0 and math.min(spec.count, cols * rows) or cols * rows
		local key = table.concat({ "Sheet", spec.image, cols, rows, count, fps, tostring(pingPong) }, "|")
		animation = animations[key]
		if not animation then
			animation = { key = key, fps = fps, count = count, pingPong = pingPong, loadKey = spec.image, cols = cols, rows = rows, positions = {}, index = -1, members = {} }
			for index = 0, count - 1 do
				animation.positions[index + 1] = UDim2.fromScale(-(index % cols), -math.floor(index / cols))
			end
			load(spec.image, { spec.image })
		end
	elseif spec.source == "List" and spec.frames and spec.frames[1] then
		local joined = table.concat(spec.frames, ",")
		local key = table.concat({ "List", joined, fps, tostring(pingPong) }, "|")
		animation = animations[key]
		if not animation then
			animation = { key = key, fps = fps, count = #spec.frames, pingPong = pingPong, loadKey = joined, frames = spec.frames, index = -1, members = {} }
			load(joined, spec.frames)
		end
	end
	if animation then
		animations[animation.key] = animation
	end
	return animation
end

local function leave(label)
	local animation = playing[label]
	if animation then
		animation.members[label] = nil
		playing[label] = nil
		if next(animation.members) == nil then
			animations[animation.key] = nil
		end
	end
end

function ThemeClock.image(label, spec)
	local animation = animationFor(spec)
	if animation ~= playing[label] then
		leave(label)
	end
	if not animation then
		ThemeClock.stop(label)
		return
	end
	local member = { shown = -1 }
	if spec.source == "Sheet" then
		member.cells = sheetCells(label, spec, animation.cols, animation.rows)
	else
		local sheet = label:FindFirstChild("_ClockSheet")
		if sheet then
			sheet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	-- It joins at the frame the others show (the first while reduced or not yet playing).
	showFrame(animation, label, member, Motion.reduced() and 0 or math.max(animation.index, 0))
	animation.members[label] = member
	playing[label] = animation
	refresh()
end

function ThemeClock.stop(inst)
	if swaying[inst] then
		swaying[inst]:Cancel()
		swaying[inst] = nil
		inst.Offset = Vector2.zero
	end
	leave(inst)
	local group = inst:FindFirstChild("_ClockSheet")
	if group then
		group:Destroy()
	end
	refresh()
end

function ThemeClock.shimmer(gradient, speed, rotation)
	if swaying[gradient] then
		swaying[gradient]:Cancel()
		swaying[gradient] = nil
	end
	if (speed or 0) <= 0 then
		gradient.Offset = Vector2.zero
		refresh()
		return
	end
	local angle = math.rad(rotation or 90)
	local dx, dy = math.cos(angle) * SHIMMER_REACH, math.sin(angle) * SHIMMER_REACH
	local period = SLOWEST * (FASTEST / SLOWEST) ^ ((math.clamp(speed, 1, 100) - 1) / 99)
	gradient.Offset = Vector2.new(-dx, -dy)
	-- Sine in and out, reversing for ever: it slows into each end as a swing does.
	swaying[gradient] = TweenService:Create(gradient, TweenInfo.new(period / 2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Offset = Vector2.new(dx, dy) })
	refresh()
end

function ThemeClock.watch(screenGui)
	for _, connection in ipairs(watchConnections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	shown = screenGui.Enabled
	watchConnections = {
		screenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
			shown = screenGui.Enabled
			refresh()
		end),
		UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
			focusChanges += 1
			local release = focusChanges
			task.delay(IDLE_AFTER, function()
				if focusChanges == release then
					outOfUse = true
					refresh()
				end
			end)
		end),
		UserInputService.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
			focusChanges += 1
			outOfUse = false
			refresh()
		end),
	}
	refresh()
end

function ThemeClock.reset()
	for gradient, tween in pairs(swaying) do
		tween:Cancel()
		swaying[gradient] = nil
	end
	table.clear(playing)
	table.clear(animations)
	refresh()
end

return ThemeClock

--[[
	ThemeCode  -  the export code: a theme document packed into a short text a user pastes into
	Discord (one message holds 2,000 characters) and back.
	  ThemeCode.encode(doc) -> "PIT1." .. base64url text
	  ThemeCode.decode(text) -> a clean document (ThemeSchema.clean), or nil and why
	Every setting the document holds is a record, in ThemeSchema id order, keyed by a varint of
	((id - previous id) << 3) | wire, so a key is one byte while ids run close. Wires:
	  0 varint   a number (zigzag), a choice (its place in the list), a font or a sound (0 for none,
	             twice its place in ThemeSchema.LISTED, or twice an asset number plus one), an asset
	  1 colour   three bytes
	  2 bytes    a varint length, then: a text, an asset list (count, first id, zigzag deltas: a
	             batch upload's ids lie close), panel placements, property layouts
	  3 true, 4 false
	A record whose id this build does not know is skipped by its wire, so an older plugin reads the
	settings it knows. A code is untrusted: decode validates every value through ThemeSchema.
]]

local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.ThemeSchema)

local ThemeCode = {}

ThemeCode.PREFIX = "PIT1."

local WIRE_VARINT, WIRE_COLOR, WIRE_BYTES, WIRE_TRUE, WIRE_FALSE = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4

local function newWriter()
	return { bytes = {} }
end

local function writeByte(writer, value)
	table.insert(writer.bytes, value)
end

-- An unsigned whole number in 7-bit groups, low first (exact up to 2^53, the asset ids' range).
local function writeVarint(writer, value)
	repeat
		local low = value % 128
		value = (value - low) / 128
		writeByte(writer, value > 0 and (low + 128) or low)
	until value == 0
end

local function zigzag(value)
	return value >= 0 and value * 2 or -value * 2 - 1
end

local function writeString(writer, text)
	writeVarint(writer, #text)
	for index = 1, #text do
		writeByte(writer, string.byte(text, index))
	end
end

local function assetNumber(id)
	return tonumber(string.match(id, "(%d+)$")) or 0
end

-- A reader that runs past its end stops every later read (`failed`).

local function newReader(bytes, first, last)
	return { bytes = bytes, at = first or 1, last = last or #bytes, failed = false }
end

local function readByte(reader)
	if reader.at > reader.last then
		reader.failed = true
		return 0
	end
	local value = reader.bytes[reader.at]
	reader.at += 1
	return value
end

local function readVarint(reader)
	local value, scale = 0, 1
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local byte = readByte(reader)
		value += (byte % 128) * scale
		if byte < 128 then
			return value
		end
		scale *= 128
	end
	reader.failed = true
	return 0
end

local function unzigzag(value)
	return value % 2 == 0 and value / 2 or -(value + 1) / 2
end

local function readString(reader)
	local length = readVarint(reader)
	if length > reader.last - reader.at + 1 then
		reader.failed = true
		return ""
	end
	local chars = table.create(length)
	for index = 1, length do
		chars[index] = string.char(readByte(reader))
	end
	return table.concat(chars)
end

local function sortedKeys(map)
	local keys = {}
	for key in pairs(map) do
		table.insert(keys, key)
	end
	table.sort(keys)
	return keys
end

local PAYLOADS = {}

PAYLOADS.text = {
	write = function(writer, value)
		for index = 1, #value do
			writeByte(writer, string.byte(value, index))
		end
	end,
	read = function(reader)
		local chars = {}
		while reader.at <= reader.last do
			table.insert(chars, string.char(readByte(reader)))
		end
		return table.concat(chars)
	end,
}

PAYLOADS.assets = {
	write = function(writer, list)
		writeVarint(writer, #list)
		local previous = 0
		for index, id in ipairs(list) do
			local number = assetNumber(id)
			if index == 1 then
				writeVarint(writer, number)
			else
				writeVarint(writer, zigzag(number - previous))
			end
			previous = number
		end
	end,
	read = function(reader)
		local list, previous = {}, 0
		local count = readVarint(reader)
		for index = 1, math.min(count, 256) do
			local number = index == 1 and readVarint(reader) or previous + unzigzag(readVarint(reader))
			previous = number
			table.insert(list, "rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%d", number))
		end
		return list
	end,
}

PAYLOADS.placements = {
	write = function(writer, map)
		local keys = sortedKeys(map)
		writeVarint(writer, #keys)
		for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
			local place = map[key]
			writeString(writer, key)
			writeVarint(writer, zigzag(place.x))
			writeVarint(writer, zigzag(place.y))
			writeVarint(writer, place.w)
			writeVarint(writer, place.h)
		end
	end,
	read = function(reader)
		local map = {}
		for _ = 1, math.min(readVarint(reader), 64) do
			local key = readString(reader)
			map[key] = {
				x = unzigzag(readVarint(reader)), y = unzigzag(readVarint(reader)),
				w = readVarint(reader), h = readVarint(reader),
			}
		end
		return map
	end,
}

local LAYOUT_LISTS = { "order", "hidden", "pinned" }
PAYLOADS.propertyLayouts = {
	write = function(writer, map)
		local keys = sortedKeys(map)
		writeVarint(writer, #keys)
		for _, typeName in ipairs(keys) do
			writeString(writer, typeName)
			for _, listName in ipairs(LAYOUT_LISTS) do
				local list = map[typeName][listName] or {}
				writeVarint(writer, #list)
				for _, name in ipairs(list) do
					writeString(writer, name)
				end
			end
		end
	end,
	read = function(reader)
		local map = {}
		for _ = 1, math.min(readVarint(reader), 64) do
			local layout = {}
			local typeName = readString(reader)
			for _, listName in ipairs(LAYOUT_LISTS) do
				local count = readVarint(reader)
				if count > 0 then
					layout[listName] = {}
					for _ = 1, math.min(count, 128) do
						table.insert(layout[listName], readString(reader))
					end
				end
			end
			map[typeName] = layout
		end
		return map
	end,
}

local function wireOf(entry, value)
	local kind = entry.kind
	if kind == "toggle" then
		return value and WIRE_TRUE or WIRE_FALSE
	elseif kind == "color" then
		return WIRE_COLOR
	elseif kind == "number" or kind == "choice" or ThemeSchema.LISTED[kind] or kind == "asset" then
		return WIRE_VARINT
	end
	return WIRE_BYTES
end

local function writeValue(writer, entry, value)
	local kind = entry.kind
	if kind == "number" then
		writeVarint(writer, zigzag(value))
	elseif kind == "choice" then
		writeVarint(writer, table.find(entry.choices, value) - 1)
	elseif ThemeSchema.LISTED[kind] then
		local place = table.find(ThemeSchema.LISTED[kind], value)
		if value == "" then
			writeVarint(writer, 0)
		else
			writeVarint(writer, place and place * 2 or assetNumber(value) * 2 + 1)
		end
	elseif kind == "asset" then
		writeVarint(writer, value == "" and 0 or assetNumber(value))
	elseif kind == "color" then
		for offset = 2, 6, 2 do
			writeByte(writer, tonumber(string.sub(value, offset, offset + 1), 16))
		end
	elseif kind ~= "toggle" then
		local inner = newWriter()
		PAYLOADS[kind].write(inner, value)
		writeVarint(writer, #inner.bytes)
		for _, byte in ipairs(inner.bytes) do
			writeByte(writer, byte)
		end
	end
end

-- The value a record holds as its entry's kind takes it; nil when the wire does not fit the kind.
local function readValue(reader, entry, wire)
	local kind = entry and entry.kind
	if wire == WIRE_TRUE or wire == WIRE_FALSE then
		if kind ~= "toggle" then
			return nil
		end
		return wire == WIRE_TRUE
	elseif wire == WIRE_COLOR then
		local r, g, b = readByte(reader), readByte(reader), readByte(reader)
		return kind == "color" and string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", r, g, b) or nil
	elseif wire == WIRE_VARINT then
		local number = readVarint(reader)
		if kind == "number" then
			return unzigzag(number)
		elseif kind == "choice" then
			return entry.choices[number + 1]
		elseif kind and ThemeSchema.LISTED[kind] then
			if number == 0 then
				return ""
			elseif number % 2 == 0 then
				return ThemeSchema.LISTED[kind][number // 2]
			end
			return "rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%d", number // 2)
		elseif kind == "asset" then
			return number == 0 and "" or ("rbxassetid://" .. string.format("%d", number))
		end
		return nil
	elseif wire == WIRE_BYTES then
		local length = readVarint(reader)
		local first = reader.at
		local last = first + length - 1
		if last > reader.last then
			reader.failed = true
			return nil
		end
		reader.at = last + 1
		local payload = kind and PAYLOADS[kind]
		if not payload then
			return nil
		end
		local inner = newReader(reader.bytes, first, last)
		local value = payload.read(inner)
		return not inner.failed and value or nil
	end
	reader.failed = true
	return nil
end

-- Base64url without padding: letters, digits, - and _ (nothing Discord formats).

local ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_"
local DIGIT_OF = {}
for index = 1, 64 do
	DIGIT_OF[string.byte(ALPHABET, index)] = index - 1
end

local function toBase64(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for index = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local a, b, c = bytes[index], bytes[index + 1] or 0, bytes[index + 2] or 0
		local group = a * 65536 + b * 256 + c
		local count = math.min(#bytes - index + 1, 3) + 1
		for digit = 1, count do
			local value = math.floor(group / 64 ^ (4 - digit)) % 64
			table.insert(out, string.sub(ALPHABET, value + 1, value + 1))
		end
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function fromBase64(text)
	local bytes = {}
	local group, count = 0, 0
	for index = 1, #text do
		local value = DIGIT_OF[string.byte(text, index)]
		if value == nil then
			return nil
		end
		group = group * 64 + value
		count += 1
		if count == 4 then
			table.insert(bytes, math.floor(group / 65536) % 256)
			table.insert(bytes, math.floor(group / 256) % 256)
			table.insert(bytes, group % 256)
			group, count = 0, 0
		end
	end
	if count == 1 then
		return nil
	elseif count == 2 then
		table.insert(bytes, math.floor(group / 16) % 256)
	elseif count == 3 then
		table.insert(bytes, math.floor(group / 1024) % 256)
		table.insert(bytes, math.floor(group / 4) % 256)
	end
	return bytes
end

function ThemeCode.encode(doc)
	local clean = ThemeSchema.clean(doc)
	local present = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(ThemeSchema.ENTRIES) do
		local value = ThemeSchema.get(clean, entry.path)
		if value ~= nil then
			table.insert(present, { entry = entry, value = value })
		end
	end
	table.sort(present, function(first, second)
		return first.entry.id < second.entry.id
	end)
	local writer = newWriter()
	local previous = 0
	for _, record in ipairs(present) do
		writeVarint(writer, (record.entry.id - previous) * 8 + wireOf(record.entry, record.value))
		writeValue(writer, record.entry, record.value)
		previous = record.entry.id
	end
	return ThemeCode.PREFIX .. toBase64(writer.bytes)
end

function ThemeCode.decode(text)
	if type(text) ~= "string" then
		return nil, "not a theme code"
	end
	local body = string.match(text, "^%s*" .. string.gsub(ThemeCode.PREFIX, "%.", "%%.") .. "([%w%-_]*)%s*$")
	if not body then
		return nil, "not a theme code"
	end
	local bytes = fromBase64(body)
	if not bytes then
		return nil, "the code is damaged"
	end
	local reader = newReader(bytes)
	local doc = {}
	local id = 0
	while reader.at <= reader.last and not reader.failed do
		local key = readVarint(reader)
		id += math.floor(key / 8)
		local entry = ThemeSchema.byId[id]
		local value = readValue(reader, entry, key % 8)
		if entry and value ~= nil then
			ThemeSchema.set(doc, entry.path, value)
		end
	end
	if reader.failed then
		return nil, "the code is damaged"
	end
	return ThemeSchema.clean(doc)
end

return ThemeCode
