--[[
	ThemeEditor  -  the Theme Editor's panel outside Classic: parts on the left, the chosen part's page
	on the right, a theme code row and Reset / Try on UI / Cancel / Apply. ThemeWiring fills the parts
	and pages (Rows) and drives it; Catalogue says what goes where. Its Preview is
	ThemeEditor/Showcase, built apart from the UI by ThemeWiring.
	Returns build(screenGui) -> refs (merged into the UI's refs, hence the Theme prefixes):
	  ThemeEditor, ThemePreviewButton, ThemeInvertButton, ThemePickButton, ThemeCloseButton,
	  ModeDropdown, ModeOnChanged, the Hue row (ThemeHueStrip, ThemeHueRamp, ThemeHueHandle,
	  ThemeHueCatcher, ThemeHueBox, ThemeHueReset), ThemeBaseDropdown / ThemeBaseOnChanged ("Based
	  on", in Custom), ThemePresetDropdown / ThemePresetOnChanged (other modes), TextSizeDropdown,
	  TextSizeOnChanged, ThemeNameBox, ThemePartsList, ThemePage, ThemeCodeBox, CopyTheme,
	  ImportTheme, ThemeNotice, ResetTheme, TryTheme, CancelTheme, ApplyTheme
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local ThemeModes = require(script.Parent.ThemeModes)
local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.ThemeSchema)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Width of the code row's two buttons.
local CODE_BUTTON = 76

-- A scrolling column of rows, its scroll bar themed.
local function column(parent, name)
	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = name
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scroll.Parent = parent
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, scroll)
	W.addListLayout(scroll, 2)
	W.addPadding(scroll, 0, 8, 2, 8)
	return scroll
end

-- A header label in `frame` and the frame its control fills beside it.
local function labelledSlot(frame, labelText)
	local function labelWidth()
		return math.floor(PanelSizes.get().ThemeEditorLabel * 0.7)
	end
	W.makeRowLabel(frame, labelText, labelWidth)
	local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
	slot.Name = "Slot"
	slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.layProps(slot, function()
		local left = labelWidth() + LAYOUT.LabelGap
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -left, 1, 0) }
	end)
	slot.Parent = frame
	return slot
end

-- Half a header row: a label and the frame its control fills.
local function half(row, side, labelText)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = labelText:gsub("%s+", "")
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.layProps(frame, function()
		return {
			Position = UDim2.new(side == 1 and 0 or 0.5, side == 1 and 0 or LAYOUT.LabelGap, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -LAYOUT.LabelGap, 1, 0),
		}
	end)
	frame.Parent = row
	return labelledSlot(frame, labelText)
end

local function dropdownIn(slot, name, options, current)
	local label, wrap, onChanged = W.makeDropdown(name, slot, options, current)
	wrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	return label, onChanged
end

local function buildTitleBar(panel, refs)
	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, "Theme Editor", 0)
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)
	refs.ThemeCloseButton = bar.close
	local tools = Instance.new("Frame")
	tools.Name = "Tools"
	tools.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tools.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	W.layProps(tools, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.IconSlot + LAYOUT.LabelGap), 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row - 6) }
	end)
	tools.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	tools.ZIndex = 3
	tools.Parent = bar.header
	W.addListLayout(tools, "LabelGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	-- Preview Edits: a segment, lit while the Preview is open, so it reads as the editor's switch.
	local previewStrip = W.makeSegmentStrip(tools, "PreviewEdits")
	previewStrip.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	previewStrip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	previewStrip.LayoutOrder = 0
	refs.ThemePreviewButton = W.makeSegment(previewStrip, "Toggle", "Preview Edits", 1)
	refs.ThemeInvertButton = W.makeTextButton(tools, "Invert", "Invert", 1, "TextSecondary")
	refs.ThemePickButton = W.makeTextButton(tools, "Pick", "Pick", 2, "TextSecondary")
	bar.title.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	bar.dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
end

-- Mode and its second choice ("Based on" in Custom, else "Preset"), text size and name. Both second
-- choices are made and the mode shows one, so a mode change needs no rebuild.
local function buildHeader(panel, refs)
	local first = W.makeRowFrame(panel, "HeaderModes", 1)
	refs.ModeDropdown, refs.ModeOnChanged = dropdownIn(half(first, 1, "Mode"), "Mode", ThemeModes.ORDER, T.Mode)
	local baseSlot = half(first, 2, "Based on")
	refs.ThemeBaseDropdown, refs.ThemeBaseOnChanged = dropdownIn(baseSlot, "Base", ThemeSchema.BASES, C.MODE.Base or ThemeModes.DEFAULT)
	local presetNames = { "Custom" }
	for _, preset in ipairs(C.THEME_PRESETS) do
		table.insert(presetNames, preset.name)
	end
	local presetSlot = half(first, 2, "Preset")
	refs.ThemePresetDropdown, refs.ThemePresetOnChanged = dropdownIn(presetSlot, "Preset", presetNames, "Custom")
	W.layEach(first, function()
		local custom = C.MODE.Id == "Custom"
		baseSlot.Parent.Visible = custom
		presetSlot.Parent.Visible = not custom
	end)

	local second = W.makeRowFrame(panel, "HeaderNames", 2)
	local sizeNames = {}
	for _, size in ipairs(ThemeModes.TEXT_SIZES) do
		table.insert(sizeNames, tostring(size))
	end
	refs.TextSizeDropdown, refs.TextSizeOnChanged = dropdownIn(half(second, 1, "Text size"), "TextSize", sizeNames, tostring(T.TextSize))
	local nameBox, nameField = W.makeTextField(half(second, 2, "Name"), "Name", "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
	nameField.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	nameBox.PlaceholderText = "Untitled"
	TypeScale.style(nameBox, "Value")
	refs.ThemeNameBox = nameBox
end

-- The Hue row: a strip of the accent round the hue circle with a handle at the turn, the turn in
-- degrees, and 0° (as made). ThemeWiring paints the strip from Constants.HueBase and drives the turn.
local function buildHue(panel, refs)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(panel, "HeaderHue", 3)
	local slot = labelledSlot(row, "Hue")
	W.addListLayout(slot, "LabelGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

	local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
	strip.Name = "HueStrip"
	strip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	strip.BorderSizePixel = 0
	strip.LayoutOrder = 1
	strip:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	W.lay(strip, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row - 10)
	end)
	strip.Parent = slot
	W.addCorner(strip)
	local fill = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
	fill.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	fill.Parent = strip
	local ramp = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	ramp.Parent = strip
	local handle = W.makeMarker(strip, 10, 0, false)
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, 8)
	handle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
	local catcher = Instance.new("TextButton")
	catcher.Name = "HueInput"
	catcher.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	catcher.Text = ""
	catcher.AutoButtonColor = false
	catcher.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 8)
	catcher.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -4)
	catcher.ZIndex = 6
	catcher.Parent = strip

	local box, field = W.makeTextField(slot, "HueDegrees", "0°", Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
	field.LayoutOrder = 2
	W.lay(field, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.Text * 4 + LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2, 1, -2)
	end)
	refs.ThemeHueReset = W.makeTextButton(slot, "HueReset", "0°", 3, "TextSecondary")
	refs.ThemeHueStrip = strip
	refs.ThemeHueRamp = ramp
	refs.ThemeHueHandle = handle
	refs.ThemeHueCatcher = catcher
	refs.ThemeHueBox = box
end

-- The parts column and the page column, side by side at a fixed height (by text size).
local function buildBody(panel, refs)
	local body = Instance.new("Frame")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.lay(body, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, PanelSizes.get().ThemeEditorBody)
	end)
	body.LayoutOrder = 4
	body.Parent = panel
	local parts = column(body, "Parts")
	W.lay(parts, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, PanelSizes.get().ThemeEditorParts, 1, 0)
	end)
	local page = column(body, "Page")
	W.layProps(page, function()
		local left = PanelSizes.get().ThemeEditorParts + LAYOUT.LabelGap
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -left, 1, 0) }
	end)
	W.lay(page:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"), "Padding", function()
		return UDim.new(0, LAYOUT.RowGap)
	end)
	refs.ThemePartsList = parts
	refs.ThemePage = page
end

-- The theme code with Copy and Import, the notice under it, and Reset / Try on UI / Cancel / Apply.
local function buildFooter(panel, refs)
	local codeRow = W.makeRowFrame(panel, "Code", 6)
	local codeBox, codeField = W.makeTextField(codeRow, "ThemeCode", "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
	W.lay(codeField, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -(CODE_BUTTON + LAYOUT.LabelGap) * 2, 1, 0)
	end)
	codeBox.PlaceholderText = "Paste a theme code, or Copy this theme's"
	codeBox.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	TypeScale.style(codeBox, "Caption")
	refs.ThemeCodeBox = codeBox
	refs.CopyTheme = W.makeActionButton(codeRow, "Copy", "Copy")
	W.layProps(refs.CopyTheme, function()
		return { Size = UDim2.new(0, CODE_BUTTON, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -(CODE_BUTTON * 2 + LAYOUT.LabelGap), 0, 0) }
	end)
	refs.ImportTheme = W.makeActionButton(codeRow, "Import", "Import")
	refs.ImportTheme.Size = UDim2.new(0, CODE_BUTTON, 1, 0)
	refs.ImportTheme.Position = UDim2.new(1, -CODE_BUTTON, 0, 0)

	local notice = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	notice.Name = "Notice"
	notice.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notice.Text = ""
	notice.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	notice.TextWrapped = true
	notice.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notice.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	notice.LayoutOrder = 7
	notice.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(notice, "Caption")
	W.paint(notice, "TextColor3", "Warning")
	notice.Parent = panel
	refs.ThemeNotice = notice

	local actions = W.makeButtonRow(panel, "Actions", {
		{ name = "Reset", text = "Reset", role = "Danger" },
		{ name = "Try", text = "Try on UI", role = "Accent" },
		{ name = "Cancel", text = "Cancel", role = "TextSecondary" },
		{ name = "Apply", text = "Apply", role = "Success" },
	}, 8)
	refs.ResetTheme = actions[1]
	refs.TryTheme = actions[2]
	refs.CancelTheme = actions[3]
	refs.ApplyTheme = actions[4]
end

return function(screenGui)
	local refs = {}
	local panel = W.makePanel(screenGui, "ThemeEditor", PanelSizes.of("ThemeEditor"))
	W.lay(panel, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(0.5, -PanelSizes.get().ThemeEditor / 2, 0, 24)
	end)
	panel.ZIndex = 5
	panel.Visible = false
	refs.ThemeEditor = panel
	buildTitleBar(panel, refs)
	buildHeader(panel, refs)
	buildHue(panel, refs)
	W.makeDivider(panel, 3)
	buildBody(panel, refs)
	W.makeDivider(panel, 5)
	buildFooter(panel, refs)
	return refs
end

--[[
	Catalogue  -  what the Theme Editor lists: its parts by mode, and each part's page as sections of
	ThemeSchema entries, built from the schema's own `part` and `layer` so a new setting shows where
	its entry says.
	  Catalogue.parts(mode) -> { { key, label, group, locked } }: every part in Custom; in a built-in
	    mode its own parts, then Custom's locked (greyed, to show what Custom adds)
	  Catalogue.page(key, mode) -> { title, note, sections = { { key, title, toggle, follows, entries } } }
	    or nil for a part the mode does not list. `toggle`: the section's `.on` entry for a layer that
	    can be off; `follows`: the `.on` entry it shows only with (an image's animation, its image)
	  Catalogue.partOfSurface(surface) -> the part a Skin surface is edited under (Pick)
	  Catalogue.rebuilds(entry) -> whether a change changes which widgets exist, so only a rebuild
	    previews it; the rest, sizes and structure included, preview live (Relayout)
	  Catalogue.label(entry) -> its label in words ("TitleBarFill" -> "Title bar fill")
	Not listed while nothing reads them: the Studio theme, a label above its value, value alignment,
	per-type property layouts and panel placements; nor a setting its surface does not use (UNUSED).
]]

local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.ThemeSchema)

local Catalogue = {}

local NOT_YET = {
	["custom.structure.LabelPosition"] = true,
	["custom.structure.ValueAlign"] = true,
	["custom.layouts.properties"] = true,
	["custom.layouts.panels"] = true,
}
-- Settings a surface has but does not use: a panel's and a scroll bar's image hold no text
-- (Skin colours the text on title bars, fields and buttons).
local UNUSED = {
	["custom.surfaces.panel.image.textColor"] = true,
	["custom.surfaces.scrollBar.image.textColor"] = true,
}

local SURFACE_LABELS = {
	panel = { "Panel", "every panel" },
	titleBar = { "Title bar", "the bar atop a panel" },
	field = { "Field", "inputs and dropdowns" },
	button = { "Button", "also lit segments and the selected tab" },
	toggle = { "Toggle", "switches" },
	scrollBar = { "Scroll bar", "a list's scroll bar" },
}

-- Colour roles by what they paint, for the Custom Colours page.
local ROLE_GROUPS = {
	-- "Backgrounds", not "Surfaces": that word names the parts list's group of layered surfaces.
	{ "Backgrounds", { "Panel", "Header", "Band", "Field", "FieldHover", "Selected", "Sunken" } },
	{ "Text", { "TextPrimary", "TextHeading", "TextLabel", "TextSecondary", "TextDisabled" } },
	{ "Lines", { "Outline", "OutlineHover", "Focus", "Divider", "Rule", "PanelStroke" } },
	{ "Accent", { "Accent", "OnAccent", "ToggleOn", "ToggleOff", "KnobOn", "KnobOff", "SliderFill", "ScrollBar" } },
	{ "Status", { "Success", "Warning", "Danger" } },
}

local LAYER_TITLES = { fill = "Fill", image = "Image", gradient = "Gradient", shadow = "Shadow", outline = "Outline", corner = "Corner" }

function Catalogue.label(entry)
	local label = entry.label or entry.path
	if string.find(label, " ") or not string.find(label, "%u%l+%u") then
		return label
	end
	local words = string.gsub(label, "(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2")
	return string.sub(words, 1, 1) .. string.lower(string.sub(words, 2))
end

local function listed(entry)
	return not NOT_YET[entry.path] and not UNUSED[entry.path]
end

-- The entries whose path starts with `prefix`, in schema order.
local function under(prefix)
	local out = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(ThemeSchema.ENTRIES) do
		if string.sub(entry.path, 1, #prefix) == prefix and listed(entry) then
			table.insert(out, entry)
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- The entries of a part (and layer, when given), in schema order.
local function ofPart(part, layer, scope)
	local out = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(ThemeSchema.ENTRIES) do
		if entry.part == part and (layer == nil or entry.layer == layer) and (scope == nil or entry.scope == scope) and listed(entry) then
			table.insert(out, entry)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function byPaths(paths)
	local out = {}
	for _, path in ipairs(paths) do
		table.insert(out, ThemeSchema.byPath[path])
	end
	return out
end

local function surfacePage(surface)
	local labels = SURFACE_LABELS[surface]
	local sections = {}
	for _, layer in ipairs(ThemeSchema.SURFACE_LAYERS[surface]) do
		local prefix = "custom.surfaces." .. surface .. "." .. layer .. "."
		local entries = {}
		local animation = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(under(prefix)) do
			if entry.path ~= prefix .. "on" then
				if string.find(entry.path, "%.anim%.") then
					table.insert(animation, entry)
				else
					table.insert(entries, entry)
				end
			end
		end
		local toggle = ThemeSchema.byPath[prefix .. "on"]
		table.insert(sections, { key = layer, title = LAYER_TITLES[layer], toggle = toggle, entries = entries })
		if #animation > 0 then
			table.insert(sections, { key = layer .. ".anim", title = "Image animation", follows = toggle, entries = animation })
		end
	end
	return { title = labels[1], note = labels[2], sections = sections }
end

local PAGES = {}

function PAGES.Colours(mode)
	local sections = { { key = "base", title = "Base colours", entries = ofPart("Colours", "Base") } }
	if mode ~= "Custom" then
		return { title = "Colours", note = "the mode works out every other colour from these", sections = sections }
	end
	for _, group in ipairs(ROLE_GROUPS) do
		local paths = {}
		for _, role in ipairs(group[2]) do
			table.insert(paths, "custom.roles." .. role)
		end
		table.insert(sections, { key = "roles." .. group[1], title = group[1], entries = byPaths(paths) })
	end
	return { title = "Colours", note = "a role left empty follows the base colours", sections = sections }
end

function PAGES.Fonts(mode)
	local title = { key = "title", title = "Title font", entries = { ThemeSchema.byPath.font } }
	if mode ~= "Custom" then
		return { title = "Title font", note = "panel titles and type names", sections = { title } }
	end
	-- The Text part's Custom entries other than the fonts by role: families, weights, sizes.
	local families = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(ofPart("Text", nil, "custom")) do
		if string.sub(entry.path, 1, 13) ~= "custom.fonts." then
			table.insert(families, entry)
		end
	end
	return { title = "Fonts", note = "a role left empty uses the body font", sections = {
		title,
		{ key = "roles", title = "Fonts by role", entries = under("custom.fonts.") },
		{ key = "families", title = "Families, weights and sizes", entries = families },
	} }
end

function PAGES.Background()
	return { title = "Background", note = "behind every panel", sections = {
		{ key = "image", title = "Image", entries = ofPart("Background", "Image") },
		{ key = "animation", title = "Animation", entries = ofPart("Background", "Animation") },
	} }
end

function PAGES.Shape()
	return { title = "Shape", note = "corners, outlines and switches", sections = {
		{ key = "shape", title = "Shape", entries = ofPart("Shape") },
	} }
end

function PAGES.Motion()
	return { title = "Motion", note = "how the UI moves", sections = {
		{ key = "motion", title = "Motion", entries = ofPart("Motion") },
	} }
end

function PAGES.Sound()
	local entries = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(ofPart("Sound")) do
		if entry.path ~= "sound.on" then
			table.insert(entries, entry)
		end
	end
	return { title = "Sound", note = "Studio's own sounds load for anyone", sections = {
		{ key = "sound", title = "Sounds", toggle = ThemeSchema.byPath["sound.on"], entries = entries },
	} }
end

function PAGES.Layouts()
	return { title = "Layouts", note = "rows and spacing; per-type layouts come later", sections = {
		{ key = "rows", title = "Rows", entries = ofPart("Layouts") },
	} }
end

local CURATED = {
	{ key = "Colours", label = "Colours" },
	{ key = "Fonts", label = "Title font" },
	{ key = "Background", label = "Background" },
	{ key = "Motion", label = "Motion" },
	{ key = "Sound", label = "Sound" },
}
local CUSTOM_ONLY = { "Surfaces", "Fonts per role", "Shape", "Layouts" }

function Catalogue.parts(mode)
	local out = {}
	if mode ~= "Custom" then
		for _, part in ipairs(CURATED) do
			table.insert(out, { key = part.key, label = part.label })
		end
		for _, label in ipairs(CUSTOM_ONLY) do
			table.insert(out, { key = nil, label = label, group = "In Custom", locked = true })
		end
		return out
	end
	table.insert(out, { key = "Colours", label = "Colours" })
	table.insert(out, { key = "Fonts", label = "Fonts" })
	table.insert(out, { key = "Background", label = "Background" })
	for _, surface in ipairs(ThemeSchema.SURFACES) do
		table.insert(out, { key = "surface:" .. surface, label = SURFACE_LABELS[surface][1], group = "Surfaces" })
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Shape", "Motion", "Sound", "Layouts" }) do
		table.insert(out, { key = key, label = key })
	end
	return out
end

-- A page exists only for a part the mode lists open: a built-in mode has no surface pages.
function Catalogue.page(key, mode)
	local listed = false
	for _, part in ipairs(Catalogue.parts(mode)) do
		listed = listed or (part.key ~= nil and part.key == key)
	end
	if not listed then
		return nil
	end
	local surface = string.match(key, "^surface:(.+)$")
	if surface then
		return surfacePage(surface)
	end
	local build = PAGES[key]
	return build and build(mode) or nil
end

function Catalogue.partOfSurface(surface)
	return "surface:" .. surface
end

-- Rows moved between sections and panels placed: which widgets exist, so only a rebuild shows them.
local REBUILD_PREFIXES = { "custom.layouts." }

function Catalogue.rebuilds(entry)
	for _, prefix in ipairs(REBUILD_PREFIXES) do
		if string.sub(entry.path, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

return Catalogue

--[[
	Pick  -  the Theme Editor's Pick: the next press on the plugin's UI opens the part that edits what
	was pressed. While picking, a clear layer over the UI follows the pointer: the widget under it is
	outlined and its part named; a press picks it, Escape or the right button gives up.
	  Pick.widgetAt(themed, point) -> inst, surface   the smallest shown registered widget (Skin's
	      surfaces) under a screen point, or nil
	  Pick.start(screenGui, themed, options)   options: { partOf(surface) -> key, label(key) -> text,
	      onPicked(key), onDone() }; onDone runs however the picking ends
	  Pick.stop()
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local Skin = require(script.Parent.Parent.Skin)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T

local Pick = {}

-- Above every panel and menu of the plugin.
local LAYER_Z = 1000

local active = nil

-- Whether the widget and every ancestor up to its ScreenGui are visible.
local function shown(inst)
	local node = inst
	while node and not node:IsA("LayerCollector") do
		if node:IsA("GuiObject") and not node.Visible then
			return false
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return node ~= nil
end

-- The part of a widget its surface draws: a scrolling list is registered as a scroll bar, whose
-- bar is the strip at its right edge; any other widget, all of it.
local function rectOf(inst, surface)
	local position, size = inst.AbsolutePosition, inst.AbsoluteSize
	if surface == "scrollBar" and inst:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		local bar = math.max(inst.ScrollBarThickness, 4)
		return Vector2.new(position.X + size.X - bar, position.Y), Vector2.new(bar, size.Y)
	end
	return position, size
end

function Pick.widgetAt(themed, point)
	local best, bestSurface, bestArea = nil, nil, math.huge
	Skin.eachSurface(themed, function(inst, surface)
		if not (inst.Parent and inst:IsA("GuiObject")) then
			return
		end
		local position, size = rectOf(inst, surface)
		if point.X >= position.X and point.Y >= position.Y and point.X < position.X + size.X and point.Y < position.Y + size.Y then
			local area = size.X * size.Y
			if area < bestArea and shown(inst) then
				best, bestSurface, bestArea = inst, surface, area
			end
		end
	end)
	return best, bestSurface
end

function Pick.stop()
	if not active then
		return
	end
	local done = active.onDone
	for _, connection in ipairs(active.connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	active.layer:Destroy()
	active = nil
	if done then
		done()
	end
end

function Pick.start(screenGui, themed, options)
	Pick.stop()
	-- Screen pixels to the UI's units (the ScreenGui's UIScale), for the outline's place.
	local uiScale = screenGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	local scale = uiScale and uiScale.Scale or 1

	local layer = Instance.new("TextButton")
	layer.Name = "_ThemePick"
	layer.Text = ""
	layer.AutoButtonColor = false
	layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	layer.Size = UDim2.new(1 / scale, 0, 1 / scale, 0)
	layer.ZIndex = LAYER_Z
	layer.Parent = screenGui

	local outline = Instance.new("Frame")
	outline.Name = "Outline"
	outline.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	outline.Visible = false
	outline.ZIndex = LAYER_Z + 1
	outline.Parent = layer
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = T.Focus
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = outline

	local tag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tag.Name = "Tag"
	tag.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
	tag.BackgroundColor3 = T.Focus
	tag.TextColor3 = T.OnAccent
	tag.ZIndex = LAYER_Z + 2
	tag.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(tag, "Caption")
	tag.Parent = layer
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
	padding.Parent = tag

	active = { layer = layer, onDone = options.onDone, connections = {} }
	local current = nil

	local function follow(point)
		local inst, surface = Pick.widgetAt(themed, point)
		current = surface and options.partOf(surface) or nil
		outline.Visible = inst ~= nil
		tag.Visible = inst ~= nil
		if inst then
			local position, size = rectOf(inst, surface)
			outline.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X / scale, position.Y / scale)
			outline.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X / scale, size.Y / scale)
			tag.Text = options.label(current)
			tag.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X / scale, position.Y / scale - 18)
		end
	end

	local connections = active.connections
	table.insert(connections, layer.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			follow(Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections, layer.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			follow(Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
			local picked = current
			Pick.stop()
			if picked then
				options.onPicked(picked)
			end
		elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			Pick.stop()
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			Pick.stop()
		end
	end))
end

return Pick

--[[
	Rows  -  the Theme Editor's rows: a part in the parts list, a section of a page (a layer with its
	tick, open or closed) and a setting by its ThemeSchema kind, bound to the editor's draft.
	  Rows.part(list, part, selected, order) -> button (a locked part is a greyed label: nil)
	  Rows.pageHeading(page, title, note)
	  Rows.section(page, section, order, opened, ticked, onTick, onOpen) -> body
	  Rows.setting(body, entry, order, binding)
	binding: { get() -> the stored value or nil, shown() -> what shows while nothing is stored,
	           set(value) (nil clears a setting whose default is the mode's), pickColor(color, onPicked) }
	A short list of choices is a segment strip, a long one a dropdown; a font or a sound is a
	dropdown of names beside a box for an asset id.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.PanelSizes)
local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.ThemeSchema)
local Catalogue = require(script.Parent.Catalogue)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local Rows = {}

local SWATCH = 20
-- Width of a section's chevron, as the Properties panel's sections draw it.
local CHEVRON = 14
-- A choice list this short, of words this short, is a segment strip.
local SEGMENT_CHOICES, SEGMENT_LETTERS = 5, 9
-- A part's text inset in the parts list (a segment's own padding), and the extra for grouped parts.
local PART_INSET, GROUP_INDENT = 6, 14
-- What an unset setting shows: the dropdown entry that clears a font or sound, an optional colour's
-- placeholder.
local UNSET = "(none)"

-- Where a row's value starts, past its label (it follows the layout, as everything placed from it).
local function valueOffset()
	return PanelSizes.get().ThemeEditorLabel + LAYOUT.LabelGap
end

local function labelled(body, entry, order)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(body, entry.path, order)
	W.makeRowLabel(row, Catalogue.label(entry), PanelSizes.of("ThemeEditorLabel"))
	return row
end

local function fillFrom(control, from)
	W.layProps(control, function()
		local left = from()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -left, 1, 0) }
	end)
end

local function fieldIn(row, name, text, alignment, from)
	local box, field = W.makeTextField(row, name, text, alignment)
	fillFrom(field, from)
	return box, field
end

function Rows.part(list, part, selected, order)
	if part.locked then
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Locked"
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = part.label
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		W.lay(label, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		end)
		label.LayoutOrder = order
		TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
		W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextDisabled")
		label.Parent = list
		W.addPadding(label, PART_INSET + (part.group and GROUP_INDENT or 0), PART_INSET, 0, 0)
		return nil
	end
	local button = W.makeSegment(list, "Part" .. order, part.label, order)
	button.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	W.lay(button, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
	end)
	button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	-- The segment's own padding moves in: a second UIPadding on one object is ignored.
	if part.group then
		button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding").PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, PART_INSET + GROUP_INDENT)
	end
	W.paintSegment(button, selected)
	return button
end

-- A group heading in the parts list: a caption and a rule to the edge, so it reads as a heading.
function Rows.group(list, text, order)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "Group"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.lay(row, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row - 6)
	end)
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	row.Parent = list
	W.addPadding(row, PART_INSET, PART_INSET, 0, 0)
	local layout = W.addListLayout(row, "LabelGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Title"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	label.LayoutOrder = 1
	TypeScale.style(label, "Caption")
	W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	label.Parent = row
	local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
	rule.Name = "Rule"
	rule.BorderSizePixel = 0
	rule.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
	rule.LayoutOrder = 2
	W.paint(rule, "BackgroundColor3", "Divider")
	rule.Parent = row
	local fill = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
	fill.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	fill.Parent = rule
end

function Rows.pageHeading(page, title, note)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(page, "Heading", 0)
	local heading = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	heading.Name = "Title"
	heading.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	heading.Text = title
	heading.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	heading.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(heading, "Type")
	W.paint(heading, "TextColor3", "TextHeading")
	heading.Parent = row
	local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hint.Name = "Note"
	hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hint.Text = note or ""
	hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	hint.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	hint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	hint.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	hint.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(hint, "Caption")
	W.paint(hint, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	hint.Parent = row
end

-- A section: its tick (a layer that can be off), title and opening chevron; returns its body.
function Rows.section(page, section, order, opened, ticked, onTick, onOpen)
	local header = W.makeRowFrame(page, "Section_" .. section.key, order)
	local tick = nil
	if section.toggle then
		tick = W.makeToggle("Tick", header, false)
		tick.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		tick.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		tick:SetAttribute("IsOn", ticked == true)
		tick:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
			onTick(tick:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true)
		end)
	end
	local opener = Instance.new("TextButton")
	opener.Name = "Opener"
	opener.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	opener.AutoButtonColor = false
	opener.Text = section.title
	opener.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	fillFrom(opener, function()
		return tick and tick.Size.X.Offset + LAYOUT.LabelGap or 0
	end)
	TypeScale.style(opener, "Group")
	W.paint(opener, "TextColor3", (section.toggle and not ticked) and "TextSecondary" or "TextHeading")
	opener.Parent = header
	W.addPadding(opener, CHEVRON + 4, 0, 0, 0)
	opener.Activated:Connect(onOpen)
	-- The arrow keeps "▼" / "▶" as its state; attachChevron draws the line chevron over it.
	local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	arrow.Name = "Arrow"
	arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.Text = opened and "▼" or "▶"
	arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, -(CHEVRON + 4), 0, 0)
	arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, CHEVRON, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(arrow, "Chevron")
	arrow.Parent = opener
	W.attachChevron(arrow)

	local body = Instance.new("Frame")
	body.Name = "Body_" .. section.key
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	body.LayoutOrder = order + 0.5
	body.Visible = opened
	body.Parent = page
	W.addListLayout(body, "RowGap")
	W.addPadding(body, 12, 0, 0, 6)
	return body
end

local function colorRow(body, entry, order, binding)
	local row = labelled(body, entry, order)
	local stored = binding.get()
	-- An optional colour left unset (an image's text colour) shows as none, not as white.
	local shownHex = stored or binding.shown()
	local swatch = Instance.new("TextButton")
	swatch.Name = "Swatch"
	swatch.Text = ""
	swatch.AutoButtonColor = false
	swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
	swatch.BackgroundColor3 = C.hexToColor3(shownHex or "#FFFFFF") or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	swatch.BackgroundTransparency = shownHex and 0 or 1
	swatch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	W.lay(swatch, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, valueOffset(), 0.5, 0)
	end)
	swatch.Size = UDim2.new(0, SWATCH, 0, SWATCH)
	-- A user colour: the theme's colour-matching pass must not repaint it.
	swatch:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	swatch.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(swatch)
	W.addStroke(swatch)
	local box = fieldIn(row, "Hex", stored or "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, function()
		return valueOffset() + SWATCH + LAYOUT.LabelGap
	end)
	box.PlaceholderText = stored and "" or (shownHex or UNSET)
	local function commit(hex)
		binding.set(hex)
		local now = hex or binding.shown()
		box.Text = hex or ""
		box.PlaceholderText = hex and "" or (now or UNSET)
		swatch.BackgroundColor3 = C.hexToColor3(now or "#FFFFFF") or swatch.BackgroundColor3
		swatch.BackgroundTransparency = now and 0 or 1
	end
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local text = string.upper((box.Text:gsub("%s", "")))
		if text == "" and entry.default == nil then
			commit(nil)
			return
		end
		if string.sub(text, 1, 1) ~= "#" then
			text = "#" .. text
		end
		if C.hexToColor3(text) then
			commit(text)
		else
			box.Text = binding.get() or ""
		end
	end)
	swatch.Activated:Connect(function()
		binding.pickColor(swatch.BackgroundColor3, function(color)
			commit(C.color3ToHex(color))
		end)
	end)
end

local function numberRow(body, entry, order, binding)
	local row = labelled(body, entry, order)
	local stored = binding.get()
	local box = fieldIn(row, "Number", stored ~= nil and tostring(stored) or "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, valueOffset)
	box.PlaceholderText = stored == nil and tostring(binding.shown() or "") or ""
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local number = tonumber(box.Text)
		if box.Text == "" and entry.default == nil then
			binding.set(nil)
		elseif number then
			binding.set(number)
		end
		local now = binding.get()
		box.Text = now ~= nil and tostring(now) or ""
	end)
end

local function choiceRow(body, entry, order, binding)
	local row = labelled(body, entry, order)
	local names = {}
	local longest = 0
	for _, choice in ipairs(entry.choices) do
		table.insert(names, tostring(choice))
		longest = math.max(longest, #tostring(choice))
	end
	local current = binding.get()
	if current == nil then
		current = binding.shown()
	end
	local function pick(name)
		for _, choice in ipairs(entry.choices) do
			if tostring(choice) == name then
				binding.set(choice)
			end
		end
	end
	if #names <= SEGMENT_CHOICES and longest <= SEGMENT_LETTERS then
		local strip = W.makeSegmentStrip(row, "Choices")
		fillFrom(strip, valueOffset)
		local segments = {}
		for index, name in ipairs(names) do
			local segment = W.makeSegment(strip, name, name, index, { fill = true })
			segments[name] = segment
			W.paintSegment(segment, name == tostring(current))
			segment.Activated:Connect(function()
				for other, button in pairs(segments) do
					W.paintSegment(button, other == name)
				end
				pick(name)
			end)
		end
		return
	end
	local _, wrap, onChanged = W.makeDropdown("Choice", row, names, tostring(current or ""))
	fillFrom(wrap, valueOffset)
	onChanged(pick)
end

local function toggleRow(body, entry, order, binding)
	local row = labelled(body, entry, order)
	local toggle = W.makeToggle("Toggle", row, true)
	toggle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
	local current = binding.get()
	if current == nil then
		current = binding.shown()
	end
	toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", current == true)
	toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
		binding.set(toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true)
	end)
end

local function textRow(body, entry, order, binding)
	local row = labelled(body, entry, order)
	local stored = binding.get()
	local text = stored
	if entry.kind == "assets" then
		text = table.concat(stored or {}, ", ")
	end
	local box = fieldIn(row, "Text", text or "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, valueOffset)
	box.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	box.PlaceholderText = entry.kind == "text" and "" or "rbxassetid://..."
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		if entry.kind == "assets" then
			local ids = {}
			for piece in string.gmatch(box.Text, "[^,%s]+") do
				table.insert(ids, piece)
			end
			binding.set(#ids > 0 and ids or nil)
			box.Text = table.concat(binding.get() or {}, ", ")
			return
		end
		binding.set(box.Text)
		box.Text = binding.get() or ""
	end)
end

local function listedRow(body, entry, order, binding)
	local row = labelled(body, entry, order)
	local names = { UNSET }
	for _, name in ipairs(ThemeSchema.offered(entry.kind)) do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	local stored = binding.get()
	local isId = type(stored) == "string" and string.find(stored, "^rbxassetid://") ~= nil
	local shown = stored
	if shown == nil or shown == "" then
		shown = UNSET
	end
	-- Three fifths of the value column for the names, the rest for an id.
	local _, wrap, onChanged = W.makeDropdown("Name", row, names, isId and UNSET or shown)
	W.layProps(wrap, function()
		local from = valueOffset()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, from, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.6, -from * 0.6 - LAYOUT.LabelGap / 2, 1, 0) }
	end)
	local box, field = W.makeTextField(row, "Id", isId and string.match(stored, "%d+") or "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
	W.layProps(field, function()
		local from = valueOffset()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0.6, from * 0.4 + LAYOUT.LabelGap / 2, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -from * 0.4 - LAYOUT.LabelGap / 2, 1, 0) }
	end)
	box.PlaceholderText = "or an id"
	onChanged(function(name)
		box.Text = ""
		if name == UNSET then
			binding.set(entry.kind == "sound" and "" or nil)
		else
			binding.set(name)
		end
	end)
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local digits = string.match(box.Text, "%d+")
		if digits then
			binding.set("rbxassetid://" .. digits)
		end
	end)
end

local BUILDERS = {
	color = colorRow,
	number = numberRow,
	choice = choiceRow,
	toggle = toggleRow,
	text = textRow,
	asset = textRow,
	assets = textRow,
	font = listedRow,
	sound = listedRow,
}

function Rows.setting(body, entry, order, binding)
	local build = BUILDERS[entry.kind]
	if build then
		build(body, entry, order, binding)
	end
end

return Rows

--[[
	Showcase  -  the Theme Editor's Preview: one of each kind of control the plugin draws, built by
	the same widget builders, so a theme is seen whole in one place. ThemeWiring draws it in the
	draft, apart from the UI (UIBuilder.buildAside). Nothing in it writes anything: a switch or a
	segment only shows its other state.
	Returns build(screenGui) -> refs: ThemePreview (the panel), ThemePreviewClose.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.PanelSizes)
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Rows of the sample list, enough that it scrolls.
local LIST_ROWS = { "Spark", "Ember", "Smoke trail", "Shockwave", "Dust ring", "Glint" }
-- The status line's words, by the role they show.
local STATUS = { { "Success", "Saved" }, { "Warning", "Unsaved changes" }, { "Danger", "Not shared" } }
-- The sample colour, a user colour the theme never repaints.
local SAMPLE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 66)

local function labelWidth()
	return PanelSizes.get().SettingsLabel
end

-- Where a row's control starts: past the label column.
local function controlLeft()
	return labelWidth() + LAYOUT.LabelGap
end

-- Lays a row's control from the label column to the row's end (it follows the layout).
local function afterLabel(control)
	W.layProps(control, function()
		local offset = controlLeft()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, offset, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 1, 0) }
	end)
end

local function dropdownRow(body, name, labelText, options, current, order)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(body, name, order)
	W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, labelWidth)
	local _, wrap = W.makeDropdown(name, row, options, current)
	afterLabel(wrap)
end

local function switchRow(body, name, labelText, on, order)
	local toggle = W.makeSwitchRow(body, name, labelText, order)
	toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", on)
end

-- A segment strip with one segment lit; a press lights another.
local function segmentRow(body, labelText, names, lit, order)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(body, "Segments", order)
	W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, labelWidth)
	local strip = W.makeSegmentStrip(row, "Choices")
	afterLabel(strip)
	local segments = {}
	for index, name in ipairs(names) do
		local segment = W.makeSegment(strip, name, name, index, { fill = true })
		segments[name] = segment
		W.paintSegment(segment, name == lit)
		segment.Activated:Connect(function()
			for other, button in pairs(segments) do
				W.paintSegment(button, other == name)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function colorRow(body, order)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(body, "Colour", order)
	W.makeRowLabel(row, "Colour", labelWidth)
	local swatch = Instance.new("Frame")
	swatch.Name = "Swatch"
	swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
	swatch.BackgroundColor3 = SAMPLE_COLOR
	swatch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	W.layProps(swatch, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, controlLeft(), 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.Swatch, 0, LAYOUT.Swatch) }
	end)
	swatch:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	swatch.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(swatch)
	W.addStroke(swatch)
	local _, field = W.makeTextField(row, "Hex", C.color3ToHex(SAMPLE_COLOR), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
	W.layProps(field, function()
		local from = controlLeft() + LAYOUT.Swatch + LAYOUT.LabelGap
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, from, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -from, 1, 0) }
	end)
end

local function sliderRow(body, order)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(body, "Size", order)
	W.makeRowLabel(row, "Size", labelWidth)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "SliderHolder"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	afterLabel(holder)
	holder.Parent = row
	W.makeSlider(holder, 0, 10, 4, nil, "%.1f")
end

local function statusLine(panel, order)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(panel, "Status", order)
	W.addListLayout(row, function() return LAYOUT.LabelGap * 2 end, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	for index, spec in ipairs(STATUS) do
		local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		text.Name = spec[1]
		text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		text.Text = spec[2]
		text.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		text.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		text.LayoutOrder = index
		TypeScale.style(text, "Caption")
		W.paint(text, "TextColor3", spec[1])
		text.Parent = row
	end
end

-- "Draft" in the title bar, left of the close button: what the panel shows is not saved.
local function draftTag(header)
	local tag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tag.Name = "Draft"
	tag.Text = "Draft"
	tag.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	tag.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	W.layProps(tag, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.IconSlot + LAYOUT.LabelGap), 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row - 10) }
	end)
	tag.ZIndex = 3
	TypeScale.style(tag, "Caption")
	W.paint(tag, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
	W.paint(tag, "TextColor3", "OnAccent")
	W.addCorner(tag)
	W.addPadding(tag, 6, 6, 0, 0)
	tag.Parent = header
end

-- A short list that scrolls, for the scroll bar and a list's rows.
local function sampleList(panel, order)
	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "List"
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.lay(list, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row * 3 + LAYOUT.RowGap * 2)
	end)
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.T.ScrollBar
	list.LayoutOrder = order
	list.Parent = panel
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, list)
	W.addListLayout(list, "RowGap")
	for index, name in ipairs(LIST_ROWS) do
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(list, "Item" .. index, index)
		local label = W.makeRowLabel(row, name, 0)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
	end
end

return function(screenGui)
	local panel = W.makePanel(screenGui, "ThemePreview", function()
		return PanelSizes.get().Settings + 100
	end)
	panel.ZIndex = 5
	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, "Preview", 0)
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)
	draftTag(bar.header)

	local _, search = W.makeSearchField(panel, "ShowcaseSearch", "Search properties...")
	search.LayoutOrder = 1

	local _, typeBody = W.makeSection(panel, "Particles", 2, false, nil, 1)
	local _, emission = W.makeSection(typeBody, "Emission", 1, false, nil, 2)
	dropdownRow(emission, "Mode", "Mode", { "Emit", "Stream", "Burst" }, "Emit", 1)
	W.makeNumberRow(emission, "Rate", "Rate", "24", labelWidth, 2)
	switchRow(emission, "Loop", "Loop", true, 3)
	switchRow(emission, "Enabled", "Enabled", false, 4)
	sliderRow(emission, 5)
	local _, look = W.makeSection(typeBody, "Appearance", 2, false, nil, 2)
	segmentRow(look, "View", { "Tilted", "Front", "On Top" }, "Front", 1)
	colorRow(look, 2)
	local texture = W.makeNumberRow(look, "Texture", "Texture", "rbxassetid://", labelWidth, 3)
	texture.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	W.makeDivider(panel, 3)
	W.makeButtonRow(panel, "Actions", {
		{ name = "Emit", text = "Emit" },
		{ name = "Clear", text = "Clear" },
	}, 4)
	W.makeButtonRow(panel, "Roles", {
		{ name = "Apply", text = "Apply", role = "Success" },
		{ name = "Reset", text = "Reset", role = "Danger" },
	}, 5)
	statusLine(panel, 6)
	sampleList(panel, 7)

	return { ThemePreview = panel, ThemePreviewClose = bar.close }
end

--[[
	ThemeModes  -  the selectable looks of the plugin UI: Typo, Slate, Shannon and Classic, and
	Custom: one of the first three ("based on") with the theme's own roles, structure and metrics on
	top (ThemeSchema's custom settings).
	  ThemeModes.ORDER, DEFAULT, TEXT_SIZES, DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE
	  ThemeModes.get(id)             mode table; an unknown id gives the default mode
	  ThemeModes.textSize(value)     a supported text size, else the default
	  ThemeModes.resolve(inputs, id, textSize, custom)   { Id, Base, Structure, Metrics, Surface, Roles }
	    custom (for Custom): { base, roles = { Role = Color3 }, structure = {...}, metrics = {...} }
	  ThemeModes.turnHue(roles, degrees), ThemeModes.ColorMath, ThemeModes.Invert
	Inputs are the saved theme colours { panel, field, accent, text, slider, scrollBar }. Roles are
	derived on every call and never saved. Constants fills T and LAYOUT from the result.
]]

local ColorMath = require(script.ColorMath)

local ThemeModes = {}

local MODES = {
	Typo = require(script.Typo),
	Slate = require(script.Slate),
	Shannon = require(script.Shannon),
	Classic = require(script.Classic),
}

-- Custom has no tables of its own: resolve builds them from its base mode.
local CUSTOM = { Id = "Custom" }
-- Classic draws through its own builders, so it is no base for Custom.
local CUSTOM_BASES = { Typo = true, Slate = true, Shannon = true }

ThemeModes.ColorMath = ColorMath
ThemeModes.Invert = require(script.Invert)
ThemeModes.ORDER = { "Typo", "Slate", "Shannon", "Classic", "Custom" }
ThemeModes.DEFAULT = "Shannon"
-- Only multiples of 4 draw on whole pixels at the base UI scale (1.25, the settings box's 100%).
ThemeModes.TEXT_SIZES = { 12, 16 }
ThemeModes.DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE = 16

-- Status hues with the saturation each is solved at.
local STATUS = {
	Success = { color = Color3.fromRGB(139, 195, 74), saturation = 0.62 },
	Warning = { color = Color3.fromRGB(224, 160, 64), saturation = 0.70 },
	Danger = { color = Color3.fromRGB(238, 100, 100), saturation = 0.58 },
}
local STATUS_FLOOR = 4.6
local FILL_FLOOR = 3.1

function ThemeModes.get(id)
	if id == "Custom" then
		return CUSTOM
	end
	return MODES[id] or MODES[ThemeModes.DEFAULT]
end

-- A copy of `base` with `over`'s keys on top; `base` itself when there is nothing over it.
local function overlay(base, over)
	if not over or next(over) == nil then
		return base
	end
	local out = table.clone(base)
	for key, value in pairs(over) do
		out[key] = value
	end
	return out
end

function ThemeModes.textSize(value)
	for _, size in ipairs(ThemeModes.TEXT_SIZES) do
		if size == value then
			return size
		end
	end
	return ThemeModes.DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE
end

-- A saved fill colour is kept when it stands out from `background`, otherwise it is re-solved.
local function resolveFill(saved, background, light)
	if ColorMath.contrast(saved, background) >= FILL_FLOOR then
		return saved
	end
	local hue, saturation = saved:ToHSV()
	return ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation, { background }, FILL_FLOOR, light)
end

-- Roles the modes share unless a mode sets its own: status colours and the slider / scrollbar fills.
local function addSharedRoles(roles, inputs)
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(roles.Panel)
	local surfaces = { roles.Panel, roles.Field, roles.Header }
	for name, status in pairs(STATUS) do
		if roles[name] == nil then
			local hue = status.color:ToHSV()
			roles[name] = ColorMath.solveTone(hue, status.saturation, surfaces, STATUS_FLOOR, light)
		end
	end
	if roles.SliderFill == nil then
		roles.SliderFill = resolveFill(inputs.slider, roles.Field, light)
	end
	if roles.ScrollBar == nil then
		roles.ScrollBar = resolveFill(inputs.scrollBar, roles.Panel, light)
	end
end

-- Every role turned `degrees` around the hue circle (ColorMath.turnHue), but the status colours,
-- which keep their meaning (danger stays red). A new table; `roles` is left as it is.
function ThemeModes.turnHue(roles, degrees)
	local turned = {}
	for role, color in pairs(roles) do
		turned[role] = STATUS[role] and color or ColorMath.turnHue(color, degrees)
	end
	return turned
end

function ThemeModes.resolve(inputs, id, textSize, custom)
	local isCustom = id == "Custom"
	local mode = ThemeModes.get(id)
	if isCustom then
		local base = custom and custom.base
		mode = MODES[CUSTOM_BASES[base] and base or ThemeModes.DEFAULT]
	end
	local roles = mode.derive(inputs, ColorMath)
	-- The theme's own roles before the shared ones, which only fill what is still unset.
	if isCustom and custom and custom.roles then
		for role, color in pairs(custom.roles) do
			roles[role] = color
		end
	end
	addSharedRoles(roles, inputs)
	local metrics = mode.Metrics[ThemeModes.textSize(textSize)]
	local structure = mode.Structure
	if isCustom and custom then
		structure = overlay(structure, custom.structure)
		metrics = overlay(metrics, custom.metrics)
	end
	return {
		Id = isCustom and "Custom" or mode.Id,
		Base = mode.Id,
		Structure = structure,
		Metrics = metrics,
		Surface = mode.Surface,
		Roles = roles,
	}
end

return ThemeModes

--[[
	Classic  -  the classic theme mode: see-through panels, a filled box behind every label and
	header, the theme font for all text at fixed sizes, and text shades taken straight from the
	theme's text colour.
	Returns { Id, Structure, Metrics, Surface, derive }. Nothing is solved for contrast: the saved
	colours are used as they are. Structure.Classic tells widgets to build the classic shapes; the
	text-size option does not apply.
]]

local Classic = {}

Classic.Id = "Classic"

Classic.Structure = {
	Classic = true,
	ChevronSide = "Left",
	TypeHeader = "Blob",
	TypeRule = 0,
	GroupDivider = false,
	FieldOutline = "Always",
	Toggle = "Switch",
	NumberFont = "Theme",
	TitleFont = "Theme",
	TypeFont = "Theme",
	TitleBarFill = false,
	Shadow = false,
	AxisOutline = false,
	RowHover = false,
	TitleWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	TypeWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	GroupWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	LabelWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	ValueWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
}

-- Both text sizes share these offsets.
local METRICS = {
	Text = 10, TitleText = 12, TypeText = 11, GroupText = 11,
	TitleBar = 26, Search = 20, TypeHead = 22, GroupHead = 22,
	Row = 22, RowGap = 3, RowIndent = 0, LabelWidth = 78, LabelGap = 4,
	PanelPad = 6, FieldPad = 4, GroupBodyTop = 4, GroupGap = 3, OpenGroupGap = 4, TypeGap = 4,
	Corner = 5, BigCorner = 8,
	Swatch = 14, ToggleWidth = 28, ToggleHeight = 16, Knob = 12, AxisPill = 18, IconSlot = 18,
}
Classic.Metrics = { [12] = METRICS, [16] = METRICS }

-- Opacity is the theme's own in this mode; these apply when a theme saved none.
Classic.Surface = { PanelAlpha = 0.15, BlobAlpha = 0.25, BorderAlpha = 0.8, UsesSavedAlpha = true }

-- The default text colour keeps its hand-picked shades.
local DEFAULT_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(196, 162, 101)
local DEFAULT_SHADES = {
	Bright = Color3.fromRGB(232, 213, 168),
	Muted = Color3.fromRGB(154, 122, 72),
	Dark = Color3.fromRGB(122, 90, 48),
}

local function isDefaultText(color)
	return math.abs(color.R - DEFAULT_TEXT.R) < 0.02
		and math.abs(color.G - DEFAULT_TEXT.G) < 0.02
		and math.abs(color.B - DEFAULT_TEXT.B) < 0.02
end

-- Bright, muted and dark shades of a text colour.
local function textShades(base)
	if isDefaultText(base) then
		return DEFAULT_SHADES.Bright, DEFAULT_SHADES.Muted, DEFAULT_SHADES.Dark
	end
	local hue, saturation, value = base:ToHSV()
	local bright = Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.max(0, saturation * 0.55), math.min(1, value * 1.2))
	local muted = Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.min(1, saturation * 1.15), value * 0.78)
	local dark = Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.min(1, saturation * 1.25), value * 0.62)
	return bright, muted, dark
end

function Classic.derive(inputs)

--[[
	ColorMath  -  contrast and colour-space helpers for theme derivation. Pure; no requires.
	API: quantize, luminance, contrast, minContrast, mix, isLight, toOklch, fromOklch, turnHue,
	oklchWithContrast, solveTone, backOff, toHex, fromHex.
	Contrast is the ratio of relative luminances, 1 to 21. OKLCH keeps hue steady while lightness changes.
]]

local ColorMath = {}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- A panel brighter than this counts as a light theme.
local LIGHT_THEME_LUMINANCE = 0.18

local function channelToLinear(channel)
	if channel <= 0.04045 then
		return channel / 12.92
	end
	return ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
end

local function linearToChannel(value)
	value = math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
	if value <= 0.0031308 then
		return 12.92 * value
	end
	return 1.055 * value ^ (1 / 2.4) - 0.055
end

-- Round each channel to 8 bits, the precision a saved theme keeps.
function ColorMath.quantize(color)
	local red = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5)
	local green = math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5)
	local blue = math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)
	return Color3.fromRGB(red, green, blue)
end

-- Relative luminance, 0 to 1.
function ColorMath.luminance(color)
	return 0.2126 * channelToLinear(color.R) + 0.7152 * channelToLinear(color.G) + 0.0722 * channelToLinear(color.B)
end

-- Contrast ratio between two colours, 1 to 21.
function ColorMath.contrast(first, second)
	local firstLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(first)
	local secondLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(second)
	local brighter = math.max(firstLuminance, secondLuminance)
	local darker = math.min(firstLuminance, secondLuminance)
	return (brighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05)
end

function ColorMath.minContrast(color, backgrounds)
	local lowest = math.huge
	for _, background in ipairs(backgrounds) do
		lowest = math.min(lowest, ColorMath.contrast(color, background))
	end
	return lowest
end

-- sRGB blend of `from` toward `to`, rounded to 8 bits.
function ColorMath.mix(from, to, amount)
	return ColorMath.quantize(from:Lerp(to, amount))
end

function ColorMath.isLight(color)
	return ColorMath.luminance(color) > LIGHT_THEME_LUMINANCE
end

-- Returns lightness (0 to 1), chroma and hue (degrees).
function ColorMath.toOklch(color)
	local red = channelToLinear(color.R)
	local green = channelToLinear(color.G)
	local blue = channelToLinear(color.B)

	local long = (0.4122214708 * red + 0.5363325363 * green + 0.0514459929 * blue) ^ (1 / 3)
	local medium = (0.2119034982 * red + 0.6806995451 * green + 0.1073969566 * blue) ^ (1 / 3)
	local short = (0.0883024619 * red + 0.2817188376 * green + 0.6299787005 * blue) ^ (1 / 3)

	local lightness = 0.2104542553 * long + 0.7936177850 * medium - 0.0040720468 * short
	local greenRed = 1.9779984951 * long - 2.4285922050 * medium + 0.4505937099 * short
	local blueYellow = 0.0259040371 * long + 0.7827717662 * medium - 0.8086757660 * short

	local chroma = math.sqrt(greenRed * greenRed + blueYellow * blueYellow)
	local hue = math.deg(math.atan2(blueYellow, greenRed)) % 360
	return lightness, chroma, hue
end

-- Linear sRGB channels for an OKLCH colour; values outside 0..1 are out of gamut.
local function oklchToLinear(lightness, chroma, hue)
	local greenRed = chroma * math.cos(math.rad(hue))
	local blueYellow = chroma * math.sin(math.rad(hue))

	local long = (lightness + 0.3963377774 * greenRed + 0.2158037573 * blueYellow) ^ 3
	local medium = (lightness - 0.1055613458 * greenRed - 0.0638541728 * blueYellow) ^ 3
	local short = (lightness - 0.0894841775 * greenRed - 1.2914855480 * blueYellow) ^ 3

	local red = 4.0767416621 * long - 3.3077115913 * medium + 0.2309699292 * short
	local green = -1.2684380046 * long + 2.6097574011 * medium - 0.3413193965 * short
	local blue = -0.0041960863 * long - 0.7034186147 * medium + 1.7076147010 * short
	return red, green, blue
end

local function inGamut(value)
	return value >= -0.0001 and value <= 1.0001
end

-- OKLCH to an 8-bit colour. Out-of-gamut colours lose chroma until they fit.
function ColorMath.fromOklch(lightness, chroma, hue)
	local reduced = chroma
	for _ = 1, 60 do
		local red, green, blue = oklchToLinear(lightness, reduced, hue)
		if inGamut(red) and inGamut(green) and inGamut(blue) then
			return ColorMath.quantize(Color3.new(linearToChannel(red), linearToChannel(green), linearToChannel(blue)))
		end
		reduced *= 0.95
	end
	local red, green, blue = oklchToLinear(lightness, 0, hue)
	return ColorMath.quantize(Color3.new(linearToChannel(red), linearToChannel(green), linearToChannel(blue)))
end

-- `color` turned `degrees` around the OKLCH hue circle, lightness and chroma kept (a grey stays
-- grey): the Theme Editor's Hue. An HSV turn would make a yellow bright and a blue dark.
function ColorMath.turnHue(color, degrees)
	local lightness, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(color)
	if chroma < 0.0005 or degrees % 360 == 0 then
		return color
	end
	return ColorMath.fromOklch(lightness, chroma, (hue + degrees) % 360)
end

-- OKLCH colour whose lightness moves away from the backgrounds until `floor` contrast holds.
function ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(lightness, chroma, hue, backgrounds, floor, light)
	local step = light and -0.02 or 0.02
	local current = lightness
	local color = ColorMath.fromOklch(current, chroma, hue)
	while ColorMath.minContrast(color, backgrounds) < floor and current > 0.02 and current < 0.98 do
		current += step
		color = ColorMath.fromOklch(current, chroma, hue)
	end
	-- A mid-tone background can be out of reach for a tinted colour; plain black or white is the most it allows.
	if ColorMath.minContrast(color, backgrounds) < floor then
		return light and BLACK or WHITE
	end
	return color
end

-- True when `color` sits on the far side of every background and reaches `target` against each.
local function reaches(color, backgrounds, target, light)
	local colorLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(color)
	for _, background in ipairs(backgrounds) do
		local backgroundLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(background)
		if light and colorLuminance >= backgroundLuminance then
			return false
		end
		if not light and colorLuminance <= backgroundLuminance then
			return false
		end
		if ColorMath.contrast(color, background) < target then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function fromHsv(hue, saturation, value)
	return ColorMath.quantize(Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, value))
end

-- The least extreme HSV value that reaches `target` against every background at the given
-- hue. Saturation drops in steps of 0.05 when full value (or zero, for light themes) misses.
function ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation, backgrounds, target, light)
	local current = saturation
	while current >= -0.001 do
		local used = math.max(0, current)
		local extreme = light and 0 or 1
		if reaches(fromHsv(hue, used, extreme), backgrounds, target, light) then
			-- Bisection: 30 halvings resolve value far below 1/255.
			local low = 0
			local high = 1
			for _ = 1, 30 do
				local middle = (low + high) / 2
				local passes = reaches(fromHsv(hue, used, middle), backgrounds, target, light)
				if passes == light then
					low = middle
				else
					high = middle
				end
			end
			if light then
				return fromHsv(hue, used, low)
			end
			local value = high
			local color = fromHsv(hue, used, value)
			-- 8-bit rounding can land just under the target; step up until it holds.
			while not reaches(color, backgrounds, target, light) and value < 1 do
				value = math.min(1, value + 0.004)
				color = fromHsv(hue, used, value)
			end
			return color
		end
		current -= 0.05
	end
	return light and BLACK or WHITE
end

-- `from` pulled toward `to` by `pull`, easing back in steps of 0.01 until `floor` holds.
function ColorMath.backOff(from, to, pull, floor, backgrounds)
	local amount = pull
	while amount > 0 and ColorMath.minContrast(ColorMath.mix(from, to, amount), backgrounds) < floor do
		amount = math.floor((amount - 0.01) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
	end
	return ColorMath.mix(from, to, amount)
end

function ColorMath.toHex(color)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

-- A colour from "RGB" or "RRGGBB", with or without its "#"; nil when it is not one.
function ColorMath.fromHex(hex)
	hex = string.gsub(hex, "#", "")
	if #hex == 3 then
		hex = string.rep(string.sub(hex, 1, 1), 2) .. string.rep(string.sub(hex, 2, 2), 2) .. string.rep(string.sub(hex, 3, 3), 2)
	end
	if #hex ~= 6 then
		return nil
	end
	local red, green, blue = tonumber(string.sub(hex, 1, 2), 16), tonumber(string.sub(hex, 3, 4), 16), tonumber(string.sub(hex, 5, 6), 16)
	if not red or not green or not blue then
		return nil
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(red, green, blue)
end

return ColorMath

--[[
	Invert  -  a theme's other polarity, for the Theme Editor's Invert: a dark theme's light twin, a
	light theme's dark one. Pure; requires ColorMath.
	A grey (OKLCH chroma under NEUTRAL) moves its lightness along one line: the canvas goes to where a
	twin's canvas sits and the text to the other end, every grey keeping its place between and beyond
	them. A coloured fill (an accent, a lit switch) and the marks drawn on it stay as they are;
	coloured text moves its lightness only as far as it must to keep its contrast on the canvas (at
	most CONTRAST_CAP). Images keep their colours.
	  Invert.context(canvas, text) -> { from, to, light, ... }: the canvas, its twin, whether the twin
	    is light (text, the theme's text colour, anchors the line; nil guesses it)
	  Invert.color(color, context, use) -> Color3      use: "text" (default), "fill" or "keep"
	  Invert.roles(roles) -> roles, context            every theme role by its use
]]

local ColorMath = require(script.Parent.ColorMath)

local Invert = {}

-- Under this OKLCH chroma a colour counts as a grey.
local NEUTRAL = 0.06
-- Where a twin's canvas and text land (OKLCH lightness): a light twin's near white and near black,
-- a dark twin's deep grey and near white.
local LIGHT_CANVAS, LIGHT_TEXT = 0.97, 0.22
local DARK_CANVAS, DARK_TEXT = 0.21, 0.94
-- Coloured text keeps the contrast it had on the canvas, up to this.
local CONTRAST_CAP = 7
-- Coloured text that read below this on the canvas was never meant to stand out: it mirrors.
local TEXT_FLOOR = 3

-- How each role is used: a fill keeps its colour when coloured; the rest are text or surfaces
-- (TEXT_FLOOR tells which).
local FILL_ROLES = {
	Accent = true, ToggleOn = true, SliderFill = true, ScrollBar = true, Selected = true,
	Focus = true, OutlineHover = true,
}
-- A mark and the fill it is drawn on: the mark keeps its colour while its fill does, and mirrors
-- with a grey one.
local MARK_ON = { OnAccent = "Accent", KnobOn = "ToggleOn" }

-- A grey's lightness in the twin: on the line through (canvas, its new place) and (text, its new
-- place), which keeps how far apart the theme's greys stand.
local function mirror(lightness, context)
	return math.clamp(context.canvasTo + (lightness - context.canvasFrom) * context.slope, 0, 1)
end

function Invert.context(canvas, text)
	local canvasFrom, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(canvas)
	local textFrom = text and (ColorMath.toOklch(text)) or 1 - canvasFrom
	local light = not ColorMath.isLight(canvas)
	local canvasTo = light and LIGHT_CANVAS or DARK_CANVAS
	local textTo = light and LIGHT_TEXT or DARK_TEXT
	-- Text as light as the canvas (no theme reads so) gives no line: a plain mirror instead.
	local slope = math.abs(textFrom - canvasFrom) > 0.05 and (textTo - canvasTo) / (textFrom - canvasFrom) or -1
	local context = { from = canvas, light = light, canvasFrom = canvasFrom, canvasTo = canvasTo, slope = slope }
	context.to = ColorMath.fromOklch(canvasTo, chroma, hue)
	return context
end

function Invert.color(color, context, use)
	if use == "keep" then
		return color
	end
	local lightness, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(color)
	if chroma < NEUTRAL then
		return ColorMath.fromOklch(mirror(lightness, context), chroma, hue)
	end
	if use == "fill" then
		return color
	end
	local had = ColorMath.contrast(color, context.from)
	if had < TEXT_FLOOR then
		return ColorMath.fromOklch(mirror(lightness, context), chroma, hue)
	end
	return ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(lightness, chroma, hue, { context.to }, math.min(had, CONTRAST_CAP), context.light)
end

local function isGrey(color)
	local _, chroma = ColorMath.toOklch(color)
	return chroma < NEUTRAL
end

function Invert.roles(roles)
	local context = Invert.context(roles.Panel, roles.TextPrimary)
	local out = {}
	for role, color in pairs(roles) do
		local use = nil
		if FILL_ROLES[role] then
			use = "fill"
		elseif MARK_ON[role] and roles[MARK_ON[role]] and not isGrey(roles[MARK_ON[role]]) then
			use = "keep"
		end
		out[role] = Invert.color(color, context, use)
	end
	return out, context
end

return Invert

--[[
	Shannon  -  theme mode with a calm, editorial look: warm surfaces a few shades apart, titles
	in the theme font, hairlines drawn in the text colour, raised fields, and one accent on
	screen (the switch). Ships with the Shannon Dark and Shannon Light presets.
	Returns { Id, Structure, Metrics, derive }. Every colour is a blend of the panel, the text
	colour, black and white, so custom themes keep working.
]]

local Shannon = {}

Shannon.Id = "Shannon"

Shannon.Structure = {
	ChevronSide = "Right",
	TypeHeader = "Plain",
	-- Hairline between type sections.
	TypeRule = 1,
	GroupDivider = true,
	FieldOutline = "Always",
	Toggle = "Switch",
	NumberFont = "Body",
	TitleFont = "Theme",
	TypeFont = "Theme",
	TitleBarFill = false,
	AxisOutline = true,
	RowHover = true,
	Shadow = true,
	TitleWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	TypeWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	GroupWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Medium,
	LabelWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	ValueWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
}

-- Solid surfaces and strokes.
Shannon.Surface = { PanelAlpha = 0, BlobAlpha = 0, BorderAlpha = 0 }

-- Offsets at UI scale 1, keyed by the theme's text size.
Shannon.Metrics = {
	[12] = {
		Text = 12, TitleText = 16, TypeText = 16, GroupText = 12,
		TitleBar = 40, Search = 28, TypeHead = 32, GroupHead = 24,
		Row = 24, RowGap = 4, RowIndent = 0, LabelWidth = 80, LabelGap = 8,
		PanelPad = 12, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 4, GroupGap = 12, OpenGroupGap = 0, TypeGap = 16,
		Corner = 8, BigCorner = 12,
		Swatch = 16, ToggleWidth = 28, ToggleHeight = 16, Knob = 12, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 20,
	},
	[16] = {
		Text = 16, TitleText = 20, TypeText = 20, GroupText = 16,
		TitleBar = 44, Search = 32, TypeHead = 36, GroupHead = 28,
		Row = 28, RowGap = 4, RowIndent = 0, LabelWidth = 88, LabelGap = 8,
		PanelPad = 12, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 4, GroupGap = 12, OpenGroupGap = 0, TypeGap = 16,
		Corner = 8, BigCorner = 12,
		Swatch = 20, ToggleWidth = 36, ToggleHeight = 20, Knob = 16, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 20,
	},
}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- The theme's text colour is used as is once it reaches this contrast on the canvas.
local PRIMARY_FLOOR = 12

function Shannon.derive(inputs, ColorMath)
	local canvas = inputs.panel
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(canvas)

	local field = light and WHITE or ColorMath.mix(canvas, WHITE, 0.046)
	local hover = ColorMath.mix(canvas, BLACK, light and 0.02 or 0.18)
	local pressed = ColorMath.mix(canvas, BLACK, light and 0.04 or 0.47)

	local primary = inputs.text
	if ColorMath.minContrast(primary, { canvas, field }) < PRIMARY_FLOOR then
		local hue, saturation = inputs.text:ToHSV()
		primary = ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation * 0.55, { canvas, field }, PRIMARY_FLOOR, light)
	end

	local label = ColorMath.backOff(primary, canvas, light and 0.18 or 0.27, 7, { canvas, hover })
	local secondary = ColorMath.backOff(primary, canvas, light and 0.41 or 0.45, 4.5, { canvas, field, hover })
	local disabled = ColorMath.backOff(primary, canvas, 0.62, 3, { canvas, field })

	-- The accent steps toward the text colour until it stands out from the canvas.
	local accent = inputs.accent
	for _ = 1, 60 do
		if ColorMath.contrast(accent, canvas) >= 3 then
			break
		end
		accent = ColorMath.mix(accent, primary, 0.05)
	end
	local knobOn = ColorMath.contrast(WHITE, accent) >= 3 and WHITE or canvas

	local hairline = ColorMath.mix(canvas, primary, 0.15)

	return {
		Panel = canvas,
		Header = canvas,
		Band = canvas,
		Field = field,
		FieldHover = hover,
		Selected = pressed,
		Sunken = pressed,
		TextPrimary = primary,
		TextHeading = primary,
		TextLabel = label,
		TextSecondary = secondary,
		TextDisabled = disabled,
		Outline = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.15),
		OutlineHover = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.30),
		Focus = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.70),
		Divider = hairline,
		Rule = hairline,
		PanelStroke = hairline,
		Accent = accent,
		OnAccent = knobOn,
		ToggleOn = accent,
		ToggleOff = light and ColorMath.mix(canvas, BLACK, 0.07) or pressed,
		KnobOn = knobOn,
		KnobOff = secondary,
	}
end

return Shannon

	fields that gain an outline only on hover or focus.
	Returns { Id, Structure, Metrics, derive }. Surfaces keep the panel's hue at low chroma, so
	the theme shows in the type band, the checkbox and the focus ring.
]]

local Slate = {}

Slate.Id = "Slate"

Slate.Structure = {
	ChevronSide = "Left",
	TypeHeader = "Band",
	TypeRule = 0,
	GroupDivider = true,
	FieldOutline = "Hover",
	Toggle = "Check",

	TitleFont = "Body",

	TypeWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Bold,
	GroupWeight = Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold,

-- Offsets at UI scale 1, keyed by the theme's text size.
Slate.Metrics = {
	[12] = {
		Text = 12, TitleText = 16, TypeText = 12, GroupText = 12,
		TitleBar = 32, Search = 24, TypeHead = 28, GroupHead = 28,
		Row = 24, RowGap = 4, RowIndent = 20, LabelWidth = 88, LabelGap = 4,
		PanelPad = 8, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 0, GroupGap = 0, OpenGroupGap = 8, TypeGap = 8,

		Swatch = 16, ToggleWidth = 16, ToggleHeight = 16, Knob = 12, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 24,

	[16] = {

		PanelPad = 8, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 0, GroupGap = 0, OpenGroupGap = 8, TypeGap = 8,
		Corner = 4, BigCorner = 8,
		Swatch = 16, ToggleWidth = 20, ToggleHeight = 20, Knob = 16, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 20,
	},
}

-- OKLCH lightness per role: dark themes read up from the panel, light themes read down.
local DARK = { Primary = 0.96, Label = 0.87, Secondary = 0.77, Disabled = 0.58, Accent = 0.74 }
local LIGHT = { Primary = 0.22, Label = 0.36, Secondary = 0.45, Disabled = 0.62, Accent = 0.50 }

function Slate.derive(inputs, ColorMath)
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(inputs.panel)
	local panelLightness, panelChroma, panelHue = ColorMath.toOklch(inputs.panel)
	local _, textChroma, textHue = ColorMath.toOklch(inputs.text)
	local _, accentChroma, accentHue = ColorMath.toOklch(inputs.accent)

	local base = light and math.clamp(panelLightness, 0.92, 0.98) or math.clamp(panelLightness, 0.20, 0.30)
	local direction = light and -1 or 1
	local surfaceChroma = math.min(panelChroma * 0.6, 0.035)
	local bandChroma = math.min(accentChroma * 0.5, 0.045)
	local tone = light and LIGHT or DARK

	-- Surface `delta` lightness steps away from the panel, toward the text.
	local function surface(delta)
		return ColorMath.fromOklch(base + direction * delta, surfaceChroma, panelHue)
	end

	local panel = surface(0)
	local field = surface(0.06)
	local fieldHover = surface(0.09)
	local band = ColorMath.fromOklch(base + direction * 0.05, bandChroma, accentHue)

	local primary = ColorMath.fromOklch(tone.Primary, math.min(textChroma * 0.2, 0.02), textHue)
	local label = ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(tone.Label, math.min(textChroma * 0.25, 0.025), textHue, { panel }, 7, light)
	local secondary = ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(tone.Secondary, math.min(textChroma * 0.3, 0.03), textHue, { panel, band, fieldHover }, 4.5, light)
	local disabled = ColorMath.fromOklch(tone.Disabled, math.min(textChroma * 0.3, 0.03), textHue)
	local accent = ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(tone.Accent, math.min(accentChroma, 0.13), accentHue, { panel, field }, 3, light)

	return {
		Panel = panel,
		Header = panel,
		Band = band,
		Field = field,
		FieldHover = fieldHover,
		Selected = surface(0.13),
		Sunken = ColorMath.fromOklch(base - 0.03, surfaceChroma, panelHue),
		TextPrimary = primary,
		TextHeading = primary,
		TextLabel = label,
		TextSecondary = secondary,
		TextDisabled = disabled,
		Outline = field,
		OutlineHover = surface(0.17),
		Focus = accent,
		Divider = surface(0.10),
		Rule = surface(0.10),
		PanelStroke = surface(0.10),
		Accent = accent,
		OnAccent = panel,
		ToggleOn = accent,
		ToggleOff = surface(0.36),
		KnobOn = panel,
		KnobOff = secondary,
	}
end

return Slate

--[[
	Typo  -  theme mode where headings carry the structure: type names are large in the theme
	font and hue, group names are semibold, and fields are filled boxes with a neutral outline.
	Returns { Id, Structure, Metrics, derive }. derive(inputs, ColorMath) maps the theme inputs
	(panel, field, accent, text) to colour roles; ThemeModes/init.luau adds the shared roles.
]]

local Typo = {}

Typo.Id = "Typo"

Typo.Structure = {
	ChevronSide = "Right",
	TypeHeader = "Plain",
	-- Thickness in screen pixels of the rule between type sections.
	TypeRule = 2,
