	TypeWeight = Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold,
	GroupWeight = Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold,
	LabelWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
	ValueWeight = Enum.FontWeight.Medium,
}

-- Solid surfaces and strokes.
Typo.Surface = { PanelAlpha = 0, BlobAlpha = 0, BorderAlpha = 0 }

-- Offsets at UI scale 1, keyed by the theme's text size. All multiples of 4 except the knob inset.
Typo.Metrics = {
	[12] = {
		Text = 12, TitleText = 16, TypeText = 16, GroupText = 12,
		TitleBar = 32, Search = 24, TypeHead = 28, GroupHead = 24,
		Row = 24, RowGap = 4, RowIndent = 0, LabelWidth = 80, LabelGap = 8,
		PanelPad = 8, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 4, GroupGap = 4, OpenGroupGap = 8, TypeGap = 8,
		Corner = 6, BigCorner = 10,
		Swatch = 16, ToggleWidth = 28, ToggleHeight = 16, Knob = 12, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 20,
	},
	[16] = {
		Text = 16, TitleText = 20, TypeText = 20, GroupText = 16,
		TitleBar = 32, Search = 28, TypeHead = 32, GroupHead = 28,
		Row = 28, RowGap = 4, RowIndent = 0, LabelWidth = 96, LabelGap = 8,
		PanelPad = 8, FieldPad = 8, GroupBodyTop = 4, GroupGap = 4, OpenGroupGap = 8, TypeGap = 8,
		Corner = 6, BigCorner = 10,
		Swatch = 20, ToggleWidth = 36, ToggleHeight = 20, Knob = 16, AxisPill = 20, IconSlot = 20,
	},
}

-- Contrast floors against the surfaces each role sits on.
local FLOOR = {
	Primary = 12,
	Label = 7,
	Secondary = 5.5,
	Heading = 4.5,
	Disabled = 3.2,
	Control = 3.1,
	Accent = 3.1,
	Subtle = 1.6,
}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- A saved field colour is kept only when it stands apart from the panel on the readable side.
local function resolveField(inputs, light, ColorMath)
	local field = inputs.field
	local panel = inputs.panel
	local wrongSide = (not light) and ColorMath.luminance(field) < ColorMath.luminance(panel)
	if ColorMath.contrast(field, panel) >= 1.2 and not wrongSide then
		return field
	end
	local hue, saturation = panel:ToHSV()
	return ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation * 0.9, { panel }, 1.25, light)
end

-- Heading hue comes from the text colour when it has colour, otherwise from the accent.
local function resolveHeading(inputs, surfaces, light, ColorMath)
	local _, textChroma = ColorMath.toOklch(inputs.text)
	local source = textChroma >= 0.04 and inputs.text or inputs.accent
	local _, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(source)
	local lightness = light and 0.45 or 0.80
	return ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(lightness, math.min(chroma, 0.12), hue, surfaces, FLOOR.Heading, light)
end

function Typo.derive(inputs, ColorMath)
	local panel = inputs.panel
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(panel)
	local field = resolveField(inputs, light, ColorMath)
	local header = ColorMath.mix(panel, field, 0.5)
	local surfaces = { panel, field, header }

	local textHue, textSaturation = inputs.text:ToHSV()
	local accentHue, accentSaturation = inputs.accent:ToHSV()

	local primary = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.25, surfaces, FLOOR.Primary, light)
	local secondary = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.55, surfaces, FLOOR.Secondary, light)
	local disabled = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.45, surfaces, FLOOR.Disabled, light)
	local label = ColorMath.backOff(primary, panel, 0.28, FLOOR.Label, { panel })
	local heading = resolveHeading(inputs, { panel, header }, light, ColorMath)

	local borderControl = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, math.min(accentSaturation * 0.6, 0.45), { panel, header }, FLOOR.Control, light)
	local borderSubtle = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, math.min(accentSaturation * 0.5, 0.35), { panel }, FLOOR.Subtle, light)

	local accent = inputs.accent
	if ColorMath.minContrast(accent, { panel, field }) < FLOOR.Accent then
		accent = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, accentSaturation, { panel, field }, FLOOR.Accent, light)
	end
	local onAccent = panel
	if ColorMath.contrast(panel, accent) < 4.5 then
		onAccent = ColorMath.contrast(BLACK, accent) > ColorMath.contrast(WHITE, accent) and BLACK or WHITE
	end

	local knobOn = panel
	if ColorMath.contrast(panel, heading) < 3 then
		knobOn = ColorMath.contrast(BLACK, heading) > ColorMath.contrast(WHITE, heading) and BLACK or WHITE
	end
	-- The focus ring sits on the field, where the heading hue can be too close.
	local focus = heading
	if ColorMath.contrast(focus, field) < 3 then
		focus = primary
	end

	return {
		Panel = panel,
		Header = header,
		Band = panel,
		Field = field,
		FieldHover = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.08),
		Selected = ColorMath.mix(field, accent, 0.28),
		Sunken = ColorMath.mix(panel, BLACK, light and 0.08 or 0.35),
		TextPrimary = primary,
		TextHeading = heading,
		TextLabel = label,
		TextSecondary = secondary,
		TextDisabled = disabled,
		Outline = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.12),
		OutlineHover = borderControl,
		Focus = focus,
		Divider = borderSubtle,
		Rule = borderSubtle,
		PanelStroke = borderSubtle,
		Accent = accent,
		OnAccent = onAccent,
		ToggleOn = heading,
		ToggleOff = field,
		KnobOn = knobOn,
		KnobOff = secondary,
	}
end

return Typo

--[[
	ThemeSchema  -  every setting a theme holds, once: the theme document's shape, what the export
	code carries, what the Theme Editor shows and what the engine reads.
	An entry is { id, path, kind, default, scope, part, layer, label, min, max, choices }:
	  id       its number in the export code (ThemeCode), for good: never reused or moved. The lists
	           ids are counted from (ROLES, STUDIO_COLORS, STRUCTURE, METRICS, IMAGE_FIELDS,
	           SURFACE_FIELDS, SURFACES) and every choices list only grow at their end
	  path     where it sits in the document ("background.anim.fps")
	  kind     color ("#RRGGBB"), number, choice, toggle, asset (rbxassetid://), assets (a list),
	           font (an Enum.Font name or a font family's asset id), sound ("" for none, a name in
	           SOUNDS, or an audio asset id), text, placements (panel key -> { x, y, w, h }),
	           propertyLayouts (type name -> { order, hidden, pinned })
	  default  the value without the setting; nil: the mode decides (Custom falls back to its base)
	  scope    "all" (every mode) or "custom" (the Custom mode only)
	  part, layer, label   where the Theme Editor lists it
	A document stores only what differs from the defaults, so a code stays short.
	  ThemeSchema.ENTRIES, ThemeSchema.byPath[path]
	  ThemeSchema.SURFACE_LAYERS[surface]   the layers that surface draws
	  ThemeSchema.hasPicture(image, source, frames)   whether an image setting shows anything
	  ThemeSchema.imageLayerShows(doc, surface)       a Custom surface's image layer is on, with one
	  ThemeSchema.backgroundPath(fieldPath)           where the background keeps an image field
	  ThemeSchema.fontEnum(name) -> the Enum.Font of a listed font, or nil
	  ThemeSchema.offered(kind) -> the names of a listed kind (font, sound) a theme is offered
	  ThemeSchema.get(doc, path) -> the stored value or nil; ThemeSchema.value(doc, path) -> or the default
	  ThemeSchema.set(doc, path, value)        nil removes it
	  ThemeSchema.validate(entry, value) -> the value made valid, or nil
	  ThemeSchema.clean(doc) -> a new document: only known, valid, non-default settings
	The version 3 keys (accent, bg, blob, slider, scrollBar, textAccent, font, bgImage, bgImageAlpha,
	panelAlpha, blobAlpha, mode, textSize) stay flat at the top, so older builds read a newer theme's
	base; everything else nests under background, motion, sound, studio and custom.
]]

local FONT_ALIASES = { GothamSSm = "Gotham" }

-- The Enum.Font a listed name draws in, or nil when Roblox has none by that name.
function ThemeSchema.fontEnum(name)
	local ok, font = pcall(function()
		return Enum.Font[FONT_ALIASES[name] or name]
	end)
	if ok then
		return font
	end
	return nil
end

-- The names of a listed kind a theme is offered: every sound, the fonts Roblox still has.
local offeredFonts = nil
function ThemeSchema.offered(kind)
	if kind ~= "font" then
		return ThemeSchema.LISTED[kind]
	end
	if not offeredFonts then
		offeredFonts = {}
		for _, name in ipairs(FONTS) do
			if ThemeSchema.fontEnum(name) then

function ThemeSchema.hasPicture(image, source, frames)
	return (image or "") ~= "" or source == "List" and type(frames) == "table" and frames[1] ~= nil
end

function ThemeSchema.imageLayerShows(doc, surface)
	local prefix = "custom.surfaces." .. surface .. ".image."
	return ThemeSchema.value(doc, prefix .. "on") == true
		and ThemeSchema.hasPicture(ThemeSchema.value(doc, prefix .. "image"), ThemeSchema.value(doc, prefix .. "anim.source"), ThemeSchema.value(doc, prefix .. "anim.frames"))
end

local function split(path)
	local parts = {}
	for piece in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
		table.insert(parts, piece)
	end
	return parts
end

function ThemeSchema.get(doc, path)
	local node = doc
	for _, piece in ipairs(split(path)) do
		if type(node) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		node = node[piece]
	end
	return node
end

function ThemeSchema.value(doc, path)
	local stored = ThemeSchema.get(doc, path)
	if stored ~= nil then
		return stored
	end
	local entry = ThemeSchema.byPath[path]
	return entry and entry.default
end

function ThemeSchema.set(doc, path, value)
	local parts = split(path)
	local node = doc
	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local piece = parts[index]
		if type(node[piece]) ~= "table" then
			if value == nil then
				return
			end
			node[piece] = {}
		end
		node = node[piece]
	end
	node[parts[#parts]] = value
end

-- Validation: a value from a code is untrusted; each kind is made valid or dropped.

local function hexColor(value)
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local hex = string.match(value, "^#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)$")
	return hex and ("#" .. string.upper(hex)) or nil
end

local function assetId(value)
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local trimmed = string.match(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if trimmed == "" then
		return ""
	end
	local number = string.match(trimmed, "^(%d+)$") or string.match(trimmed, "^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")
		or string.match(trimmed, "^https?://www%.roblox%.com/asset/%?id=(%d+)$")
	return number and ("rbxassetid://" .. number) or nil
end

local function shortName(value)
	if type(value) ~= "string" or #value == 0 or #value > LONGEST_TEXT then
		return nil
	end
	return value
end

local function nameList(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(value) do
		local name = shortName(item)
		if name and #out < MOST_LAYOUT_NAMES then
			table.insert(out, name)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local VALIDATORS = {
	color = function(_, value)
		return hexColor(value)
	end,
	number = function(entry, value)
		if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
			return nil
		end
		return math.clamp(math.floor(value + 0.5), entry.min, entry.max)
	end,
	choice = function(entry, value)
		return table.find(entry.choices, value) and value or nil
	end,
	toggle = function(_, value)
		if type(value) == "boolean" then
			return value
		end
		return nil
	end,
	asset = function(_, value)
		return assetId(value)
	end,
	assets = function(_, value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		local out = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(value) do
			local id = assetId(item)
			if id and id ~= "" and #out < MOST_ASSETS then
				table.insert(out, id)
			end
		end
		return #out > 0 and out or nil
	end,
	font = function(_, value)
		if table.find(FONTS, value) then
			return value
		end
		local id = assetId(value)
		return id ~= "" and id or nil
	end,
	sound = function(_, value)
		if value == "" or table.find(ThemeSchema.SOUNDS, value) then
			return value
		end
		return assetId(value)
	end,
	text = function(_, value)
		if type(value) ~= "string" then
			return nil
		end
		return string.sub(value, 1, LONGEST_TEXT)
	end,
	placements = function(_, value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		local out, count = {}, 0
		for key, place in pairs(value) do
			if shortName(key) and type(place) == "table" and count < MOST_PLACEMENTS then
				local x, y, w, h = place.x, place.y, place.w, place.h
				if type(x) == "number" and type(y) == "number" and type(w) == "number" and type(h) == "number" then
					out[key] = {
						x = math.clamp(math.floor(x), -4000, 8000), y = math.clamp(math.floor(y), -4000, 8000),
						w = math.clamp(math.floor(w), 40, 4000), h = math.clamp(math.floor(h), 24, 4000),
					}
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
		return next(out) and out or nil
	end,
	propertyLayouts = function(_, value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		local out, count = {}, 0
		for typeName, layout in pairs(value) do
			if shortName(typeName) and type(layout) == "table" and count < MOST_TYPES then
				local cleaned = { order = nameList(layout.order), hidden = nameList(layout.hidden), pinned = nameList(layout.pinned) }
				if next(cleaned) then
					out[typeName] = cleaned
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
		return next(out) and out or nil
	end,
}

function ThemeSchema.validate(entry, value)
	if value == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return VALIDATORS[entry.kind](entry, value)
end

local function equal(first, second)
	if type(first) ~= "table" or type(second) ~= "table" then
		return first == second
	end
	for key, value in pairs(first) do
		if not equal(value, second[key]) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for key in pairs(second) do
		if first[key] == nil then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function ThemeSchema.clean(doc)
	local out = { v = 4 }
	if type(doc) ~= "table" then
		return out
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(ThemeSchema.ENTRIES) do
		local value = ThemeSchema.validate(entry, ThemeSchema.get(doc, entry.path))
		if value ~= nil and not equal(value, entry.default) then
			ThemeSchema.set(out, entry.path, value)
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ThemeSchema

--[[
	ThemeStore  -  the saved theme as text: the ThemeJSON plugin setting, the export code and the
	theme code box. A theme is one document (ThemeSchema); T holds its inputs and T.Doc the rest.
	  ThemeStore.document()              the theme in T as a clean document
	  ThemeStore.encode()                that document as ThemeJSON (version 4, with every version 3
	                                     key written out so an older build reads them)
	  ThemeStore.exportCode()            that document as an export code (ThemeCode)
	  ThemeStore.decode(text)            an export code or a version 3 / 4 JSON read into the theme's
	                                     inputs (Color3s, alphas 0..1, mode, text size, font,
	                                     background) and `doc`; nil if unreadable. Missing settings
	                                     take their defaults
	  ThemeStore.fromDocument(doc)       a document read into the inputs, as decode does
	  ThemeStore.apply(theme)            writes a decoded theme into T and refreshes
	  ThemeStore.load(text)              decode and apply
	  ThemeStore.hold(), putBack(held)   T's inputs kept and written back around a drawing in another
	                                     theme (UIBuilder.withTheme)
	  ThemeStore.setDraft(doc)           the Theme Editor's unsaved theme (nil for none): every build
	                                     while it is set shows it, so a rebuild mid-edit keeps it
	  ThemeStore.loadForBuild(plugin)    the draft, else the saved ThemeJSON, else the default
	                                     theme (C.DEFAULT_THEME_CODE); before Build
	  ThemeStore.defaultDocument()       the default theme as a new document (the editors' Reset)
	  ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(text)  "123" -> "rbxassetid://123"
	  ThemeStore.moveToDefaults(plugin)  the one-time move to the default look; before load
	  ThemeStore.defaultsMove(saved, scale)  what that move saves, from the saved settings alone
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ThemeModes = require(script.Parent.ThemeModes)
local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.ThemeSchema)
local ThemeCode = require(script.Parent.ThemeCode)
local T = C.T

local ThemeStore = {}

local COLOR_KEYS = { "accent", "bg", "blob", "slider", "scrollBar", "textAccent" }
local INPUT_OF = { accent = "InputAccent", bg = "InputBg", blob = "InputBlob", slider = "InputSlider", scrollBar = "InputScrollBar", textAccent = "TextAccent" }

function ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(text)
	text = (text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if text == "" then
		return ""
	end
	if text:match("^%d+$") then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. text
	end
	return text
end

-- The version 3 keys as T holds them now.
local function inputsOf()
	local inputs = {
		mode = T.Mode,
		textSize = T.TextSize,
		panelAlpha = math.floor(T.InputPanelAlpha * 100 + 0.5),
		blobAlpha = math.floor(T.InputBlobAlpha * 100 + 0.5),
		font = T.Font.Name,
		bgImage = T.BgImage or "",
		bgImageAlpha = math.floor((T.BgImageTransparency or 1) * 100 + 0.5),
	}
	for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
		inputs[key] = C.color3ToHex(T[INPUT_OF[key]])
	end
	return inputs
end

function ThemeStore.document()
	local doc = ThemeSchema.clean(T.Doc)
	for key, value in pairs(inputsOf()) do
		ThemeSchema.set(doc, key, value)
	end
	return ThemeSchema.clean(doc)
end

function ThemeStore.encode()
	local doc = ThemeStore.document()
	for key, value in pairs(inputsOf()) do
		doc[key] = value
	end
	return HttpService:JSONEncode(doc)
end

function ThemeStore.exportCode()
	return ThemeCode.encode(ThemeStore.document())
end

-- A document from an export code or a JSON code (version 3 or 4); nil when it is neither.
local function documentFrom(text)
	if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if string.find(text, ThemeCode.PREFIX, 1, true) then
		return (ThemeCode.decode(text))
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(text)
	end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return ThemeSchema.clean(data)
end

function ThemeStore.fromDocument(doc)
	local function value(path)
		return ThemeSchema.value(doc, path)
	end
	local theme = { doc = doc }
	for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
		theme[key] = C.hexToColor3(value(key))
	end
	theme.font = value("font")
	theme.bgImage = value("bgImage")
	theme.bgImageTransparency = value("bgImageAlpha") / 100
	theme.panelAlpha = value("panelAlpha") / 100
	theme.blobAlpha = value("blobAlpha") / 100
	theme.mode = ThemeModes.get(value("mode")).Id
	theme.textSize = ThemeModes.textSize(value("textSize"))
	return theme
end

function ThemeStore.decode(text)
	local doc = documentFrom(text)
	if not doc then
		return nil
	end
	return ThemeStore.fromDocument(doc)
end

-- Mutates T (the shared theme table). Before Build nothing needs repainting.
function ThemeStore.apply(theme)
	for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
		T[INPUT_OF[key]] = theme[key]
	end
	T.BgImage = theme.bgImage
	T.BgImageTransparency = theme.bgImageTransparency
	T.InputPanelAlpha = theme.panelAlpha
	T.InputBlobAlpha = theme.blobAlpha
	T.Mode = theme.mode
	T.TextSize = theme.textSize
	T.Font = ThemeSchema.fontEnum(theme.font) or T.Font
	T.Doc = theme.doc
	C.refresh()
end

function ThemeStore.hold()
	local held = {
		Mode = T.Mode,
		TextSize = T.TextSize,
		Font = T.Font,
		Doc = T.Doc,
		BgImage = T.BgImage,
		BgImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency,
		InputPanelAlpha = T.InputPanelAlpha,
		InputBlobAlpha = T.InputBlobAlpha,
	}
	for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
		held[INPUT_OF[key]] = T[INPUT_OF[key]]
	end
	return held
end

function ThemeStore.putBack(held)
	for name, value in pairs(held) do
		T[name] = value
	end
	C.refresh()
end

function ThemeStore.load(text)
	local theme = ThemeStore.decode(text)
	if not theme then
		return false
	end
	ThemeStore.apply(theme)
	return true
end

local draft = nil

function ThemeStore.setDraft(doc)
	draft = doc
end

function ThemeStore.defaultDocument()
	return documentFrom(C.DEFAULT_THEME_CODE)
end

-- No saved theme, or one no longer readable: the default theme.
function ThemeStore.loadForBuild(plugin)
	if draft then
		ThemeStore.apply(ThemeStore.fromDocument(draft))
		return true
	end
	return ThemeStore.load(plugin:GetSetting("ThemeJSON")) or ThemeStore.load(C.DEFAULT_THEME_CODE)
end

-- The one-time move to the default look (Ashen Grace). No readable saved theme: all of it, the UI
-- scale too. A built-in look (any mode but Custom, in any colours): the default theme, keeping the
-- user's UI scale. A Custom theme is the user's own and stays. A UI scale never saved stays the
-- size it showed (LEGACY_UI_SCALE_PERCENT).
ThemeStore.DEFAULTS_VERSION = 3
local LEGACY_UI_SCALE_PERCENT = 100

-- `saved`: the decoded ThemeJSON or nil; `savedScale`: the UIScale setting or nil. Returns
-- { theme = "clear" | "keep", uiScale = percent to save or nil }.
function ThemeStore.defaultsMove(saved, savedScale)
	if saved == nil then
		return { theme = "clear", uiScale = C.DEFAULT_UI_SCALE_PERCENT }
	end
	local move = { theme = saved.mode == "Custom" and "keep" or "clear" }
	if savedScale == nil then
		move.uiScale = LEGACY_UI_SCALE_PERCENT
	end
	return move
end

-- Runs defaultsMove once per user (setting ThemeDefaults), before load and before QOLWiring reads
-- the UI scale; a scale it writes takes UIScaleBase with it.
function ThemeStore.moveToDefaults(pluginn)
	if pluginn:GetSetting("ThemeDefaults") == ThemeStore.DEFAULTS_VERSION then
		return
	end
	local raw = pluginn:GetSetting("ThemeJSON")
	local saved = nil
	if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
		end)
		if ok and type(data) == "table" then
			saved = data
		end
	end
	local move = ThemeStore.defaultsMove(saved, tonumber(pluginn:GetSetting("UIScale")))
	if move.theme == "clear" then
		pluginn:SetSetting("ThemeJSON", "")
	end
	if move.uiScale then
		pluginn:SetSetting("UIScale", move.uiScale)
		pluginn:SetSetting("UIScaleBase", C.BASE_UI_SCALE)
	end
	pluginn:SetSetting("ThemeDefaults", ThemeStore.DEFAULTS_VERSION)
end

return ThemeStore

-- The two tool decks (WidgetDeck): "Re:" holds the Size and Time pages (Resize / Retime),
-- "PropertyTools" Clipboard and Shifter. Page refs keep the panel names QOLWiring, SelectionHandler
-- and Actions read (ResizePanel is the Size page, and so on). Either deck splits into one panel per
-- page (DeckSplit). Sizes and content come from the mode's builders (ToolPanels.builders()).

local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local TP = require(script.Parent.ToolPanels)
local DeckPages = require(script.Parent.DeckPages)

local ToolDecks = {}

local function merge(into, refs)
	for key, value in pairs(refs) do into[key] = value end
end

function ToolDecks.build(sg, TypeRegistry)
	local refs = {}
	local builders = TP.builders()
	-- A size of the mode's deck layout, asked again when the layout changes (Relayout).
	local function sized(key)
		return function()
			return builders.deckLayout()[key]
		end
	end

	-- A page is labelled by its key and sized by the deck layout's entry of that name.
	local function pagesOf(deck)
		local pages = {}
		for _, key in ipairs(DeckPages[deck]) do
			table.insert(pages, { key = key, label = key, height = sized(key) })
		end
		return pages
	end

	local re = W.makeDeck(sg, {

--[[
	DeckPages  -  the tool deck pages (Resize, Retime, Clipboard, Shifter) laid out for the theme
	modes other than Classic. Each builder fills the page frame WidgetDeck hands in (the area under
	the deck's title bar) and returns the refs its Classic counterpart in ToolPanels returns.
	DeckPages.deckLayout() gives the deck widths and page heights these layouts need.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local ToolPanels = require(script.Parent.Parent.ToolPanels)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local DeckPages = {}

-- W.makeSlider's fixed height.
local SLIDER_HEIGHT = 28

-- Height of a deck whose page stacks `rows` rows plus `extra` pixels of other content.
local function deckHeight(rows, extra)
	local gaps = math.max(rows - 1, 0) * LAYOUT.RowGap
	return LAYOUT.TitleBar + LAYOUT.PanelPad * 2 + rows * LAYOUT.Row + gaps + extra
end

function DeckPages.deckLayout()
	local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
	local sliderBlock = SLIDER_HEIGHT + LAYOUT.RowGap
	return {
		ReWidth = sizes.ReDeck,
		ReMinWidth = sizes.ReDeckMin,
		ToolsWidth = sizes.PropertyToolsDeck,
		ToolsMinWidth = sizes.ReDeck,
		Size = deckHeight(3, sliderBlock),
		Time = deckHeight(2, sliderBlock),
		Clipboard = sizes.PropertyToolsHeight,
		Shifter = sizes.PropertyToolsHeight,
	}
end

-- A multiplier slider and the page's switches under it, with Apply / Reset held at the page's
-- bottom edge: a panel dragged shorter than its rows gives up the switches and keeps the buttons.
local function buildScalePage(page, switches)
	local rows = Instance.new("Frame")
	rows.Name = "Rows"
	rows.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.lay(rows, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap))
	end)
	rows.ClipsDescendants = true
	rows.Parent = page
	W.addListLayout(rows, "RowGap")

	local slider, input, setValue, getValue = W.makeSlider(rows, 0.5, 2, 1, nil, "%.2fx", true)
	slider.LayoutOrder = 0

	local toggles = {}
	for index, switch in ipairs(switches) do
		toggles[index] = W.makeSwitchRow(rows, switch.name, switch.label, index)
	end

	local buttons, buttonRow = W.makeButtonRow(page, "Buttons", {
		{ name = "Ap", text = "Apply" },
		{ name = "Rs", text = "Reset", role = "TextSecondary" },
	}, 0)
	buttonRow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	buttonRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)

	return {
		slider = slider, input = input, setValue = setValue, getValue = getValue,
		toggles = toggles, apply = buttons[1], reset = buttons[2],
	}
end

function DeckPages.buildResize(page)
	local parts = buildScalePage(page, {
		{ name = "ResDesc", label = "Include Descendants" },
		{ name = "ResShape", label = "Scale Spawn Area" },
	})
	-- A container is nearly always resized together with what is inside it.
	parts.toggles[1]:SetAttribute("IsOn", true)
	return {
		ResizeGetVal = parts.getValue, ResizeSetVal = parts.setValue, ResizeInput = parts.input,
		ResizeDescToggle = parts.toggles[1], ResizeScaleShapeToggle = parts.toggles[2],
		ResizeApply = parts.apply, ResizeReset = parts.reset,
		ResizeSlider = parts.slider, ResizePanel = page,
	}
end

function DeckPages.buildRetime(page)
	local parts = buildScalePage(page, {
		{ name = "RetDesc", label = "Include Descendants" },
	})
	parts.toggles[1]:SetAttribute("IsOn", true)
	return {
		RetimeGetVal = parts.getValue, RetimeSetVal = parts.setValue, RetimeInput = parts.input,
		RetimeDescToggle = parts.toggles[1],
		RetimeApply = parts.apply, RetimeReset = parts.reset,
		RetimeSlider = parts.slider, RetimePanel = page,
	}
end

-- The scrolling property list that fills a page from `top()` down (it follows the layout).
local function makeList(page, top)
	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "Scroll"
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.layProps(scroll, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top()), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -top()) }
	end)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scroll.Parent = page
	W.addListLayout(scroll, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, scroll)
	return scroll
end

function DeckPages.buildClipboard(page, TypeRegistry)
	local buttons = W.makeButtonRow(page, "Buttons", {
		{ name = "Cp", text = "Copy" },
		{ name = "Ps", text = "Paste" },
	}, 0)

	local function top()
		return LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap
	end
	local search, searchField = W.makeSearchField(page, "Search", "Search...")
	W.lay(searchField, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top())
	end)

	local scroll = makeList(page, function()
		return top() + LAYOUT.Search + LAYOUT.RowGap
	end)
	local groups = ToolPanels.fillClipboardList(scroll, search, TypeRegistry)
	return {
		ClipCopy = buttons[1], ClipPaste = buttons[2], ClipSearch = search,
		ClipboardPanel = page, ClipboardScroll = scroll, ClipboardGroups = groups,
	}
end

function DeckPages.buildShifter(page, TypeRegistry)
	local function step()
		return LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap
	end

	local input = W.makeTextField(page, "Shift", "1.0", Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

	local operations, operationRow = W.makeButtonRow(page, "Operations", {
		{ name = "Mul", text = "x" },
		{ name = "Div", text = "/" },
		{ name = "Add", text = "+" },
		{ name = "Sub", text = "-" },
	}, 0)
	W.lay(operationRow, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, step())
	end)

	local envelope, envelopeRow = W.makeSwitchRow(page, "Env", "Scale Envelope", 0)
	W.lay(envelopeRow, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, step() * 2)
	end)

	local search, searchField = W.makeSearchField(page, "Search", "Search...")
	W.lay(searchField, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, step() * 3)
	end)

	local scroll = makeList(page, function()
		return step() * 3 + LAYOUT.Search + LAYOUT.RowGap
	end)
	local groups = ToolPanels.fillShifterList(scroll, search, TypeRegistry)
	return {
		ShiftInput = input,
		ShiftMul = operations[1], ShiftDiv = operations[2], ShiftAdd = operations[3], ShiftSub = operations[4],
		EnvelopeToggle = envelope, ShiftSearch = search,
		ShifterPanel = page, ShifterScroll = scroll, ShifterGroups = groups,
	}
end

return DeckPages

function Panels.buildQMenu(sg)
	local rowCount = #TOOL_BUTTONS + 1

		return LAYOUT.TitleBar + LAYOUT.PanelPad * 2 + rowCount * LAYOUT.Row + (rowCount - 1) * LAYOUT.RowGap
	end

	local panel, bar = W.makeTitledPanel(sg, "QMenu", "Tools")

	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)

		return {

			Size = UDim2.new(0, sizes.Tools, 0, height()),

		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -LAYOUT.TitleBar) }

			return UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, 0)

function Panels.buildHueChanger(sg)
	local panel, chrome = W.makeToolShell(sg, "HueChanger", PanelSizes.of("Hue"), PanelSizes.of("HueHeight"))
	chrome.title.Text = "Hue"
	panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", "Hue")
	local body = chrome.body
	local refs = {}

	-- Under the tracks: one line of letters, the values (degrees, percent, percent), then
	-- Apply / Reset. Functions: they follow the layout (Relayout).
	local function letterHeight()
		return LAYOUT.Text + 4
	end
	local function readoutHeight()
		return LAYOUT.Row - 4
	end
	local function buttonBlock()
		return LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap
	end
	local function readoutBlock()
		return buttonBlock() + readoutHeight() + LAYOUT.RowGap
	end

	-- A value field: what its slider is set to, and a place to type an exact value.
	local function makeReadout(index, xScale)
		local field = W.makeBlob("Value" .. index, body, UDim2.new(1 / 3, -READOUT_GAP, 0, readoutHeight()))
		field.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		W.layProps(field, function()
			return { Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -READOUT_GAP, 0, readoutHeight()), Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 1, -buttonBlock()) }
		end)

		local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
		box.Name = "Box"
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		box.Text = "0"
		box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(box, "Caption")
		W.paint(box, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
		box.Parent = field
		W.wireFieldStates(field, box)
		return box
	end
	ToolPanels.buildHueSliders(body, refs, function()
		return letterHeight() + readoutBlock() + LAYOUT.RowGap
	end, 0, makeReadout)

	for index, letter in ipairs({ "H", "S", "V" }) do
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = letter
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = letter
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		W.layProps(label, function()
			return { Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, letterHeight()), Position = UDim2.new((index * 2 - 1) / 6, 0, 1, -readoutBlock()) }
		end)
		TypeScale.style(label, "Caption")
		W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
		label.Parent = body
	end

	local buttons, buttonRow = W.makeButtonRow(body, "Buttons", {
		{ name = "Ap", text = "Apply" },
		{ name = "Rs", text = "Reset", role = "TextSecondary" },
	}, 0)
	buttonRow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	buttonRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)

	refs.HueApply = buttons[1]
	refs.HueReset = buttons[2]
	refs.HuePanel = panel
	return refs
end

local function _makeSearchBox(parent, yPos)

	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; box.BorderSizePixel = 0; box.Parent = sb; return box

-- Matches at a word start; the query's pattern characters match literally.
local function _escapePattern(s) return (s:gsub("[%(%)%.%%%+%-%*%?%[%]%^%$]", "%%%1")) end
local function _labelMatches(label, q)
	local esc = _escapePattern(q)
	return label:sub(1, #q) == q or label:find("[%s_]" .. esc) ~= nil
end

-- Code that changes row visibility during a search (selection filter, type toggles) calls this, so
-- clearing the search snapshots the filtered state instead of restoring a stale one.
function ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)
	if searchBox then searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", true) end
end

function ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scrollFrame)
	if not searchBox or not scrollFrame then return end
	local _saved = {} -- {[frame] = wasVisible} before the search
	searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local query = searchBox.Text:lower()
		local isSearch = query ~= ""
		-- Marked dirty by invalidateSearchSnapshot: snapshot again from what shows now.
		if searchBox:GetAttribute("_savedDirty") then
			_saved = {}
			searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", nil)
		end
		-- The first search keystroke snapshots bodies and rows.
		if isSearch and next(_saved) == nil then
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Body" or d:GetAttribute("PropRow") or d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then _saved[d] = d.Visible end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then _saved[s] = s.Visible end end
		end
		if isSearch then
			local hits = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and d:GetAttribute("PropRow") then
					local lbl = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
					if lbl then
						-- SearchText: more names a row answers to (a Blender state's row: "State 3 Blender").
						local extra = d:GetAttribute("SearchText")
						local match = _saved[d] and (_labelMatches(lbl.Text:lower(), query) or (extra ~= nil and _labelMatches(extra:lower(), query)))
						d.Visible = match or false
						if match then local c = d.Parent; while c and c ~= scrollFrame do hits[c] = true; c = c.Parent end end
					end
				end
			end
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then d.Visible = hits[d] or false
				elseif d.Name == "Body" and d:IsA("Frame") then d.Visible = hits[d] or false end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then s.Visible = hits[s] or false end end
		else
			for d, vis in pairs(_saved) do d.Visible = vis end; _saved = {}
		end
		-- Section arrows follow their bodies.
		for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
			local hdr = d:IsA("Frame") and d:FindFirstChild("Header")
			if hdr then local ar = hdr:FindFirstChild("Arrow"); if ar then
				local body = d:FindFirstChild("Body"); if body then ar.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end
			end end
		end
	end)
end

	{name = "Motion", props = {"SpreadAngle", "Speed", "Acceleration", "Drag", "RotSpeed", "VelocityInheritance", "WindAffectsDrag"}},

}
local PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER = {
	{name = "Emission", props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "TimeScale", "EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
	{name = "Motion", props = {"SpreadAngle", "Speed", "Acceleration", "Drag", "RotSpeed", "VelocityInheritance"}},

	{name = "Flipbook", props = {"FlipbookFramerate"}},
}
ToolPanels.PE_SECTIONS = PE_SECTIONS

-- Value types the Shifter can scale (QOL.shiftItems dispatches on typeof).
local SHIFTABLE_TYPES = { number = true, NumberRange = true, NumberSequence = true, Vector2 = true, Vector3 = true, UDim2 = true }
-- Item-level emit timing has no TypeData entry; QOL shifts the item attributes directly.
local SHIFTABLE_ITEM_ATTRS = { EmitCount = true, EmitDelay = true, EmitDuration = true }

-- ClipShiftFix reads it as ToolPanels.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS.
local TYPE_ITEM_KEYS = PropertyCatalog.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS

local function _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)
	return PropertyCatalog.merge(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)
end

-- Filled during the build; ClipShiftFix reads them.
ToolPanels.propTypeMap = {}; ToolPanels.propTypeMapShifter = {}; ToolPanels.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS = TYPE_ITEM_KEYS

-- Fills the Clipboard list (every type's categories plus PE) and wires its search. Returns each
-- category's addGroup, where ClipShiftFix adds a selection's Blender states and decal layers.
function ToolPanels.fillClipboardList(scroll, searchBox, TypeRegistry)
	local merged, propTypeMap = _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS)
	ToolPanels.propTypeMap = propTypeMap
	local _, groups = W.buildPropToggles(scroll, merged, "Properties", 0, DISPLAY_NAMES)
	-- The All States row also answers to "blender".
	for _, row in ipairs(scroll:GetDescendants()) do
		if row:GetAttribute("PropKey") == "Blender" then row:SetAttribute("SearchText", "Blender") end
	end
	ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scroll)
	return groups
end

-- Fills the Shifter list: shiftable TypeData props, the item emit timing attrs and PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER.
function ToolPanels.fillShifterList(scroll, searchBox, TypeRegistry)
	local function shiftable(typeName, prop)
		if typeName == "PE" or SHIFTABLE_ITEM_ATTRS[prop] then return true end
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
		local def = typeDef and typeDef.properties and typeDef.properties[prop]
		return def ~= nil and SHIFTABLE_TYPES[def.type] == true
	end
	local merged, propTypeMap = _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER, nil, shiftable)
	ToolPanels.propTypeMapShifter = propTypeMap
	local _, groups = W.buildPropToggles(scroll, merged, "Properties", 0, DISPLAY_NAMES)
	ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scroll)
	return groups
end

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HANDLE_H = 8

-- The handle lands exactly on the neutral value within this many screen pixels of it.
local SNAP_PIXELS = 5

-- A vertical slider on a gradient. xScale: its place, 0-1. trackHeightTrim / trackTop: how much
-- shorter than `parent` the track is and where it starts. step: values are whole multiples of it.
-- Returns getVal, setVal, track, bindReadout(box, scale, suffix).
local function makeVSlider(parent, xScale, gradient, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, step)
	local track = Instance.new("Frame"); track.Name = "Track"; track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.layProps(track, function()
		return { Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 1, -W.measure(trackHeightTrim)), Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, W.measure(trackTop)) }
	end)
	track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); track.Parent = parent
	local cr = Instance.new("UICorner"); cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4); cr.Parent = track
	local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient"); gr.Rotation = 90; gr.Parent = track
	gr.Color = gradient
	local handle = Instance.new("Frame"); handle.Name = "Handle"; handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
	handle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); handle.Size = UDim2.new(1,4,0,HANDLE_H)
	handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
	-- White whatever the theme.
	handle:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	handle.ZIndex = 3; handle.Parent = track
	local hc = Instance.new("UICorner"); hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,3); hc.Parent = handle
	local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); hs.Color = Color3.new(0,0,0); hs.Thickness = 1; hs.Parent = handle

	local current = defaultVal
	local dragging = false
	local showValue = nil
	local lowest, highest = math.min(minVal, maxVal), math.max(minVal, maxVal)

	local function setVal(value)
		current = math.clamp(math.round(value / step) * step, lowest, highest)
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, (current - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0)
		if showValue then
			showValue()
		end
	end
	local function getVal()
		return current
	end

	local function setFromMouse(mouseY)
		local height = track.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local share = math.clamp((mouseY - track.AbsolutePosition.Y) / height, 0, 1)
		local neutral = (defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
		if math.abs(share - neutral) * height <= SNAP_PIXELS then
			share = neutral
		end
		setVal(minVal + share * (maxVal - minVal))
	end

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; btn.Text = ""
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); btn.ZIndex = 4; btn.Parent = track
	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
		end
	end)
	btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
	local connections = W.getUISConnections()
	table.insert(connections, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			setFromMouse(input.Position.Y)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFromMouse(UIS:GetMouseLocation().Y)
	end)

	local function bindReadout(box, scale, suffix)
		showValue = function()
			local shown = math.round(current * scale)
			box.Text = (shown == 0 and "0" or string.format("%+d", shown)) .. suffix
		end
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			-- Whatever is not part of a number goes: the suffix, a plus sign, spaces.
			local typed = tonumber((string.gsub(box.Text, "[^%d%.%-]", "")))
			if typed then
				setVal(typed / scale)
			else
				showValue()
			end
		end)
		showValue()
	end

	setVal(defaultVal)
	return getVal, setVal, track, bindReadout
end

local hueGrad = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.167, Color3.fromHSV(0.167,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.333, Color3.fromHSV(0.333,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHSV(0.5,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.667, Color3.fromHSV(0.667,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.833, Color3.fromHSV(0.833,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)),
})
-- Saturation, from white to full red.
local satGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1))})
local valGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0,0,0))})

-- The Hue, Saturation and Value sliders, get / set written into refs; whole degrees and percent.
-- The layout's makeReadout(index, xScale) -> TextBox shows each value and takes a typed one.
function ToolPanels.buildHueSliders(parent, refs, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, makeReadout)
	local sliders = {
		{ name = "Hue", gradient = hueGrad, min = -0.5, max = 0.5, step = 1 / 360, scale = 360, suffix = "\u{00B0}" },
		{ name = "Sat", gradient = satGrad, min = -1, max = 1, step = 0.01, scale = 100, suffix = "%" },
		{ name = "Val", gradient = valGrad, min = 1, max = -1, step = 0.01, scale = 100, suffix = "%" },
	}
	for index, slider in ipairs(sliders) do
		local xScale = (index * 2 - 1) / 6
		local getVal, setVal, _, bindReadout = makeVSlider(parent, xScale, slider.gradient, slider.min, slider.max, 0, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, slider.step)
		refs[slider.name .. "GetVal"] = getVal
		refs[slider.name .. "SetVal"] = setVal
		bindReadout(makeReadout(index, xScale), slider.scale, slider.suffix)
	end
end

--[[
	ToolShell  -  the frame of a floating tool panel: fixed size, resizable from its edges, with a
	header carrying the title, minimize (folds the panel into the HUD tray) and close. Loaded by
	Widgets.luau; adds to W:
	  makeToolPanel(sg, name, width, height) -> panel   the Classic shell: a boxed 18 px header in the
	                                                    padding, content at absolute offsets from y = 22
	                                                    (also a panel with no layout for the other modes)
	  makeToolShell(sg, name, width, height) -> panel, chrome   the current mode's shell
	  makeTitledPanel(sg, panelName, title) -> panel, bar   a modes' panel the caller sizes: padded, a
	                                                    title bar with two icon slots, close, dragged by the bar
	  toolChrome(panel) -> chrome of either:
	    header, title, close, minimize
	    body             parent for content: the panel in the Classic shell, else a frame under the title bar
	    bodyTop          y in body where content starts (22 in the Classic shell, else 0)
	    controlsWidth()  width the header's right buttons take now; grows with addButton
	    addButton(name, text, onClick) -> button placed left of the header buttons already there
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local BuildPacer = require(script.Parent.BuildPacer)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- The Classic shell's content top.
local CLASSIC_BODY_TOP = 22
local CLASSIC_CONTROLS = 30
local CLASSIC_BUTTON = 18

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addStroke, addPadding = W.addCorner, W.addStroke, W.addPadding

	-- A bare text button for a header's right end (addButton places and paints it).
	local function headerButton(buttonName, text)
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Name = buttonName
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		button.Text = text
		return button
	end

	-- Panel -> chrome. Weak keys: a destroyed panel drops its entry.
	local chromeOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	function W.toolChrome(panel)
		return chromeOf[panel]
	end

	function W.makeToolPanel(sg, name, w, h)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = name.."Panel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,w,0,h); panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Visible = false; panel.Parent = sg
		addCorner(panel, "Big"); addStroke(panel); addPadding(panel,5,5,5,5)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		local hd = W.makeBlob("Hd", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,18)); hd.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); hd.ZIndex = 10
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel"); t.BackgroundTransparency = 1; t.Text = name
		t.TextColor3 = T.Gold; t.Font = T.Font; t.TextSize = 10; t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		t.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0); t.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); t.Parent = hd
		local cb = Instance.new("TextButton"); cb.Name = "Close"; cb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cb.Text = "X"; cb.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; cb.Font = T.Font; cb.TextSize = 9
		cb.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); cb.Position = UDim2.new(1,-14,0,0); cb.ZIndex = 12; cb.Parent = hd
		cb.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end)
		-- Minimize folds the panel into the HUD tray (WidgetDeck.collapsePanel); its chip brings it back.
		local mb = Instance.new("TextButton"); mb.Name = "Min"; mb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		mb.Text = "\u{2013}"; mb.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; mb.Font = T.Font; mb.TextSize = 9
		mb.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); mb.Position = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,0); mb.ZIndex = 12; mb.Parent = hd
		mb.Activated:Connect(function() if W.collapsePanel then W.collapsePanel(panel) end end)
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", name)
		local dg = Instance.new("TextButton"); dg.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dg.Text = ""
		dg.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0); dg.ZIndex = 11; dg.Parent = hd; W.makeDraggable(panel, dg)
		W.makeResizable(panel, math.max(w, 80), 40)

		-- added: the buttons addButton placed left of close and minimize.
		local chrome = {
			header = hd, title = t, close = cb, minimize = mb,
			body = panel, bodyTop = CLASSIC_BODY_TOP, added = 0,
		}
		function chrome.controlsWidth()
			return CLASSIC_CONTROLS + chrome.added * CLASSIC_BUTTON
		end
		function chrome.addButton(buttonName, text, onClick)
			local button = headerButton(buttonName, text)
			button.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
			button.Font = T.Font
			button.TextSize = 7
			button.Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASSIC_BUTTON, 1, 0)
			button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(chrome.controlsWidth() + CLASSIC_BUTTON), 0, 0)
			button.ZIndex = 12
			button.Parent = hd
			button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
			table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
				button.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
			end)
			chrome.added += 1
			return button
		end
		chromeOf[panel] = chrome
		return panel
	end

	function W.makeTitledPanel(sg, panelName, title)
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = panelName
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ClipsDescendants = true
		panel.Active = true
		panel.Visible = false
		panel.Parent = sg
		addCorner(panel, "Big")
		addStroke(panel)
		addPadding(panel, "PanelPad", "PanelPad", "PanelPad", "PanelPad")
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)

		local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, title, 0)
		TypeScale.style(bar.title, "Group")
		W.lay(bar.title, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot * 2, 1, 0)
		end)
		bar.close.Activated:Connect(function()
			panel.Visible = false
		end)
		W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)
		return panel, bar
	end

	-- Outside Classic: a full-width title bar and a body frame under it. width / height: numbers or
	-- layout functions.
	local function makeModernShell(sg, name, width, height)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local measure = W.measure

		local panel, bar = W.makeTitledPanel(sg, name .. "Panel", name)
		W.lay(panel, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(0, measure(width), 0, measure(height))
		end)
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", name)
		bar.header.Name = "Hd"

		local minimize = Instance.new("TextButton")
		minimize.Name = "Min"
		minimize.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		minimize.Text = "\u{2013}"
		W.layProps(minimize, function()
			return { Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot * 2, 0, 0) }
		end)
		minimize.ZIndex = 3
		TypeScale.style(minimize, "Glyph")
		W.paint(minimize, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		minimize.Parent = bar.header
		minimize.Activated:Connect(function()
			if W.collapsePanel then
				W.collapsePanel(panel)
			end
		end)

		-- One panel padding below the title bar.
		local body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "ToolBody"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		W.layProps(body, function()
			return { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -LAYOUT.TitleBar) }
		end)
		body.Parent = panel

		W.makeResizable(panel, math.max(measure(width), 80), LAYOUT.TitleBar + LAYOUT.PanelPad)

		-- controls: how many icon slots the header's right end holds (close and minimize first).
		local chrome = {
			header = bar.header, title = bar.title, close = bar.close, minimize = minimize,
			body = body, bodyTop = 0, controls = 2,
		}
		-- The width of the header's controls (DeckSplit and decks lay chips beside them).
		function chrome.controlsWidth()
			return chrome.controls * LAYOUT.IconSlot
		end
		function chrome.addButton(buttonName, text, onClick)
			local button = headerButton(buttonName, text)
			local place = chrome.controls
			W.layProps(button, function()
				return { Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -(place + 1) * LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, 0) }
			end)
			button.ZIndex = 3
			TypeScale.style(button, "Caption")
			W.paint(button, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
			button.Parent = bar.header
			button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
			chrome.controls += 1
			return button
		end
		chromeOf[panel] = chrome
		return panel
	end

	function W.makeToolShell(sg, name, width, height)
		local panel
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, name, W.measure(width), W.measure(height))
		else
			panel = makeModernShell(sg, name, width, height)
		end
		return panel, chromeOf[panel]
	end
end

--[[
	TypeScale  -  fonts and text sizes for the plugin UI.
	  TypeScale.style(inst, role)    font, weight and size for a text role.
	  TypeScale.adopt(inst)          maps text built with a literal size onto the theme's sizes.
	  TypeScale.watch(screenGui)     adopts text as it is created; returns the connection.
	  TypeScale.reapply(screenGui)   restyles every text object (theme font change).
	Roles: Title, Type, Group, Label, LabelSmall, Value, Number, Button, Glyph, Chevron, Caption, Chip,
	Display.
	The Classic mode keeps each builder's own size and draws all text in the theme font.
	Attributes: `_typeRole` names the role (or a Legacy kind for adopted text); `_baseTextSize`
	keeps the literal size adopt() saw first. See RESERVED_ATTRS.md.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local TypeScale = {}

-- Text smaller than this is never drawn; it is also the caption size in both text sizes.
local CAPTION_SIZE = 12

-- size: LAYOUT key. weight / family: MODE.Structure keys. bump: added to the size. bold / fixedWeight:
-- a weight alike in every mode. floor: the least size (else the caption size). family "Soft": the
-- chip face. font: Custom's font for the role (MODE.Fonts).
local ROLES = {
	Title = { size = "TitleText", weight = "TitleWeight", family = "TitleFont", font = "title" },
	Type = { size = "TypeText", weight = "TypeWeight", family = "TypeFont", font = "type" },
	Group = { size = "GroupText", weight = "GroupWeight", font = "group" },
	Label = { size = "Text", weight = "LabelWeight", font = "label" },
	-- A row label too long for its column: caption size, wrapped (Widgets.fitRowLabel).
	LabelSmall = { weight = "LabelWeight", font = "label" },
	Value = { size = "Text", weight = "ValueWeight", font = "value" },
	Number = { size = "Text", weight = "ValueWeight", family = "NumberFont", font = "number" },
	Button = { size = "Text" },
	Glyph = { size = "TitleText" },
	Chevron = { size = "TitleText", bump = 4, bold = true },
	-- A filled triangle chevron: a solid glyph fills its em, so it sits under the caption size.
	Triangle = { size = "Text", bump = -4, floor = 8 },
	Caption = {},
	-- A chip's word: three under the body size, never under the caption size (12 and 13).
	Chip = { size = "Text", bump = -3, family = "Soft", fixedWeight = Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold },
	-- A window's headline (the licence reminder's golden rule): the title face, bold, eight over it.
	Display = { size = "TitleText", bump = 8, family = "TitleFont", bold = true, font = "title" },
}

local function isText(inst)
	return inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextBox")
end

-- Skin's `_Skin...` copies follow their widget's text; styled on their own they would scale twice.
local function isSkinCopy(inst)
	return string.sub(inst.Name, 1, 5) == "_Skin"
end

local CLASSIC_SIZES = { Title = 12, Type = 11, Group = 11, Label = 10, LabelSmall = 10, Value = 10, Number = 11, Button = 11, Glyph = 14, Chevron = 8, Triangle = 8, Caption = 9, Chip = 9, Display = 18 }

local function fontFor(role)
	local structure = C.MODE.Structure
	local weight = role.fixedWeight or (role.weight and structure[role.weight]) or Enum.FontWeight.Medium
	if role.bold then
		weight = Enum.FontWeight.Bold
	end
	-- Custom's own font for the role; other roles draw as below (with Custom's body font).
	local own = role.font and C.MODE.Fonts and C.MODE.Fonts[role.font]
	if own then
		return Font.new(own, weight)
	end
	if role.family == "Soft" then
		return C.softFont(weight)
	end
	local family = role.family and structure[role.family] or "Body"
	if family == "Theme" then
		return C.themeFont(weight)
	end
	if family == "Mono" then
		return C.monoFont(Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
	end
	return C.bodyFont(weight)
end

function TypeScale.style(inst, roleName)
	local role = ROLES[roleName]
	inst:SetAttribute("_typeRole", roleName)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		inst.Font = C.T.Font
		inst.TextSize = CLASSIC_SIZES[roleName]
		return
	end
	inst.FontFace = fontFor(role)
	inst.TextSize = math.max(role.floor or CAPTION_SIZE, (role.size and LAYOUT[role.size] or CAPTION_SIZE) + (role.bump or 0))
end

-- Legacy kinds, decided once from how the text was built; theme-font text is ordinary text.
local function legacyKind(inst, baseSize)
	local own = inst.Font ~= C.T.Font
	if own and (inst.Font == Enum.Font.Code or inst.Font == Enum.Font.RobotoMono) then
		return "LegacyMono"
	end
	if own and inst.Font == Enum.Font.GothamBold then
		return "LegacyBold"
	end
	if inst:IsA("TextLabel") and baseSize >= 12 then
		return "LegacyTitle"
	end
	return "Legacy"
end

local function legacyFont(kind)
	if kind == "LegacyMono" then
		return C.monoFont(Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
	end
	if kind == "LegacyBold" then
		return C.bodyFont(Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
	end
	if kind == "LegacyTitle" then
		return C.themeFont(C.MODE.Structure.TitleWeight)
	end
	return C.bodyFont(Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
end

-- Titles in panels laid out for literal sizes: their boxes cannot take a larger size.
local LEGACY_TITLE_SIZE = 16

-- Literal sizes fall into three bands: captions, body text and titles.
local function legacySize(baseSize)
	if baseSize <= 9 then
		return CAPTION_SIZE
	end
	if baseSize <= 11 then
		return LAYOUT.Text
	end
	return LEGACY_TITLE_SIZE
end

function TypeScale.adopt(inst)
	local kind = inst:GetAttribute("_typeRole")
	if (kind ~= nil and ROLES[kind]) or isSkinCopy(inst) then
		return
	end
	-- Classic: the builder already used the theme font and its own size.
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return
	end
	local baseSize = inst:GetAttribute("_baseTextSize")
	if baseSize == nil then
		baseSize = inst.TextSize
		inst:SetAttribute("_baseTextSize", baseSize)
	end
	if kind == nil then
		kind = legacyKind(inst, baseSize)
		inst:SetAttribute("_typeRole", kind)
	end
	inst.FontFace = legacyFont(kind)
	inst.TextSize = legacySize(baseSize)
end

-- Deferred so the builder finishes setting its literal size before it is read.
function TypeScale.watch(screenGui)
	return screenGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
		if isText(inst) then
			task.defer(TypeScale.adopt, inst)
		end
	end)
end

function TypeScale.reapply(screenGui)
	local classic = C.MODE.Structure.Classic
	for _, inst in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if isText(inst) and not isSkinCopy(inst) then
			local kind = inst:GetAttribute("_typeRole")
			if classic then
				if not inst:GetAttribute("_noFontOverride") then
					inst.Font = C.T.Font
				end
			elseif kind ~= nil and ROLES[kind] then
				TypeScale.style(inst, kind)
			else
				TypeScale.adopt(inst)
			end
		end
	end
end

return TypeScale

--[[
	UISound  -  the theme's UI sounds: a click on any button of the plugin UI, a toggle switched, a
	panel opened or closed, the pointer over a button. Played as Sounds under the plugin's audio
	widget (Part/VisualHost.getEditAudioHost, a DockWidgetPluginGui): Studio plays a plugin's Sounds
	in edit mode reliably only there. Without that widget (a game) no sound is made.
	  UISound.watch(screenGui, themed)  listens to that UI while the theme's sounds are on: every
	                                    GuiButton (a toggle, one with `IsOn`, sounds `toggle`), the
	                                    panels of `themed` (`Visible`), and what is added later
	  UISound.refresh()                 the theme changed: sounds, volume and listening follow it
	  UISound.play(event)               plays an event's sound now (ThemeSchema.SOUND_EVENTS)
	A click and a toggle answer Activated, which only the user's input fires. Off (the default)
	nothing listens. One event sounds once a frame at most; a sound not loaded yet is skipped. The
	Sounds live under the widget: never in the place, never saved.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.ThemeSchema)
local InstanceMap = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.InstanceMap)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.VisualHost)
local T = C.T

local UISound = {}

local screen = nil
local themedLists = nil
-- The theme's Sounds, under the audio widget.
local folder = nil
local players = {}
local lastPlayed = {}
-- Widget -> its listening connections; a destroyed widget's go with it.
local hooked = InstanceMap.new()
local addedConnection = nil

local function setting(field)
	return ThemeSchema.value(T.Doc, "sound." .. field)
end

-- What a sound setting plays: Studio's own file for a name, else the asset id itself.
local function assetOf(value)
	return ThemeSchema.SOUND_FILES[value] or value
end

local function dropPlayers()
	for event, player in pairs(players) do
		player:Destroy()
		players[event] = nil
	end
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
		folder = nil
	end
end

-- One Sound per event with a sound, loading ahead so a click is heard at once.
local function buildPlayers()
	dropPlayers()
	local host = VisualHost.getEditAudioHost()
	if not host then
		return
	end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "_UISounds"
	folder.Archivable = false
	folder.Parent = host
	local volume = setting("volume") / 100
	for _, event in ipairs(ThemeSchema.SOUND_EVENTS) do
		local value = setting(event)
		if value ~= "" then
			local player = Instance.new("Sound")
			player.Name = event
			player.SoundId = assetOf(value)
			player.Volume = volume
			player.Parent = folder
			players[event] = player
		end
	end
end

function UISound.play(event)
	local player = players[event]
	if not player or not player.IsLoaded then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPlayed[event] and now - lastPlayed[event] < 1 / 60 then
		return
	end
	lastPlayed[event] = now
	player.TimePosition = 0
	player:Play()
end

-- A button sounds on a press (a toggle's as `toggle`, told by IsOn at the press, as it is set after
-- parenting) and on the pointer coming over it.
local function hook(inst)
	if hooked:get(inst) or not inst:IsA("GuiButton") then
		return
	end
	hooked:set(inst, {
		inst.Activated:Connect(function()
			UISound.play(inst:GetAttribute("IsOn") ~= nil and "toggle" or "click")
		end),
		inst.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			UISound.play("hover")
		end),
	})
end

local function hookPanel(panel)
	if hooked:get(panel) then
		return
	end
	hooked:set(panel, { panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		UISound.play(panel.Visible and "open" or "close")
	end) })
end

local function unhookAll()
	for _, connections in pairs(hooked.values) do
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	hooked:clear()
	if addedConnection then
		addedConnection:Disconnect()
		addedConnection = nil
	end
end

local function listen()
	if addedConnection or not screen then
		return
	end
	for _, desc in ipairs(screen:GetDescendants()) do
		hook(desc)
	end
	for _, panel in ipairs(themedLists and themedLists.panels or {}) do
		hookPanel(panel)
	end
	addedConnection = screen.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)
end

function UISound.refresh()
	if not screen then
		return
	end
	if setting("on") then
		buildPlayers()
		listen()
	else
		unhookAll()
		dropPlayers()
	end
end

function UISound.watch(screenGui, themed)
	unhookAll()
	dropPlayers()
	screen = screenGui
	themedLists = themed
	UISound.refresh()
end

return UISound
