--[[
	Axis widget factories (graph rows, input rows, inline axis selectors). Loaded by Widgets.luau;
	adds them to W.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- The theme's colour for an axis, read at call time: each mode sets its own (Constants.refresh).
local function axisColor(axis)
	return T["Axis" .. axis] or T.MutedGold
end

-- A muted tint of an axis colour, for the selected state.
local function axisSelectedBg(color)
	local h, s, v = color:ToHSV()
	return Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(s * 0.6, 1), v * 0.25)
end

-- How much of the axis colour a selected pill's fill takes, and how thick the leading axis's ring is.
local SELECTED_TINT = 0.35
local LEADER_RING = 2

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addStroke = W.addCorner, W.addStroke
	-- Cross-file: ThemeApply's axis-button repaint reads each registered { btn, color, selBg } and the
	-- button's `_selected` (set by the makeInlineAxis* below) to pick the selected paint.
	local function trackAxis(btn, color, selBg)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().axisButtons, {btn = btn, color = color, selBg = selBg})
		-- The ring the leading axis wears outside Classic, named SelectedStroke so paintAxis and
		-- makeInlineAxisGraphSelect tell the looks apart. Made and dropped with the structure (Relayout).
		W.layEach(btn, function()
			local outline = btn:FindFirstChild("SelectedStroke")
			if C.MODE.Structure.AxisOutline and not outline then
				outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
				outline.Name = "SelectedStroke"
				outline.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
				outline.Thickness = LEADER_RING
				W.paint(outline, "Color", "BrightGold")
				outline.Enabled = false
				outline.Parent = btn
				-- The plain look's leading stroke goes with it.
				local plain = btn:FindFirstChild("PrimaryStroke")
				if plain then
					plain:Destroy()
				end
			elseif not C.MODE.Structure.AxisOutline and outline then
				outline:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Paints an axis pill. state: true on, false off, nil mixed. Outside Classic the leading axis
	-- (`_primary`) alone takes a solid axis fill and a ring in the text colour.
	local function paintAxis(button, color, selBg, state)
		local outline = button:FindFirstChild("SelectedStroke")
		if not state then
			button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			button.TextColor3 = state == nil and T.MutedGold or T.DarkGold
			if outline then
				outline.Enabled = false
			end
			return
		end
		if not outline then
			button.BackgroundColor3 = selBg
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
			button.TextColor3 = color
			return
		end
		local live = T["Axis" .. button.Text] or color
		local primary = button:GetAttribute("_primary") == true
		button.BackgroundColor3 = primary and live or T.Field:Lerp(live, SELECTED_TINT)
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		button.TextColor3 = primary and T.Panel or live
		outline.Color = T.BrightGold
		outline.Enabled = primary
	end
	-- ThemeApply repaints every registered pill through this after a theme change.
	W.paintAxisButton = paintAxis

	function W.makeAxisGraphRow(parent, axis, color, order, withCheckbox)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = axis.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		local xOffset = 18
		local checkbox = nil

		if withCheckbox then
			checkbox = Instance.new("TextButton"); checkbox.Name = "Checkbox"; checkbox.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			checkbox.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; checkbox.Text = ""; checkbox.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,0,14)
			checkbox.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0.5,-7); checkbox.BorderSizePixel = 0; checkbox.AutoButtonColor = false
			checkbox.Parent = row; addCorner(checkbox, UDim.new(0,3)); addStroke(checkbox)
			local checkMark = Instance.new("TextLabel"); checkMark.Name = "Mark"; checkMark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			checkMark.Text = ""; checkMark.TextColor3 = color; checkMark.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; checkMark.TextSize = 10
			checkMark.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); checkMark.Parent = checkbox
			table.insert(W.getThemed().axisColored, { inst = checkMark, prop = "TextColor3", axis = axis })
			row:SetAttribute("Checked", false)
			checkbox.Activated:Connect(function()
				local checked = not row:GetAttribute("Checked"); row:SetAttribute("Checked", checked)
				checkMark.Text = checked and "✓" or ""
				checkbox.BackgroundColor3 = checked and T.Selected or T.BlobBg
			end)
			xOffset = 34 -- past the checkbox
		end

		local axLbl = Instance.new("TextButton"); axLbl.Name = "AxisLabel"; axLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		axLbl.Text = axis; axLbl.TextColor3 = color; axLbl.Font = T.Font; axLbl.TextSize = 11
		axLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,1,0); axLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, xOffset - 18, 0, 0); axLbl.Parent = row
		if withCheckbox then axLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0) end

		local gBtn, gFrame, selLbl = W.makeSelectButton(axis, nil, color)
		gFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,xOffset,0,0); gFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,-xOffset,1,0); gFrame.Parent = row
		return {row = row, axisBtn = axLbl, graphBtn = gBtn, graphFrame = gFrame, selectLabel = selLbl, checkbox = checkbox}
	end

	function W.makeAxisInputRow(parent, axis, color, order, placeholder)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = axis.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent
		local axLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); axLbl.Name = "AxisLabel"; axLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		axLbl.Text = axis; axLbl.TextColor3 = color; axLbl.Font = T.Font; axLbl.TextSize = 11
		axLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,1,0); axLbl.Parent = row
		local wrap = W.makeBlob("InputWrap", row, UDim2.new(1,-18,1,0)); wrap.Position = UDim2.new(0,18,0,0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Input"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tb.Text = "0, 0"; tb.PlaceholderText = placeholder or "min, max"
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 10
		tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = wrap
		return {row = row, input = tb}
	end

	-- axis_select: [Label] [X][Y][Z] [Edit] [...], for graph properties.
	function W.makeInlineAxisSelect(parent, key, axes, order)

		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = key.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		local axBtns = {}
		local selected = {}
		local _onSelChanged = nil
		local btnWidth = LAYOUT.AxisPill
		for i, axis in ipairs(axes) do
			local color = axisColor(axis)
			local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
			local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = axis.."Btn"
			ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
			ab.Size = UDim2.new(0,btnWidth,0,btnWidth); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i-1)*(btnWidth+2), 0.5, -btnWidth/2)
			ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = row
			addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0,3))
			selected[axis] = false
			ab:SetAttribute("_selected", false)
			ab.Activated:Connect(function()
				selected[axis] = not selected[axis]
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", selected[axis])
				paintAxis(ab, color, selBg, selected[axis])
				if _onSelChanged then _onSelChanged() end
			end)
			trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
			axBtns[axis] = ab
		end

		local editOffset = #axes * (btnWidth + 2) + 2
		local editBtn, editFrame, editLbl, dotsBtn = W.makeSelectButton(key, nil, T.MutedGold)
		editFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, editOffset, 0, 0)
		editFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -editOffset, 1, 0); editFrame.Parent = row

		local function getSelected()
			local result = {}
			for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
				if selected[axis] then table.insert(result, key..axis) end
			end
			return result
		end

		local function setOnSelectionChanged(fn) _onSelChanged = fn end

		return {row = row, axisButtons = axBtns, editBtn = editBtn, editFrame = editFrame,
			selectLabel = editLbl, dotsBtn = dotsBtn, getSelected = getSelected, setOnSelectionChanged = setOnSelectionChanged}
	end

	-- axis_graph_select: [Label] [X][Y][Z] [value] [...], for graph-style axis properties.
	function W.makeInlineAxisGraphSelect(parent, key, axes, order)

		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = key.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		local axBtns = {}
		-- Click order: selectedOrder[1] is the primary axis, whose graph the shared field shows.
		local selectedOrder = {}
		local _onSelChanged = nil
		local btnWidth = LAYOUT.AxisPill
		local primaryStrokes = {} -- made on demand

		local function updatePrimaryIndicator()
			for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
				local ab = axBtns[axis]
				if not ab then continue end
				if ab:FindFirstChild("SelectedStroke") then
					ab:SetAttribute("_primary", selectedOrder[1] == axis)
					local color = axisColor(axis)
					paintAxis(ab, color, axisSelectedBg(color), ab:GetAttribute("_selected") == true)
					continue
				end
				local stroke = primaryStrokes[axis]
				if selectedOrder[1] == axis then
					-- Primary: a bright stroke, made again if a ring look dropped it.
					if not stroke or stroke.Parent ~= ab then
						stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Name = "PrimaryStroke"
						stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
						stroke.Thickness = 1.5; stroke.Parent = ab
						primaryStrokes[axis] = stroke
					end
					stroke.Color = axisColor(axis)
					stroke.Transparency = 0.2
					stroke.Enabled = true
				else
					if stroke then stroke.Enabled = false end
				end
			end
		end

		for i, axis in ipairs(axes) do
			local color = axisColor(axis)
			local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
			local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = axis.."Btn"
			ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
			ab.Size = UDim2.new(0,btnWidth,0,btnWidth); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i-1)*(btnWidth+2), 0.5, -btnWidth/2)
			ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = row
			addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0,3))
			ab:SetAttribute("_selected", false)
			ab.Activated:Connect(function()
				local wasSelected = false
				for j, a in ipairs(selectedOrder) do
					if a == axis then table.remove(selectedOrder, j); wasSelected = true; break end
				end
				if not wasSelected then
					table.insert(selectedOrder, axis)
				end
				local isOn = not wasSelected
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", isOn)
				paintAxis(ab, color, selBg, isOn)
				updatePrimaryIndicator()
				if _onSelChanged then _onSelChanged() end
			end)
			trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
			axBtns[axis] = ab
		end

		-- The more button, then the TextBox, in Widgets.makeGraphRow's order.
		local editOffset = #axes * (btnWidth + 2) + 2
		local blob = W.makeBlob(key.."Graph", row, UDim2.new(1,-editOffset,1,0))
		blob.Position = UDim2.new(0, editOffset, 0, 0)
		local input = Instance.new("TextBox"); input.Name = key.."Input"; input.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		input.Text = ""; input.PlaceholderText = ""
		input.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; input.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; input.Font = T.Font; input.TextSize = 11
		input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; input.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		input.Size = UDim2.new(1,-22,1,0); input.Position = UDim2.new(0,18,0,0); input.BorderSizePixel = 0; input.Parent = blob
		local dotsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); dotsBtn.Name = "DotsBtn"; dotsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dotsBtn.Text = "\u{22EF}"; dotsBtn.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; dotsBtn.TextTransparency = 0; dotsBtn.Font = T.Font; dotsBtn.TextSize = 14
		dotsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,18,1,0); dotsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
		dotsBtn.ZIndex = 3; dotsBtn.Parent = blob

		local function getSelected()
			local result = {}
			for _, axis in ipairs(selectedOrder) do
				table.insert(result, key..axis)
			end
			return result
		end

		local function getPrimary()
			if #selectedOrder > 0 then return key..selectedOrder[1] end
			return nil
		end

		local function setOnSelectionChanged(fn) _onSelChanged = fn end

		return {row = row, axisButtons = axBtns, input = input, dotsBtn = dotsBtn,
			getSelected = getSelected, getPrimary = getPrimary, setOnSelectionChanged = setOnSelectionChanged}
	end

	-- axis_input: [Label] [X][Y][Z] [input], for value properties. evenAttrs (optional): each pill gets
	-- a dot toggling that config attribute, wired through `evenButtons` (PropertyInputs).
	function W.makeInlineAxisInput(parent, key, axes, order, placeholder, evenAttrs)

		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = key.."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight); row.LayoutOrder = order or 0; row.Parent = parent

		local axBtns = {}
		local evenBtns = {}
		local selected = {}
		local _onSelChanged = nil
		local btnWidth = LAYOUT.AxisPill
		for i, axis in ipairs(axes) do
			local color = axisColor(axis)
			local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
			local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = axis.."Btn"
			ab.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
			ab.Size = UDim2.new(0,btnWidth,0,btnWidth); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i-1)*(btnWidth+2), 0.5, -btnWidth/2)
			ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = row
			addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0,3))
			selected[axis] = false
			ab:SetAttribute("_selected", false)
			ab.Activated:Connect(function()
				selected[axis] = not selected[axis]
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", selected[axis])
				paintAxis(ab, color, selBg, selected[axis])
				if _onSelChanged then _onSelChanged() end
			end)
			trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
			axBtns[axis] = ab

			-- A child of the pill, a ZIndex above; a click flips `_even`, which the connector writes to config.
			if evenAttrs and evenAttrs[axis] then
				local dot = Instance.new("TextButton"); dot.Name = "Even"
				dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5); dot.Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 1)
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = T.DarkGold; dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
				dot.Text = ""; dot.BorderSizePixel = 0; dot.AutoButtonColor = false
				dot.ZIndex = (ab.ZIndex or 1) + 1; dot.Parent = ab
				addCorner(dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
				dot:SetAttribute("_even", false)
				dot:SetAttribute("_evenAttr", evenAttrs[axis])
				dot:SetAttribute("_axis", axis)
				evenBtns[axis] = dot
				table.insert(W.getThemed().evenDots, dot)
			end
		end

		local inputOffset = #axes * (btnWidth + 2) + 2
		local inputWrap = W.makeBlob("InputWrap", row, UDim2.new(1,-inputOffset,1,0))
		inputWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, inputOffset, 0, 0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Input"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tb.Text = ""; tb.PlaceholderText = placeholder or "value"
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 10
		tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = inputWrap

		local function getSelected()
			local result = {}
			for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
				if selected[axis] then table.insert(result, key..axis) end
			end
			return result
		end

		local function setOnSelectionChanged(fn) _onSelChanged = fn end

		return {row = row, axisButtons = axBtns, evenButtons = evenBtns, input = tb,
			getSelected = getSelected, setOnSelectionChanged = setOnSelectionChanged}
	end

	-- link_axes: [Label] Pos [X][Y][Z]  Rot [X][Y][Z], toggles kept on the items' attributes; groups =
	-- { {prefix, attrs = {X = attrName, ...}}, ... }; Populate repaints through setState(attrName, state).
	function W.makeInlineAxisToggle(parent, key, groups)
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame"); frame.Name = key.."Toggles"; frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight); frame.Parent = parent
		local buttons = {}
		local paint = {}
		local x = 0
		local classic = C.MODE.Structure.Classic
		local PREFIX = 24
		local GROUP_GAP = 6
		for groupIndex, group in ipairs(groups) do
			-- Classic places prefixes and pills at fixed offsets; other modes give each group an equal share.
			local holder = frame
			if not classic then
				holder = Instance.new("Frame"); holder.Name = group.prefix; holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				holder.Size = UDim2.new(1 / #groups, -GROUP_GAP, 1, 0)
				holder.Position = UDim2.new((groupIndex - 1) / #groups, 0, 0, 0); holder.Parent = frame
				x = 0
			end
			local prefix = Instance.new("TextLabel"); prefix.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			prefix.Text = group.prefix; prefix.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; prefix.Font = T.Font; prefix.TextSize = 9
			prefix.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			prefix.Size = UDim2.new(0, PREFIX, 1, 0); prefix.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0); prefix.Parent = holder
			x += PREFIX
			for axisIndex, axis in ipairs({"X", "Y", "Z"}) do
				local attrName = group.attrs[axis]
				local color = axisColor(axis)
				local selBg = axisSelectedBg(color)
				local ab = Instance.new("TextButton"); ab.Name = attrName
				ab.BackgroundColor3 = selBg; ab.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
				ab.Text = axis; ab.TextColor3 = color; ab.Font = T.Font; ab.TextSize = 10
				ab.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.AxisPill, 0, LAYOUT.AxisPill); ab.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, -LAYOUT.AxisPill / 2)
				if not classic then
					-- A third of what the prefix leaves, never wider than a normal pill.
					local slot = (axisIndex - 1) / 3
					ab.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -(PREFIX / 3 + 2), 0, LAYOUT.AxisPill)
					ab.Position = UDim2.new(slot, PREFIX * (1 - slot), 0.5, -LAYOUT.AxisPill / 2)
					local limit = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
					limit.MaxSize = Vector2.new(LAYOUT.AxisPill, LAYOUT.AxisPill)
					limit.Parent = ab
				end
				ab.BorderSizePixel = 0; ab.AutoButtonColor = false; ab.Parent = holder
				addCorner(ab, UDim.new(0, 3))
				ab:SetAttribute("_selected", true)
				trackAxis(ab, color, selBg)
				paintAxis(ab, color, selBg, true)
				buttons[attrName] = ab
				paint[attrName] = function(state)
					ab:SetAttribute("_selected", state == true)
					paintAxis(ab, color, selBg, state)
				end
				x += LAYOUT.AxisPill + 2
			end
			x += GROUP_GAP
		end
		local function setState(attrName, state)
			local fn = paint[attrName]
			if fn then fn(state) end
		end
		return { frame = frame, buttons = buttons, setState = setState }
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetDeck  -  mixin on Widgets: tool decks (several tool pages under one header, tabs sliding
	them into view), the tray of collapsed panels under the HUD, and auto-tidy (selection tools fold
	into the tray while nothing is selected and come back on selection).
	W.makeDeck(sg, spec) -> { Frame, Pages = { key = frame }, api, Solos }
	  spec = { name, title?, titleWidth?, trayTitle?, width, minWidth?, fitWidth?, pages = { { key, label, height }, ... } }
	  width, minWidth (default width; how narrow the pages may get) and a page's height: a number or
	  a layout function; a deck the user resized keeps its size. fitWidth: the deck opens as narrow as
	  it may be dragged (its tabs, title and buttons, never under minWidth), width still bounding it.
	  api = show(key?), hide(), toggle(key?), setTab(key, animate?), activeKey(), onShow(fn(key)),
	        onHide(fn(key)), onTabChange(fn(fromKey, toKey)); setSplit(on), isSplit(), solos() (DeckSplit)
	  Page frames fill the shell's body (ToolShell): in Classic the whole panel (builders start at
	  y = 22), else the area under the title bar. A hidden deck hides every page, so `page.Visible`
	  means "on screen" (QOLWiring and SelectionHandler read it). The deck frame's ActiveTab attribute
	  is saved by PanelPersistence; a page's height follows the user's resizes while it is active.
	W.makeTray(hud)                   the chip row under the HUD; once a UI, before its decks
	W.collapsePanel(panel, auto?)     hides a panel and adds its chip (TrayTitle); auto marks it for autoTidy
	W.foldPanel(panel)                adds the chip of a panel already hidden (folded in an earlier session)
	W.foldState(panel)                "auto" (autoTidy), "hand" (its minimize button) or nil
	W.restorePanel(panel)             shows it again (decks through their api)
	W.registerTidyPanel(panel)        selection tools autoTidy folds while nothing is selected
	W.autoTidy(hasSelection)
	W.makeChip(name, parent, text) / W.paintChip(button, on) / W.deckSlide()   tab chip and slide timing
	W.chipTextWidth(button, text) -> `text`'s width in the chip's font
	W.chipMetrics() -> { Height, Padding, Gap, TrayHeight } for the current mode
]]

local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local DeckSplit = require(script.Parent.DeckSplit)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local Motion = require(script.Parent.Motion)
local Skin = require(script.Parent.Skin)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(W)

local tray = nil
local tidyPanels = {}
local deckApis = {}
-- Deck frame -> { [pageKey] = panel } for the panels a split deck uses.
local deckSolos = {}

-- A chip's colours for its state; a selected one wears the Custom mode's button layers too.
local function paintChip(button, on)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = on and T.Accent or T.BlobBg
	button.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or T.BlobAlpha
	button.TextColor3 = on and T.OnAccent or T.MutedGold
	Skin.dressLit(button, on)
end

-- Chip height, text padding, gap and tray chip height; Classic keeps its small chips.
local function chipMetrics()
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return { Height = 14, Padding = 10, Gap = 3, TrayHeight = 16 }
	end
	return { Height = 18, Padding = 14, Gap = 4, TrayHeight = 20 }
end

local function makeChip(name, parent, text)
	local metrics = chipMetrics()
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Text = text
	TypeScale.style(button, "Chip")
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, metrics.Height)
	button.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.ZIndex = 12
	button.Parent = parent
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, metrics.Padding / 2)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, metrics.Padding / 2)
	padding.Parent = button
	W.addCorner(button, UDim.new(0, metrics.Height / 2))
	W.addStroke(button)
	paintChip(button, false)
	return button
end

-- A chip's face has an Enum.Font only in Classic; elsewhere it reads back as Unknown and is
-- measured as Constants says.
local MEASURE_BOUNDS = Vector2.new(10000, 100)
local function chipTextWidth(button, text)
	local font = button.Font
	if font == Enum.Font.Unknown then
		font = C.SOFT_MEASURE_FONT
	end
	return TextService:GetTextSize(text, button.TextSize, font, MEASURE_BOUNDS).X
end

-- Shared with UIBuilder/PropertiesTabs, whose chips and page slides match a deck's.
W.makeChip = makeChip
W.chipTextWidth = chipTextWidth
W.paintChip = paintChip
W.chipMetrics = chipMetrics
function W.deckSlide()
	return Motion.info(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end

-- Room for the header buttons beside the strip in Classic; other modes leave an icon slot for each
-- control and for DeckSplit's button.
local CLASSIC_STRIP_ROOM = 50
-- Spare pixels past what the header needs, so a measured width never clips a chip.
local FLOOR_MARGIN = 2

function W.makeDeck(sg, spec)
	local pages = spec.pages
	local measure = W.measure
	-- spec.fitWidth: the width that holds the header, set once the tabs exist.
	local fitted = nil
	local function deckWidth()
		return fitted and fitted() or measure(spec.width)
	end
	-- The shell lays the deck's default size (the first page's); the deck lays the shown page's below.
	local frame, chrome = W.makeToolShell(sg, spec.name, deckWidth, function()
		return measure(pages[1].height)
	end)
	frame.Name = spec.name
	frame:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", spec.trayTitle or spec.title or spec.name)
	local header = chrome.header
	local title = chrome.title
	local classic = C.MODE.Structure.Classic
	local classicTitleWidth = 0
	-- Outside Classic: icon slots right of the strip for the header's controls and DeckSplit's button,
	-- counted before it is added.
	local stripSlots = classic and 0 or chrome.controls + 1
	local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
	strip.Name = "Tabs"
	strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	strip.Parent = header
	local layout = W.addListLayout(strip, chipMetrics().Gap, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	-- Right of the chips: the split button (DeckSplit adds it), then minimize and close.
	if classic then
		if spec.title then
			title.Text = spec.title
			classicTitleWidth = spec.titleWidth or 22
			title.Size = UDim2.new(0, classicTitleWidth, 1, 0)
		else
			title.Visible = false
		end
		strip.Position = UDim2.new(0, classicTitleWidth + 4, 0, 2)
		strip.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(classicTitleWidth + 4 + CLASSIC_STRIP_ROOM), 1, -4)
		strip.ZIndex = 12
	else
		if spec.title then
			title.Text = spec.title
			title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
			title.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			title.LayoutOrder = 0
			title.Parent = strip
		else
			title.Visible = false
		end
		W.lay(strip, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, -stripSlots * LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		end)
		strip.ZIndex = 3
	end

	-- The narrowest the deck may be dragged: what the strip's title and chips need beside the header
	-- buttons, within the pages' minimum and its width. Measured on screen (with the UI scale).
	local pageMinWidth = spec.minWidth or spec.width
	-- nil until the deck has been laid out.
	local function leastWidth()
		local width = frame.Size.X.Offset
		if width <= 0 or frame.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local scale = frame.AbsoluteSize.X / width
		local used = 0
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(strip:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
				used += child.AbsoluteSize.X
				count += 1
			end
		end
		used += math.max(count - 1, 0) * layout.Padding.Offset * scale
		local spare = (strip.AbsoluteSize.X - used) / scale
		local floor = math.ceil(width - spare) + FLOOR_MARGIN
		return math.clamp(floor, measure(pageMinWidth), math.max(measure(spec.width), measure(pageMinWidth)))
	end
	W.setResizeMinimum(frame, function()
		return leastWidth() or measure(spec.width)
	end)

	local pageFrames, tabs, heights, order = {}, {}, {}, {}
	for index, page in ipairs(pages) do
		local pageFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		pageFrame.Name = page.key .. "Page"
		pageFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		pageFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		pageFrame.Visible = false
		pageFrame.ZIndex = 1
		pageFrame.Parent = chrome.body
		pageFrames[page.key] = pageFrame
		heights[page.key] = measure(page.height)
		order[page.key] = index
		local tab = makeChip(page.key .. "Tab", strip, page.label)
		tab.LayoutOrder = index
		tabs[page.key] = tab
	end

	-- What the header needs beside the strip's content, measured as the chips are laid out (text size
	-- set first: a relayout restyles text after the slots).
	local function headerNeeds()
		local metrics = chipMetrics()
		local used, count = 0, 0
		if spec.title and not classic then
			TypeScale.style(title, title:GetAttribute("_typeRole") or "Group")
			used += math.ceil(chipTextWidth(title, spec.title))
			count += 1
		end
		for _, page in ipairs(pages) do
			local tab = tabs[page.key]
			if not classic then
				TypeScale.style(tab, "Chip")
			end
			used += math.ceil(chipTextWidth(tab, page.label)) + metrics.Padding
			count += 1
		end
		used += math.max(count - 1, 0) * metrics.Gap
		local padding = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
		local sides = padding and padding.PaddingLeft.Offset + padding.PaddingRight.Offset or 0
		local around = classic and classicTitleWidth + 4 + CLASSIC_STRIP_ROOM or stripSlots * LAYOUT.IconSlot
		return used + around + sides + FLOOR_MARGIN
	end
	if spec.fitWidth then
		fitted = function()
			return math.max(measure(pageMinWidth), headerNeeds())
		end
	end

	local active = nil
	local tweening = false
	-- DeckSplit's state; while split the show / hide / toggle / setTab calls go to it.
	local splitState = nil
	local showListeners, hideListeners, tabListeners = {}, {}, {}
	local api = {}

	local function fire(list, ...)
		for _, fn in ipairs(list) do fn(...) end
	end

	local function syncPages()
		if splitState and splitState.isSplit() then return end
		for key, pageFrame in pairs(pageFrames) do
			pageFrame.Visible = frame.Visible and key == active
			if not frame.Visible then pageFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) end
		end
	end

	-- Slides the new page in from its side of the strip and grows the deck to its height.
	function api.setTab(key, animate)
		if splitState and splitState.isSplit() then
			splitState.routed.setTab(key)
			return
		end
		local target = pageFrames[key]
		if not target then return end
		local fromKey = active
		if fromKey == key then
			syncPages()
			return
		end
		active = key
		frame:SetAttribute("ActiveTab", key)
		for tabKey, tab in pairs(tabs) do paintChip(tab, tabKey == key) end
		if not frame.Visible then
			syncPages()
			fire(tabListeners, fromKey, key)
			return
		end
		local direction = (order[key] >= (order[fromKey] or 0)) and 1 or -1
		local outgoing = fromKey and pageFrames[fromKey] or nil
		if animate then
			tweening = true
			target.Position = UDim2.new(direction, 0, 0, 0)
			target.Visible = true
			local slide = W.deckSlide()
			TweenService:Create(target, slide, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) }):Play()
			local grow = TweenService:Create(frame, slide, { Size = UDim2.new(0, frame.Size.X.Offset, 0, heights[key]) })
			grow.Completed:Connect(function() tweening = false end)
			grow:Play()
			if outgoing then
				local leave = TweenService:Create(outgoing, slide, { Position = UDim2.new(-direction, 0, 0, 0) })
				leave.Completed:Connect(function()
					if active ~= fromKey then outgoing.Visible = false end
					outgoing.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				end)
				leave:Play()
			end
		else
			frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, frame.Size.X.Offset, 0, heights[key])
			syncPages()
		end
		fire(tabListeners, fromKey, key)
	end

	function api.show(key)
		if splitState and splitState.isSplit() then
			splitState.routed.show(key)
			return
		end
		if key then api.setTab(key, false) end
		W.restoreChip(frame)
		frame.Visible = true
		task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(frame) end)
	end

	function api.hide()
		if splitState and splitState.isSplit() then
			splitState.routed.hide()
			return
		end
		frame.Visible = false
	end

	-- The deck closes when its shown page is asked for again; any other page just comes forward.
	function api.toggle(key)
		if splitState and splitState.isSplit() then
			splitState.routed.toggle(key)
			return
		end
		if frame.Visible and (key == nil or key == active) then
			api.hide()
		else
			api.show(key)
		end
	end

	function api.activeKey() return active end
	function api.onShow(fn) table.insert(showListeners, fn) end
	function api.onHide(fn) table.insert(hideListeners, fn) end
	function api.onTabChange(fn) table.insert(tabListeners, fn) end

	-- A tab switches on a click only: the cursor crossing the strip on its way leaves the page be.
	for key, tab in pairs(tabs) do
		tab.Activated:Connect(function() api.setTab(key, true) end)
	end
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
		for tabKey, tab in pairs(tabs) do paintChip(tab, tabKey == active) end
	end)
	frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
		if not tweening and frame.Visible and active then heights[active] = frame.Size.Y.Offset end
	end)
	frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		syncPages()
		if frame.Visible then fire(showListeners, active) else fire(hideListeners, active) end
	end)
	api.setTab(pages[1].key, false)

	-- A layout change: each page takes its new height and the deck its new width, unless the user
	-- sized them since.
	local laidWidth = frame.Size.X.Offset
	local laidHeights = table.clone(heights)
	W.layEach(frame, function()
		local width = deckWidth()
		for _, page in ipairs(pages) do
			local height = measure(page.height)
			if heights[page.key] == laidHeights[page.key] then
				heights[page.key] = height
			end
			laidHeights[page.key] = height
		end
		if not tweening and active and not (splitState and splitState.isSplit()) then
			local x = frame.Size.X.Offset
			if x == laidWidth then
				x = width
			end
			frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, heights[active])
		end
		laidWidth = width
	end)

	-- A fitted deck opens at exactly its narrowest, measured on screen as it shows (text at a UI scale
	-- renders narrower than headerNeeds measures); a width the user set stays.
	if fitted then
		frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			local least = frame.Visible and frame.Size.X.Offset == laidWidth and leastWidth()
			if least then
				laidWidth = least
				frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, least, frame.Size.Y.Scale, frame.Size.Y.Offset)
			end
		end)
	end

	splitState = DeckSplit.attach(W, {
		sg = sg, frame = frame, chrome = chrome, title = spec.title, pages = pages,
		pageFrames = pageFrames, heights = heights, width = spec.width, minWidth = pageMinWidth, api = api,
		syncPages = syncPages,
		setActive = function(key)
			active = key
			frame:SetAttribute("ActiveTab", key)
			for tabKey, tab in pairs(tabs) do paintChip(tab, tabKey == key) end
		end,
	})
	deckApis[frame] = api
	deckSolos[frame] = splitState.solos
	return { Frame = frame, Pages = pageFrames, api = api, Solos = splitState.solos }
end

function W.makeTray(hud)
	-- A new tray is a new UI: the decks and panels listed for the one before it are destroyed.
	tidyPanels = {}
	deckApis = {}
	deckSolos = {}
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Tray"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	frame.LayoutOrder = 1
	frame.Parent = hud
	local layout = W.addListLayout(frame, chipMetrics().Gap, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	pcall(function() layout.Wraps = true end)
	tray = { frame = frame, chips = {}, auto = {}, shown = {} }
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
		for _, chip in pairs(tray.chips) do paintChip(chip, false) end
	end)
	return frame
end

function W.restoreChip(panel)
	if not tray then return end
	local chip = tray.chips[panel]
	if not chip then return end
	chip:Destroy()
	tray.chips[panel] = nil
	tray.auto[panel] = nil
	local shownConn = tray.shown[panel]
	if shownConn then
		shownConn:Disconnect()
		tray.shown[panel] = nil
	end
end

local function addChip(panel, auto)
	if tray.chips[panel] then return end
	local chip = makeChip("Chip", tray.frame, panel:GetAttribute("TrayTitle") or panel.Name)
	chip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, chipMetrics().TrayHeight)
	tray.chips[panel] = chip
	tray.auto[panel] = auto == true
	chip.Activated:Connect(function() W.restorePanel(panel) end)
	-- A panel shown by any other path (Q-menu, shortcut, toolbar) drops its chip.
	tray.shown[panel] = panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if panel.Visible then W.restoreChip(panel) end
	end)
end

-- The chip is recorded before the panel hides: PanelPersistence asks foldState from the Visible
-- signal, and saves a folded panel as not closed.
function W.collapsePanel(panel, auto)
	if not tray or not panel.Visible then return end
	addChip(panel, auto)
	panel.Visible = false
end

function W.foldPanel(panel)
	if not tray or panel.Visible then return end
	addChip(panel, false)
end

function W.foldState(panel)
	if not tray or not tray.chips[panel] then return nil end
	return tray.auto[panel] and "auto" or "hand"
end

function W.restorePanel(panel)
	W.restoreChip(panel)
	local api = deckApis[panel]
	if api then
		api.show()
	else
		panel.Visible = true
		task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
	end
end

-- A deck brings its split-mode page panels along.
function W.registerTidyPanel(panel)
	table.insert(tidyPanels, panel)
	for _, solo in pairs(deckSolos[panel] or {}) do
		table.insert(tidyPanels, solo)
	end
end

-- Nothing selected: fold the open selection tools into the tray; a selection brings them back
-- (panels folded by hand stay folded).
function W.autoTidy(hasSelection)
	if not tray then return end
	if hasSelection then
		local restore = {}
		for panel, isAuto in pairs(tray.auto) do
			if isAuto then table.insert(restore, panel) end
		end
		for _, panel in ipairs(restore) do W.restorePanel(panel) end
	else
		for _, panel in ipairs(tidyPanels) do
			if panel.Visible then W.collapsePanel(panel, true) end
		end
	end
end

end

--[[
	WidgetDropdown  -  the inline dropdown: a field that expands a floating option list. Loaded by
	Widgets.luau; adds makeDropdown, hideDropdownExpansion and openDropdown to it.
	The list shows up to MAX_VISIBLE_OPTIONS rows and scrolls beyond (Material has about 45). It
	opens under the field, or above where there is more room, inside the screen, scrolled to the
	current option.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local InstanceMap = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.InstanceMap)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local MAX_VISIBLE_OPTIONS = 10
-- The list opens under its field while at least this many rows fit there.
local MIN_ROWS_BELOW = 6
-- Kept clear between the list and the screen's top or bottom edge.
local SCREEN_MARGIN = 8
-- The list's own padding above and below its options.
local LIST_PAD = 3
local SCROLLBAR = 3

return function(Widgets)
	local addCorner, addStroke, addListLayout = Widgets.addCorner, Widgets.addStroke, Widgets.addListLayout

	local _activeDropdownExpansion = nil
	local _activeDropdownBtn = nil
	local _activeDropdownArrow = nil
	local _dropdownOptButtons = {}
	-- The ScrollingFrame a hover switched off, so a close from elsewhere can switch it back on.
	local _hoverScrollDisabled = nil

	local function hideDropdownExpansion()
		if _activeDropdownExpansion then
			_activeDropdownExpansion:Destroy()
			_activeDropdownExpansion = nil
		end
		if _activeDropdownArrow then _activeDropdownArrow.Text = "\u{25BC}" end
		if _hoverScrollDisabled and _hoverScrollDisabled.Parent then
			_hoverScrollDisabled.ScrollingEnabled = true
		end
		_hoverScrollDisabled = nil
		_activeDropdownBtn = nil
		_activeDropdownArrow = nil
		_dropdownOptButtons = {}
	end
	Widgets.hideDropdownExpansion = hideDropdownExpansion

	-- Field -> what a click on it does; Widgets.openDropdown uses it, as a script cannot click.
	local _toggleByField = InstanceMap.new()
	function Widgets.openDropdown(field)
		local toggle = _toggleByField:get(field)
		if toggle then
			toggle()
		end
	end

	local function _dropdownHL() return T.Selected end
	local function updateDropdownHighlight(selectedIdx)
		local hl = _dropdownHL()
		for i, ob in ipairs(_dropdownOptButtons) do
			ob.BackgroundColor3 = (i == selectedIdx) and hl or T.BlobBg
			ob.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			ob.TextColor3 = (i == selectedIdx) and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
		end
	end

	function Widgets.makeDropdown(name, parent, options, default)
		local f = Instance.new("TextButton"); f.Name = name.."Wrap"
		f.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; f.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		f.Text = ""
		Widgets.lay(f, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight)
		end)
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.AutoButtonColor = false
		if parent then f.Parent = parent end
		addCorner(f); addStroke(f); table.insert(Widgets.getThemed().blobs, f)
		-- A choice reads as a field, not a button (Skin): its own surface beats the blobs' class guess.
		table.insert(Widgets.getThemed().surfaces, { inst = f, surface = "field" })

		-- The wheel cycles options only after the pointer rests SCROLL_HOVER_DELAY seconds; 0: not hovering.
		local _hoverEnterAt = 0
		local SCROLL_HOVER_DELAY = 0.2

		-- Hovering switches off the parent's scroll so the wheel cycles options. PropertiesTabs switches
		-- its page host back on at every page change: a dropdown can leave with its page.
		f.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			-- Covered by another panel or an open list: no hover, so the wheel cannot cycle it either.
			if Widgets.pointerBlocked(f) then return end
			_hoverEnterAt = os.clock()
			local scroll = f:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
			if scroll then
				scroll.ScrollingEnabled = false
				_hoverScrollDisabled = scroll
			end
		end)
		f.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			_hoverEnterAt = 0
			local scroll = f:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
			if scroll then scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true end
			if _hoverScrollDisabled == scroll then _hoverScrollDisabled = nil end
		end)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Name = name; lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Text = default or options[1] or ""; lbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		Widgets.layProps(lbl, function()
			return { Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.FieldPad + LAYOUT.IconSlot), 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.FieldPad, 0, 0) }
		end)
		TypeScale.style(lbl, "Value")
		lbl.Parent = f
		Widgets.wireFieldStates(f)

		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = "\u{25BC}"; arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		Widgets.layProps(arrow, function()
			return { Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, 0) }
		end)
		TypeScale.style(arrow, "Caption")
		arrow.Parent = f

		local idx = 1; for i, o in ipairs(options) do if o == default then idx = i; break end end
		local _onChanged = nil

		local function setValue(newIdx)
			idx = newIdx; lbl.Text = options[idx]
			if _onChanged then _onChanged(options[idx]) end
		end

		f.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
			if _hoverEnterAt == 0 or (os.clock() - _hoverEnterAt) < SCROLL_HOVER_DELAY then return end
			if Widgets.pointerBlocked(f) then return end
			if input.Position.Z > 0 then
				idx = idx % #options + 1
			else
				idx = (idx - 2) % #options + 1
			end
			setValue(idx)
			if _activeDropdownBtn == f then
				updateDropdownHighlight(idx)
			end
		end)

		local function toggleList()
			if _activeDropdownBtn == f then
				hideDropdownExpansion(); return
			end
			hideDropdownExpansion()
			_activeDropdownBtn = f
			_activeDropdownArrow = arrow
			arrow.Text = "\u{25B2}"

			-- In the ScreenGui, clear of any ScrollingFrame's clipping.
			local sg = f:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
			if not sg then return end

			-- AbsolutePosition is in screen pixels; divide by UIScale to get ScreenGui coordinates
			local scale = 1
			local uiScaleObj = sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			if uiScaleObj then scale = uiScaleObj.Scale end

			local absPos = f.AbsolutePosition
			local absSize = f.AbsoluteSize

			local optionStep = LAYOUT.Row + 1
			local fullHeight = #options * optionStep - 1 + LIST_PAD * 2
			local fieldTop = (absPos.Y - sg.AbsolutePosition.Y) / scale
			local fieldBottom = fieldTop + absSize.Y / scale
			local roomBelow = sg.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale - fieldBottom - SCREEN_MARGIN
			local roomAbove = fieldTop - SCREEN_MARGIN
			local screenHeight = sg.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale
			local height = math.min(fullHeight, MAX_VISIBLE_OPTIONS * optionStep - 1 + LIST_PAD * 2)
			local enoughBelow = math.min(fullHeight, MIN_ROWS_BELOW * optionStep)
			local opensAbove = roomBelow < enoughBelow and roomAbove > roomBelow
			local room = opensAbove and roomAbove or roomBelow
			height = math.max(math.min(height, room), optionStep)
			local listTop = opensAbove and (fieldTop - height) or fieldBottom
			-- A field that is itself partly off the screen still gets a list that is on it.
			listTop = math.clamp(listTop, SCREEN_MARGIN, math.max(screenHeight - height - SCREEN_MARGIN, SCREEN_MARGIN))

			local optFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); optFrame.Name = name.."Options"
			optFrame.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; optFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			optFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
			-- Sinks a press on the gaps between options, which would otherwise reach the panel behind.
			optFrame.Active = true
			optFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, absPos.X / scale, 0, listTop)
			optFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, absSize.X / scale, 0, height)
			optFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			optFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			optFrame.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
			optFrame.ScrollBarThickness = SCROLLBAR
			optFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
			optFrame.VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar
			-- Above modal panels (HitFilterPanel, ConfigPanel at 200) and their children: the ScreenGui sorts
			-- siblings by ZIndex.
			optFrame.ZIndex = 250
			optFrame.Parent = sg
			addCorner(optFrame); addStroke(optFrame)
			addListLayout(optFrame, 1)

			local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
			pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4); pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
			pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, LIST_PAD); pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, LIST_PAD)
			pad.Parent = optFrame

			_activeDropdownExpansion = optFrame
			_dropdownOptButtons = {}

			for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
				local ob = Instance.new("TextButton"); ob.Name = "Opt"..i
				ob.BackgroundColor3 = (i == idx) and _dropdownHL() or T.BlobBg
				ob.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				ob.Text = opt; ob.TextColor3 = (i == idx) and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
				ob.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; TypeScale.style(ob, "Value")
				ob.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row); ob.BorderSizePixel = 0; ob.LayoutOrder = i
				Widgets.addPadding(ob, 4, 4, 0, 0)
				ob.AutoButtonColor = true; ob.ZIndex = 250; ob.Parent = optFrame
				addCorner(ob, UDim.new(0,3))
				table.insert(_dropdownOptButtons, ob)
				ob.Activated:Connect(function()
					setValue(i)
					hideDropdownExpansion()
				end)
			end

			-- Opens on the current option, centred when the list scrolls (CanvasPosition is in screen pixels).
			local centred = (idx - 1) * optionStep - (height - optionStep) / 2
			local furthest = math.max(fullHeight - height, 0)
			optFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.clamp(centred, 0, furthest) * scale)
		end
		f.Activated:Connect(toggleList)
		_toggleByField:set(f, toggleList)

		local function setOnChanged(fn) _onChanged = fn end
		return lbl, f, setOnChanged
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetEvents  -  the Properties panel's Events section, one per type: a block per event (OnEmit /
	OnDeath / OnDestruction / OnHit), each a header with its enable toggle over its fields:
	  Hit Filter: [summary] [...]        (type level; types with OnHit only)
	  [Toggle] OnEmit -> Sparks · AtPosition
	     description, Emit [instance picker], Mode [AtPosition v] + hint + badge,
	     Script [Run Script] [Edit Script], Chain [depth 1..32], [Reset Event]
	The fields hide while the event is off; Populate fills the refs from the selection:
	  refs.Events = { _HitFilter = { row, label, dotsBtn },
	    OnEmit = { row, toggle, fields, description, headerLabel, baseLabel, EmitTarget = { label, dotsBtn },
	      EmitMode = { dropdown, setOnChanged }, ModeHint, ModeBadge, ScriptEnabled = { toggle },
	      EditScript, ChainDepth = { input, setVal, getVal }, ResetEvent }, OnDeath = { ... }, ... }
	WidgetEventShapes gives the row shapes; this module decides which rows exist and in what order.
	OnHit is left out where EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName says it means nothing (Beam, PointLight,
	screens, ImageLabel): the section is built once per type, before any item exists.
]]

local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local WidgetEventShapes = require(script.Parent.WidgetEventShapes)
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.EventsSchema)

local WidgetEvents = {}

local EVENT_LABELS = {
	OnEmit        = "On Emit",
	OnDeath       = "On Death",
	OnDestruction = "On Destruction",
	OnHit         = "On Hit",
}
local EVENT_DESCRIPTIONS = {
	OnEmit        = "Fires right after a particle clone spawns + enters the Heartbeat loop.",
	OnDeath       = "Fires when a particle's lifetime exhausts (each cycle if AnimateLoop=true).",
	OnDestruction = "Fires once just before the visual is destroyed (after PartLife linger).",
	OnHit         = "Fires per-frame on a sweep raycast hit between previous and current pose.",
}

-- Hit Filter row: summary label + "..." opening the HitFilterPanel. Wired by EventsConnectors.
local function buildHitFilterRow(shapes, parent)
	local row, content = shapes.rowSlot(parent, "Hit Filter")
	row.LayoutOrder = -1
	local label, dotsBtn = shapes.summary(content)
	return { row = row, label = label, dotsBtn = dotsBtn }
end

-- One event block (toggle + fields); returns its refs.
local function buildEventBlock(shapes, parent, eventName, layoutOrder)
	local block = Instance.new("Frame")
	block.Name = eventName .. "Block"
	block.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	block.BorderSizePixel = 0
	block.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	block.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	block.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
	block.Parent = parent
	W.addListLayout(block, shapes.gap)

	local refs = {}

	refs.baseLabel = EVENT_LABELS[eventName] or eventName
	refs.headerLabel, refs.toggle = shapes.header(block, refs.baseLabel)
	refs.row = block

	-- Shown while the event is on (Populate).
	local fields = Instance.new("Frame")
	fields.Name = "Fields"
	fields.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	fields.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fields.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	fields.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	fields.LayoutOrder = 1
	fields.Visible = false
	fields.Parent = block
	W.addListLayout(fields, shapes.gap)
	refs.fields = fields

	-- Shown by Populate while a selected item has ImportedUntrusted. Trust permits running but does
	-- not turn the event on.
	local untrustedBadge = shapes.note(fields, "Untrusted  -  review the script, then click Trust before this can run.", true)
	untrustedBadge.LayoutOrder = -1
	untrustedBadge.Visible = false
	refs.UntrustedBadge = untrustedBadge

	local description = shapes.note(fields, EVENT_DESCRIPTIONS[eventName] or "", false)
	description.LayoutOrder = 0
	refs.description = description

	-- The target's FullName and "..." for the instance picker (EventsConnectors).
	local pickerRow, pickerContent = shapes.rowSlot(fields, "Emit")
	pickerRow.LayoutOrder = 1
	local pickerLabel, pickerDots = shapes.picker(pickerContent)
	refs.EmitTarget = { label = pickerLabel, dotsBtn = pickerDots }

	local modeRow, modeContent = shapes.rowSlot(fields, "Mode")
	modeRow.LayoutOrder = 2
	local modeBtn, modeFrame, modeSetOnChanged =
		W.makeDropdown("Mode", modeContent, { "AtPosition", "AtSource", "AtTarget", "AtCFrame" }, "AtPosition")
	modeFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	modeFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	refs.EmitMode = { dropdown = modeBtn, setOnChanged = modeSetOnChanged }

	-- One-line hint for the selected mode + a badge when the picked target cannot honour it.
	local modeHint = shapes.note(fields, EventsSchema.EMIT_MODE_HINTS.AtPosition or "", false)
	modeHint.LayoutOrder = 3
	refs.ModeHint = modeHint
	local modeBadge = shapes.note(fields, "", true)
	modeBadge.LayoutOrder = 4
	modeBadge.Visible = false
	refs.ModeBadge = modeBadge

	local scriptRow, scriptContent = shapes.rowSlot(fields, "Script")
	scriptRow.LayoutOrder = 5
	local scriptToggle, editButton = shapes.scriptControls(scriptContent)
	refs.ScriptEnabled = { toggle = scriptToggle }
	refs.EditScript = editButton

	local depthRow, depthContent = shapes.rowSlot(fields, "Chain")
	depthRow.LayoutOrder = 6
	refs.ChainDepth = { input = shapes.valueBox(depthContent, "DW", "4", "1..32") }

	-- OnHit only: Collision Off (default) passes through; Kill / Stop / Bounce change the particle at
	-- the hit. OnHit itself is limited to Part / Attachment / Model (EventsSchema.VALID_PER_TYPE).
	if eventName == "OnHit" then
		local collRow, collContent = shapes.rowSlot(fields, "Collide")
		collRow.LayoutOrder = 7
		local collBtn, collFrame, collSetOnChanged =
			W.makeDropdown("Collide", collContent, { "Off", "Kill", "Stop", "Bounce" }, "Off")
		collFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		collFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		refs.Collision = { dropdown = collBtn, setOnChanged = collSetOnChanged }

		-- Shown only for Bounce (Populate). Bounciness, Friction and Spin: restitution, tangential damping
		-- and an angular impulse coefficient.
		local function makePhysicsRow(label, order, default)
			local row, content = shapes.rowSlot(fields, label)
			row.LayoutOrder = order
			row.Visible = false
			return row, shapes.valueBox(content, label .. "W", tostring(default), nil)
		end
		local bRow, bBox = makePhysicsRow("Bounce%",  8, 0.7)
		local fRow, fBox = makePhysicsRow("Friction", 9, 0.2)
		local sRow, sBox = makePhysicsRow("Spin",     10, 0.5)
		refs.Bounciness = { row = bRow, input = bBox }
		refs.Friction   = { row = fRow, input = fBox }
		refs.SpinAttr   = { row = sRow, input = sBox }

		-- OnHit's raycast interval, shown whatever the Collision: 0 checks every Heartbeat; more costs
		-- fewer rays but can tunnel between checks. Clamped 0..0.5.
		local hRow, hBox = makePhysicsRow("HitTick", 11, 0)
		hRow.Visible = true
		refs.HitCheckInterval = { row = hRow, input = hBox }
	end

	-- Shown by Populate with ImportedUntrusted; EventsConnectors calls EventsSchema.trustEvent.
	local trustBtn = shapes.button(fields, "Trust", "Trust Script", "trust")
	trustBtn.LayoutOrder = 12
	trustBtn.Visible = false
	refs.TrustScript = trustBtn

	-- EventsConnectors wires it with a confirm.
	local resetBtn = shapes.button(fields, "Reset", "Reset Event", "reset")
	resetBtn.LayoutOrder = 13
	refs.ResetEvent = resetBtn

	return refs
end

-- Builds the Events section into `scrollParent`; returns the refs the caller keeps as
-- refs.Events. `typeName` decides which event rows show.
function WidgetEvents.buildEventsSection(scrollParent, typeName, layoutOrder)
	local shapes = WidgetEventShapes.current()
	local section, body = W.makeSection(scrollParent, "Events", layoutOrder, true)
	local refs = {}
	-- Type-level hit filter (OnHit, Rocks and Lightning raycasts share it). Above the event
	-- blocks so it stays reachable while OnHit is off.
	if EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName(typeName, "OnHit") then
		refs._HitFilter = buildHitFilterRow(shapes, body)
	end
	local order = 0
	for _, eventName in ipairs(EventsSchema.EVENT_NAMES) do
		if EventsSchema.isValidForTypeName(typeName, eventName) then
			refs[eventName] = buildEventBlock(shapes, body, eventName, order)
			order += 1
		end
	end
	refs._section = section
	refs._body = body
	return refs
end

return WidgetEvents

--[[
	WidgetEventShapes  -  the row shapes WidgetEvents builds an Events section from, in two sets:
	Classic's boxed labels and toggles, and plain property-style rows for the other modes.
	WidgetEventShapes.current() returns the set for the current mode:
	  gap                                              spacing between stacked rows (pixels, or a LAYOUT key)
	  note(parent, text, danger) -> TextLabel          wrapping small text; danger marks a warning
	  rowSlot(parent, label) -> row, content           label on the left, content frame on the right
	  header(block, text) -> label, toggle             an event's title row with its enable toggle
	  summary(content) -> label, dotsButton            a line of text with a "..." button (hit filter)
	  picker(content) -> label, dotsButton             an instance path with a "..." button
	  valueBox(content, name, text, placeholder) -> TextBox
	  scriptControls(content) -> toggle, editButton
	  button(parent, name, text, kind) -> TextButton   kind: "trust" or "reset"
	Populate and EventsConnectors recolour the header, summary and picker labels with T.Gold,
	T.BrightGold and T.MutedGold, so those labels carry no theme role of their own.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local WidgetEventShapes = {}

local Classic = { gap = 3 }

function Classic.note(parent, text, danger)
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = text
	lbl.TextColor3 = danger and (T.Red or T.Gold) or T.MutedGold
	lbl.Font = T.Font
	lbl.TextSize = 8
	lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	lbl.TextWrapped = true
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
	lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	lbl.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lbl.Parent = parent
	lbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	return lbl
end

function Classic.rowSlot(parent, label)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight)
	row.Parent = parent
	local lblBlob = W.makeBlob("L", row, UDim2.new(0, 60, 1, 0))
	W.makeLabel("L", lblBlob, label, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.BorderSizePixel = 0
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 0)
	content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0)
	content.Parent = row
	return row, content
end

function Classic.header(block, text)
	local headerRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	headerRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	headerRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	headerRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.RowHeight)
	headerRow.LayoutOrder = 0
	headerRow.Parent = block
	local lblBlob = W.makeBlob("Lbl", headerRow, UDim2.new(1, -34, 1, 0))

--[[
	WidgetHover  -  hover and focus feedback of the plugin's rows and fields.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared Widgets table and adds:
	  Widgets.wireFieldStates(field, textBox)   outline feedback on a field (none in Classic)
	  Widgets.wireRowHover(row, label)          faint fill and brighter label on a property row
	  Widgets.clearRowHover()                   unlights the lit row
	MouseEnter reaches a row or field even while something is drawn over it, so both ignore a
	cursor that something else covers (Widgets.pointerBlocked, WidgetPointer).
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local Skin = require(script.Parent.Skin)
local T = C.T

return function(Widgets)
	-- `textBox` is optional. Classic has no field feedback.
	function Widgets.wireFieldStates(field, textBox)
		local stroke = field:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if not stroke or C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			return
		end
		local hovered = false
		local focused = false

		-- From the outline at rest: the theme's border, or a Custom outline layer's (Skin). Hover and
		-- focus show at the theme's border opacity, so an outline faint at rest still answers.
		local function repaint()
			local rest = Skin.outline(stroke)
			local thickness = rest and rest.thickness or 1
			if focused then
				stroke.Color = T.Focus
				stroke.Thickness = thickness + 1
				stroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha
			elseif hovered then
				stroke.Color = T.OutlineHover
				stroke.Thickness = thickness
				stroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha
			else
				stroke.Color = rest and rest.color or T.Border
				stroke.Thickness = thickness
				stroke.Transparency = rest and rest.transparency or T.BorderAlpha
			end
		end

		field.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if Widgets.pointerBlocked(field) then
				return
			end
			hovered = true
			repaint()
		end)
		field.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hovered = false
			repaint()
		end)
		if textBox then
			textBox.Focused:Connect(function()
				focused = true
				repaint()
			end)
			textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				focused = false
				repaint()
			end)
		end
	end

	-- How faint the hover fill is: the text colour laid over the row at this transparency.
	local ROW_HOVER_TRANSPARENCY = 0.94

	-- Unlights the lit row. One row is lit at a time, so lighting another also clears a row whose
	-- MouseLeave was missed (it is not sent while the list scrolls under the cursor).
	local _unlightRow = nil
	function Widgets.clearRowHover()
		if _unlightRow then
			_unlightRow()
		end
		_unlightRow = nil
	end

	function Widgets.wireRowHover(row, label)
		Widgets.paint(row, "BackgroundColor3", "TextPrimary")
		Widgets.addCorner(row)

		local function unlight()
			row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		end
		row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			-- Wired on every row; the structure says whether rows light (it may change in place).
			if Widgets.pointerBlocked(row) or not C.MODE.Structure.RowHover then
				return
			end
			if _unlightRow ~= unlight then
				Widgets.clearRowHover()
			end
			_unlightRow = unlight
			row.BackgroundTransparency = ROW_HOVER_TRANSPARENCY
			label.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		end)
		row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if _unlightRow == unlight then
				Widgets.clearRowHover()
			end
		end)
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetPointer  -  whether the cursor can actually reach a GuiObject. Loaded by Widgets.luau; adds:
	  Widgets.pointerBlocked(object, point) -> true when something else of this UI is drawn over
	      `object` at the cursor: another panel, a popup, an open option list. `point` (screen
	      pixels) stands in for the cursor, for checks; the plugin never passes it.
	The engine sends MouseEnter and wheel input to an object under the cursor even while something
	is drawn over it. Every hover and wheel reaction of the plugin asks this first: rows and fields
	(WidgetHover), dropdowns, menu items, deck tabs, resize handles, checklist rows, the toolbar and
	the Inventory's tiles (UIBuilder.pointerBlocked). A new hover handler must do the same.
	The order comes from the engine's own hit test, front to back. `object`, its descendants and its
	ancestors never block it; of the rest only what draws something counts.
]]

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- True when the object itself paints pixels (its children are hit-tested on their own).
local function drawsSomething(object)
	if object.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
		return true
	end
	if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
		return object.Text ~= "" and object.TextTransparency < 1
	end
	if object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
		return object.Image ~= "" and object.ImageTransparency < 1
	end
	return object:IsA("ViewportFrame")
end

return function(Widgets)
	function Widgets.pointerBlocked(object, point)
		local gui = object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not gui then
			return false
		end
		local mouse = point or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local found, hits = pcall(CoreGui.GetGuiObjectsAtPosition, CoreGui, mouse.X, mouse.Y)
		if not found then
			return false
		end
		for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
			if hit == object or hit:IsDescendantOf(object) then
				return false
			end
			if hit:IsDescendantOf(gui) and not object:IsDescendantOf(hit) and drawsSomething(hit) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
end

--[[
	Property toggles for the Clipboard and Shifter panels: checkboxes, drag-select, select-all on
	headers and checkbox propagation. Loaded by Widgets.luau; adds buildPropToggles to W.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(W)

-- Row sizes: Classic's compact boxed rows, or plain rows at the mode's text size.
-- arrow: width of a category's arrow. indent: how far a category's rows sit in.
local function metrics()
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return { classic = true, row = 16, head = 18, check = 14, arrow = 14, indent = 8, gap = 1 }
	end
	local row = LAYOUT.Row - 4
	return { classic = false, row = row, head = row, check = 20, arrow = 16, indent = 16, gap = 0 }
end

-- A row's surface: a boxed blob in Classic, otherwise a bare frame that lights under the cursor.
-- heightKey: the metrics() entry for its height ("row" or "head"), which follows the layout.
local function makeRowSurface(name, parent, heightKey)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return W.makeBlob(name, parent, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics()[heightKey]))
	end
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = name
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.lay(row, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics()[heightKey])
	end)
	W.paint(row, "BackgroundColor3", "FieldHover")
	row.Parent = parent
	W.addCorner(row)
	row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if W.pointerBlocked(row) then return end
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	end)
	row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	end)
	return row
end

-- Text at the mode's size; Classic keeps the literal size its builder set.
local function styleText(label, role)
	if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		TypeScale.style(label, role)
	end
end

local _dragConnection = nil
local _allDragStates = {}

function W.resetDragState()
	_allDragStates = {}
	if _dragConnection then _dragConnection:Disconnect(); _dragConnection = nil end
end

-- rightInset (a number, or a function that follows the layout) keeps the box clear of a chevron
-- at the header's right end.
local function makeChk(parent, rightInset)
	local c = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	c.Name = "Chk"; c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	c.Text = "☐"; c.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	c.Font = T.Font; c.TextSize = 10
	c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	W.layProps(c, function()
		return { Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics().check, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -2 - (W.measure(rightInset) or 0), 0, 0) }
	end)
	c.ZIndex = 3; c.Parent = parent
	styleText(c, "Label")
	return c
end

local function setChk(chk, on)
	chk.Text = on and "☑" or "☐"
	chk.TextColor3 = on and T.Gold or T.DarkGold
end

local function allSelected(body)
	for _, d in ipairs(body:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:GetAttribute("Selected") == false then return false end
	end
	return true
end

local function makePropToggle(parent, propName, layoutOrder, dragState, onChanged, displayNames)
	local sizes = metrics()
	local row = makeRowSurface(propName .. "Tog", parent, "row")
	row.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
	row:SetAttribute("Selected", false); row:SetAttribute("PropRow", true)
	row:SetAttribute("PropKey", propName) -- raw key for the Clipboard and Shifter lookups

	-- ToolPanels.wireSearch reads the row's first TextLabel as its name: the label comes before the box.
	local displayName = displayNames and displayNames[propName] or propName
	local label = W.makeLabel("L", row, displayName, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	if not sizes.classic then
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(sizes.check + 8), 1, 0)
	end
	styleText(label, "Label")

	local chk = makeChk(row)

	local function apply(sel)
		row:SetAttribute("Selected", sel)
		setChk(chk, sel)
		if onChanged then onChanged() end
	end

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = "Click"; btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	btn.Text = ""; btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); btn.Parent = row

	-- MouseButton1Down toggles at once and arms the drag: a sweep across rows sets each to the first
	-- click's new state (dragState.mode). Activated would wait for the release.
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		local newSel = not row:GetAttribute("Selected")
		dragState.active = true; dragState.mode = newSel
		apply(newSel)
	end)

	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		-- Rows already in the drag's state are skipped: MouseEnter fires again on every re-entry.
		if dragState.active and row:GetAttribute("Selected") ~= dragState.mode and not W.pointerBlocked(btn) then
			apply(dragState.mode)
		end
	end)
	return row
end

local function makeSubSection(parent, name, order)
	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = name:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Sub"
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	container.LayoutOrder = order; container.Parent = parent
	W.addListLayout(container, 0)
	local sizes = metrics()

	-- Header: ToolPanels.wireSearch finds it and its Arrow by name.
	local head = makeRowSurface("Header", container, "head")
	head.LayoutOrder = 0

	local arrow = W.makeLabel("Arrow", head, "▶", T.DarkGold, T.Font, 7)
	arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizes.arrow - 2, 1, 0); arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)
	styleText(arrow, "Caption")

	local title = W.makeLabel("Title", head, name, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 9)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, sizes.arrow, 0, 0)
	if not sizes.classic then
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(sizes.arrow + sizes.check + 8), 1, 0)
	end
	styleText(title, "Label")

	local body = Instance.new("Frame")
	body.Name = "Body"; body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	body.LayoutOrder = 1; body.Visible = false; body.Parent = container
	W.addListLayout(body, sizes.gap); W.addPadding(body, sizes.indent, 2, 0, 0)

	-- Collapses on the arrow only.
	local collapseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	collapseBtn.Name = "Toggle"; collapseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	collapseBtn.Text = ""; collapseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizes.arrow, 1, 0); collapseBtn.Parent = head
	collapseBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		body.Visible = not body.Visible
		arrow.Text = body.Visible and "▼" or "▶"
	end)

	return body, head
end

-- leftSlot / rightSlot: the header's ends left to its collapse arrow, wherever the mode puts it
-- (numbers, or functions that follow the layout).
local function wireSelectAll(head, body, leftSlot, onChanged, rightSlot)
	local hchk = makeChk(head, rightSlot)

	-- Select-all button covers the title area, clear of the arrow.
	local selBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	selBtn.Name = "SelectAll"; selBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; selBtn.Text = ""
	W.layProps(selBtn, function()
		local aw = W.measure(leftSlot) or 18
		return { Size = UDim2.new(1, -(aw + (W.measure(rightSlot) or 0)), 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, aw, 0, 0) }
	end)
	selBtn.ZIndex = 2; selBtn.Parent = head

	selBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		-- Any row off: select all; else clear all.
		local on = not allSelected(body)

		-- Expands on select, collapses on deselect.
		local ar = head:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
		body.Visible = on
		if ar then ar.Text = on and "▼" or "▶" end

		for _, d in ipairs(body:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:GetAttribute("Selected") ~= nil then d:SetAttribute("Selected", on) end
			if d.Name == "Chk" and d:IsA("TextLabel") then setChk(d, on) end
		end
		setChk(hchk, on)

		if onChanged then onChanged() end
	end)

	return hchk
end

local function makeRefresher(body, chk)
	return function()
		setChk(chk, allSelected(body))
	end
end

-- Returns the list's frame and, per category, addGroup(title, order, rows, attributes): a folded
-- group of its own inside that category, added after the build (Modules/ClipSlots: a Blender
-- state, a decal layer). rows: { {key, label} }; attributes are set on every row. Its header
-- ticks the group, and a tick in it reaches the category's and the list's boxes.

function W.buildPropToggles(parent, propList, sectionName, order, displayNames)
	local container, body, head = W.makeSection(parent, sectionName, order, false)

	-- Drag state shared by the type's rows.
	local dragState = { active = false, mode = false }
	table.insert(_allDragStates, dragState)
	if not _dragConnection then
		_dragConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				for _, ds in ipairs(_allDragStates) do ds.active = false end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Type-level select-all, wired after the sub-sections so ticks propagate. W.makeSection puts the
	-- collapse arrow in the first 18 px in Classic, else in the row indent or at the right end.
	local sizes = metrics()
	local function leftSlot()
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			return 18
		end
		return C.MODE.Structure.ChevronSide == "Left" and LAYOUT.RowIndent or 0
	end
	local function rightSlot()
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			return 0
		end
		return C.MODE.Structure.ChevronSide == "Left" and 0 or LAYOUT.IconSlot
	end
	local typeChk = wireSelectAll(head, body, leftSlot, nil, rightSlot)
	local refreshTypeChk = makeRefresher(body, typeChk)

	local groups = {}
	if #propList > 0 and type(propList[1]) == "table" then
		-- Sectioned list: { name, props } per category.
		for si, sec in ipairs(propList) do
			local secBody, secHead = makeSubSection(body, sec.name, si)
			local secChk = wireSelectAll(secHead, secBody, sizes.arrow, refreshTypeChk)
			local refreshSecChk = makeRefresher(secBody, secChk)

			-- A change refreshes the category's box, then the type's.
			local function onPropChanged()
				refreshSecChk()
				refreshTypeChk()
			end

			for pi, pn in ipairs(sec.props) do
				makePropToggle(secBody, pn, pi, dragState, onPropChanged, displayNames)
			end

			groups[sec.name] = function(title, groupOrder, rows, attributes)
				local groupBody, groupHead = makeSubSection(secBody, title, groupOrder)
				local groupChk = wireSelectAll(groupHead, groupBody, sizes.arrow, onPropChanged)
				local refreshGroupChk = makeRefresher(groupBody, groupChk)
				local function onRowChanged()
					refreshGroupChk()
					onPropChanged()
				end
				local labels = {}
				for _, entry in ipairs(rows) do
					labels[entry.key] = entry.label
				end
				for index, entry in ipairs(rows) do
					local row = makePropToggle(groupBody, entry.key, index, dragState, onRowChanged, labels)
					for name, value in pairs(attributes or {}) do
						row:SetAttribute(name, value)
					end
				end
				onPropChanged()
				return groupBody
			end
		end
	else
		-- A flat list.
		for i, pn in ipairs(propList) do
			makePropToggle(body, pn, i, dragState, refreshTypeChk, displayNames)
		end
	end

	return container, groups
end

end
